description: IMPORTANT: Build 42.X Thanks for the efforts of the community - and most especially FallenxSowerby - the state of Multiplayer Support should be much improved from the previous build. Please be cautioned that there may still be edge-cases that we have been unable to test/verify which may result in desyncs. As always, please use the Discord or GitHub to report issues. Steam comments/discussions are seldom checked. Playing as an administrator or disabling all anti-cheat may help resolve client-server disagreements, but this is not recommended. A Personal Appeal To Decency: Please do not add me directly on Steam or comment on my profile for help with this mod. Use the discord for that. Information: This mod adds a great deal more variety to the traits available to players during character creation. This includes, but not limited to: traits that add some starting equipment, traits that increase your starting level in specific skills but don't give exp multiplier, a bunch of unique traits with interesting effects (examples: better weapons proficiencies, better exp gains for specific playstyle, zombie infection immunity with cure period, scavenging perks, driving perks, and so on). Of course, your typical +1/2 in some skills perks are also present. The mod also attempts to add a greater variety of expense, as in there are more -1, -2, -3, -5 traits. This should help prevent the annoying feeling of having one solitary point left with nothing to spend it on. Dynamic Traits submod is present - you can earn/lose traits by leveling skills, list of all available perks can be found here. Note, that almost everything is configurable through sandbox settings (120 Sandbox options). Want to make only specific perks dynamic? I got you covered,choose which perks you want 1by1. Want to change Skill level requirement to make it easier or harder? No problem, do that. Out of 90+ or so available perks, 50+ can be made dynamic. Some additional info can be found here Known Issues Made of Glass trait sometimes hurts players while sleeping. (Haven't experienced this in a while. Might be fixed?) Killing players in Multiplayer with Martial Artist does not sync their death to the server. Evasive Insta-Death is usually caused by Instant Infection Mortality. Fix is not expected, as we got no clue why this is happening. Mod Compatibility: Evolving Traits World (ETW) - ETW submod marks which traits are dynamic, also makes Butterfingers dynamic. Dynamic Traits - The mod will opt to use their Alcoholic trait over its own. The Only Cure - The Amputation is now officially supported, and the mod will opt to use their amputation method instead of its own. Mod Options - Allows for Client-Side settings to be adjusted. Install if you would like extra options. Moodle Framework - Adds in support for Alcoholic as a moodle. Driving skill - some traits will be auto-disabled to avoid conflicts Scavenging skill (fixed) - some traits will give exp boost in scavenging if mod is present. Scrounger perk is disabled if mod is present, it does same thing as Skill. Original works too. Opening The Project Up To The Community: The Mod is now available on GitHub for others to contribute. https://github.com/hypnotoadtrance/MoreTraits Here you will find the bleeding-edge version of the mod as I and the community continue to build upon it. Regular updates will be posted to the Steam Workshop when appropriate. Public Discord: Because Steam comment sections aren't the best space for collaboration, I've set up a Discord server for this mod. Since the project is officially moving to Github and opening up, it stands to reason that anyone working together on the project will want a place to work together. https://discord.gg/6Czm3uqn4z (p.s. if you tried joining earlier and found you were unable to get passed the react roles, that should be fixed now. Sorry!) There, you will be able to share servers, discuss suggestions, make bug reports, perform translations, and get help coding for the project. description: The infection is widespread in the Zone, and how it spreads is unknown. We have seen soldiers in HazMat suits, however. The US Army is taking absolutely no chances. -Unnamed Host of NNR Military zombies have better and more "realistic" looking gear along with correct grooming standards. This mod has most zombified soldiers being in some elements of MOPP (mission oriented protective posture), as well as making helmets and other protective gear standard, as opposed to them being somewhat uncommon or absent in vanilla. Equipment is based off of PZ's lore and equipment from the 90s and early 2000s. Included are a few new variants of zombies and a unique face texture for zombified troops - as they'd likely try to remove said elements of MOPP as a zombie and end up removing their face in the process. Weapons, canteens, and radios are now ubiquitous among zombified soldiers as of B42. The majority of soldiers deployed in and around the Exclusion Zone, especially those operating with a risk of contact with infected, would likely be in MOPP 3/4. Several radio transcripts also explicitly point to the usage of camouflage hazard suits by the military. Most zombified soldiers are depicted in the 'Mask Only' protective posture. All military zombies have a small chance of spawning with normal zombies after 2 weeks into the game otherwise they can be found on military installations. Some of the new items added by this mod also spawns in containers, especially so in military bases. This should not conflict with any clothing mods unless they adjust the army zombies themselves, and even then it is unlikely to cause game-breaking issues. New variants: Urban Camo Zombie: spawns with Woodland PPE and Urban pattern uniforms. Uncommon spawn, but spawns more inside bases than checkpoints. Spawns with pistols, M16s and M14s. Military Police Zombie (in Olive Drab): spawns with Police Vest or Olive Drab Vest. Has batons, pistols and shotguns. Somewhat uncommon spawn, spawns in all military locations Zombified Paratroopers: Zombified soldiers with airborne berets of various IRL PIRs. Similar equipment to the "Army Instructor" Zombie. Rotational QRF from Fort Bragg would likely be some of the first troops to come help secure Fort Knox and try to lock down the Exclusion Zone. Can be found more often inside bases rather than checkpoints/outposts. Military Survivor Zombie: Troops who survived the of the infection, but got infected later. Can spawn with any of the camouflages in-game, as well as mix-and matched camos. Wears military limb armor, helmets, green shemaghs, shell/bullet straps, SCBAs (sometimes just the tank, sometimes the full SCBA), vests, filterless gas masks, balaclavas (to keep infected blood from entering orifices), and even more stuff. A variant that spawns with good melee weapons (wood axe, spear with metal head, scrap swords, machetes, etc.) and one that has normal military firearms are possible. Overhauled Variants: Green Camo Zombie: Complete equipment and uniform overhaul to resemble what most soldiers would have looked like in and around the exclusion zone; male spawns only, often has M16s, pistols, and webbing gear. Most common spawn of them all. Desert Camo Zombie: Complete equipment and uniform overhaul; male spawns only. Probably guys that were overseas straight off the C-130 getting pulled back to help handle the Knox infection. Pretty rare spawn in outpost/checkpoint areas. Often has M16s, pistols, and webbing gear. Army 'Instructor' Zombie: Complete equipment overhaul to resemble garrison uniforms; some of the first infected or soldiers and officers in sterile environments. Male spawns only. In vanilla they would spawn in with DCU pants and white tank-tops. Can be found more often inside bases rather than checkpoints/outposts. Sometimes has pistols and webbing gear. Ghillie Suit Zombies: Wears gas masks under their hood, may spawn with ghillie pants or tucked woodland or tigerstripe pants. Spawns not limited anymore (was limited to 2 per military zone in vanilla), quite rarely found in checkpoint/outpost locations. Usually spawns with a gun case on their back with a bolt-action rifle. New Items: Military Balaclava: Based off of USGI Cold Weather RIF/CIF issued balaclavas from mid-90s to early 2000s. Because of the harsh nature of dealing with civilians during the Outbreak, identities of troops may need to be hidden, and it may not always be appropriate to be in MOPP. Spawns sometimes on MPs and Urban Zombies. Can be lowered or raised in 3 positions. Black and green variants. Military Gloves: Flyer/Nomex Gloves, comes in black and green variants, spawns on most zombies Jungle Boots: Lighter variant of the in-game military boot, rare spawn on all military zombies Underwear and socks: Olive/FG tinted undergarments, spawns all the time on all military zombies Military Gas Mask: currently just a re-texture of the in-game gas mask in vain of the IRL M40 and M17 (see: XM40) promasks. Much less debuffs on vision and comfortability, normal gas mask filters can be attached or detached. Spawns often on most zombies. Can't fall off the face. Removing the filter increases vision (harder to make the lenses fog up with airflow) and makes it more comfortable to wear. Comes in 3 variants: Green, Black, and Green with anti-sun lenses. Defensive stats same as vanilla. Accuracy with firearms also much better as opposed to the vanilla mask. Military Helmets: All PASGT helmets have better stats, no vision debuff, and can't fall off the head. Has 90% scratch and bite resistance and 15% bullet resistance - as most rifle caliber bullets will blow straight through a PASGT, but pistol caliber bullets are usually stopped, so this is the balance in lieu of no penetration system. Military Ponchos: Woodland textured ponchos with slightly better defensive stats than the vanilla poncho. Spawns in containers and military survivor zombies Tuckable Pants: Pants spawn in tucked into the boots on military zombies and can be tucked/untucked. Compatibility: Lillie's Militaria: If you use Realistic Army Zombies, some of the zombies I added will spawn in with stuff from Lillie's Militaria, particularly patrol caps, hot weather jackets and field jackets. If you don't use it - everything still spawns in as it would without Lillie's Militaria, with no stack errors occurring or items missing, and the items from my clothing table will load in instead. No resources were taken from the mod, and no alternate version is needed, but I recommend you use Realistic Army Zombies in conjunction with Lillie's Militaria for the best quality. KNOWN ISSUES: Do >--!NOT!--< use the vanilla filter removal context button when removing a filter from the military gas mask. It will give you the filter but delete the mask. Use the context button with the gas mask icon, not the filter icon. Working on finding a solution to this. Pants unequip themselves when you tuck them in or out of the boots. Same with modifying wear of the balaclava. Also working on a fix for this. There are a few items in the game that are a WIP and get uploaded with the mod anyways. They do not spawn in but you can access them with "All Clothing Available" in the sandbox settings or in debug mode. They very likely have issues. description: Dreams for the survivor Original concept and development by Nebula. Project Zomboid Build 42 / Single-player Dreams adds a persistent dream system built around the survivor's recent state and experiences. Features - 207 non-repeating dreams with illustrations. - Automatic semantic context selection based on the survivor's recent condition and experiences. - Normal pacing: 4 dream outcomes per 12 eligible in-game days (about 33.3%). - A dream may also be absent; the survivor can wake without remembering one. - Dream memories fade during the day and are fully forgotten by the next in-game day. - A remembered dream can be recalled from the survivor's context menu while the memory remains. - Separate nightmare behavior for true zombie-virus infection. - Addon and localization-addon support through documented public interfaces. Built-in languages English / Russian / Spanish Compatibility Requires Build 42.15 or newer. Network multiplayer is not supported. Local split-screen is experimental. description: Makes you able to repair any clothes you want, such as vests, bulletproof vests, jumpsuits, etc. Working for B42! Are you generous and thankful for the mod? Please consider to donate to animals in need! In 4 years and over 1.3 million concurrent subscribers, I have only earned 5 euros in that entire time from mods. It was a very rewarding 5 euros, I mean who the hell ever gets paid for their hobby? But that's exactly what it is, a hobby, and I would honestly feel better in my heart knowing that an animal gets to live a happy life instead of me having some pocket change for a coffee because of a zombie game, and my wife being a seamstress. Thank you CarlosRojasCu for updating the mod when I was busy Thank you everyone for almost half a decade of positive comments, happy moments and for being grateful. You all helped me stay focused and inspired to challenge myself and be a better person. Have you ever found a snazzy Jumpsuit, only to be forced to throw it out, because of ugly holes? And what of the lovely Santa Suits, for when you wanted to bring Christmas Joy to the Undead of Kentucky, only to have them crying like Snoopy from "The Peanuts" because all the Santa Suits were ruined. Have you ever wanted to express your inner fursona in an apocalypse, but alas, you had to make due with your human skin, because all Spiffo suits were fit for peasants? What about all the poor gopniks and lovely slavs who need to show off their perfect Adidas suit only to have some filthy rotter chomp in their lovely shell suit jacket or pants? And of course, your ultra cool survivors with mood swings had no way to express their darkness, and how unique they were without their fingerless gloves. What about your trusty boots or fancy leather shoes? Got a hole in them, and for some reason you can't slap some duct tape on it? That's also taken care of now, as you too can sit down, and master the art of becoming a cobbler, also known as a shoemaker! Fix those pesky holes with the corresponding material, and you can walk over all the puddles Kentucky has to offer, water or brains from the zombies you've stomped! Search no longer weary traveler, because gone are the days of throwing out clothes you, for some reason, couldn't fix! WASTE NOT WANT NOT with this mod, as it allows you to fix all clothing, so whether you're a hobo, furry, teenage flick vampire, military man with enough equipment to break your back, YOU TOO, can look your very best in the Apocalypse! This mod puts all the clothes you couldn't fix before, and makes them fixable. No limitations, no telling you "You can't fix broken shoes". Just this one mod that does everything, and it's completely vanilla friendly. FAQ Q: Does this work with my version, multiplayer, singleplayer? A: It works with Build 42 both multi and single. Q: How do I fix my clothes completely without having patches on them? A: Level your tailoring to at least 8! Q: I can't repair something A: Make sure you have needle, thread and ripped sheets, denim or leather strips. Q: I still can't repair it! A: Then another mod is breaking it for you. Enable only this mod to see if it works, then start enabling the other mods you use to find the broken mod. Q: Am I allowed to repack your mod, alter it in any way and upload it to the workshop? A: Only if you put it under a different name, artwork, and if you're running a server and need to alter it, privatize it. In your server settings turn off AntiCheatProtectionType21. Use link below if you're still having issues. If you're having trouble joining or starting your server that was running the old version, a B41 version can be found here, from before the mod was improved. description: The Antibodies mod enhances the vanilla zombification mechanic by introducing an antibodies curve inspired by real-life immune system responses. If the antibodies successfully counteract the infection, the character will experience a gradual recovery over time. How it Works As you get infected, the Knox Virus in your body spreads. Alongside, your body slowly mounts an immunological response. The antibodies output rate is tied to infection progression (peaks at 50% infection), your condition, wounds, infections and hygiene. Your job is to sustain all positive effects, and reduce all negative effects (see diagnose panel) - so that antibodies can overtake the infection and eradicate the virus. Playing as character with medical background actually makes sense now, since it allows you to diagnose yourself and others, and also provide significant bonuses while treating wounds. By default, sandbox settings are rather forgiving. The easiest way to tweak that is by changing "Base Antibodies Growth" property in General section. FAQ: Will this mod work if I install it after my character got infected? Yes, unless you are past certain point. Infection length is randomized, but it takes between 2-3 days to resolve (either way). I've been nursing my character back to health for several days now, and he hasn't died, but it still says he's bitten. Should it be taking this long? Most likely you are confusing a wound and the infection. Wound will stay with you for a while, even if you survive the virus - but it will eventually heal. Does this mod work in multiplayer mode? Yes, including local co-op. Susceptible Mod compatibility? Yes. Investigated by @The Animeville Horror. Thanks again. Does antibiotics pill found in the game help at all? In real life antibiotics don't do anything against viruses. It will help by healing bacterial infections, however it won't do anything against Knox Virus. How can I make sure this mod works? Create a character with medical background (with +2 First Aid) - this will add diagnose button in your health panel. This is also the best way to tailor sandbox settings to your needs. How can I make this mod harder or adjust the difficulty? The key setting is Base Antibodies Growth, which controls how quickly your character develops immunity. Here's what different values mean (assuming no other effects): 180 (default) - You overcome the infection at 40% progression. 140 - You overcome it at 66% progression. 138 - You overcome it at 70% progression. 135 - You die. The infection progresses faster than your body can fight it. Every in-game effect modifies this baseline. You can adjust difficulty by: Lowering Base Antibodies Growth to shrink your margin for error. Adding harsher penalties (e.g., from injuries, exhaustion, etc.). Combining both for a tougher experience. Personal note: I think the vanilla Knox Infection kind of sidesteps some (even core) mechanics in the game. For example: First Aid feels almost irrelevant without human enemies like bandits or raiders. Tailoring also doesn't offer enough incentive to grind it to meaningful levels. Hygiene/Washing completely meaningless, even though you can plumb your washing machine, after water gets shut off. Personally, I find managing the infection more engaging than just hiding in a base for a few days - especially in multiplayer. Don't worry, you will get cocky at some point, and you will get stranded without necessary supplies to survive the infection. It's just a matter of time. But hey, don't let me tell you how to play your game. Special Thanks: MrTerreII for providing ES (Spanish) translation. VVentos for providing TR (Turkish) translation. llerafel for providing RU (Russian) translation. Rookavite for providing DE (German) translation. geuks for providing FR (French) translation. Translations: I’m always happy to include more translations. You can contribute here - and if you don’t know how to use Git, just drop me a message: https://github.com/lonegamedev/pz_mod_antibodies Want to say thanks? If you enjoy the mod and want to support future updates, you can do so here: Buy Me a Coffee Known conflicts: zRe Vaccine ReMod by kERHUS - this mod packs older version of Antibodies, and will break the current version. If you want new features please ask author of that mod to update theirs. You shouldn't try to run both. The same goes for any other mod that includes previous version of Antibodies. Update Schedule: I have constrained myself to update only Tue-Thu. All potential problems with the update should be resolved in this time window. I do however reserve a right to fix critical issues ASAP (for example when game update breaks the mod). Workshop ID: 2392676812 Mod ID: lgd_antibodies

description: Overview : Adds marks to the icons of books and other media that have not been read or have only been read halfway. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 Stable and in MP. Vanilla marks the books you're done with. This mod highlights the books you still need. See what’s worth taking at a glance—without checking every title or carrying every unread book home. Built for faster, survival-focused looting. Works alongside the vanilla indicators in Build 42. Features : Books that have not been read will display the original icon with "?". This includes skill books that are no longer needed at the current level. Books that have been read only halfway will display the original icon with "!". Books that have been read completely will display the original icon only. You can add a personal mark to an item. For example, you can use it to track whether you already own that item. Marking can be performed from the context menu of the target item. Options : These options are available with Mod Options in B41. Target Items : Choose which item types should display marks. Skill Book, Recipe Magazine, Map, Flier, Brochure, Titled Literature, CD, VHS, Home VHS Show Marks : Choose which status marks should be displayed. "Not Read" mark (?) "Not Completed" mark (!) "Already Read" mark (v) Show "Current Target" mark (o) : Specify whether to show or hide this mark. Show "Self Marking" mark (/) : Specify whether to show or hide personal marks. Display a mark (pencil) on marked items Display a mark (eraser) on unmarked items Auto Marking : Automatically add a personal mark when an item is transferred to your inventory, including bags and other held containers. These options have been deprecated since v3.0. Show "Not Completed" mark as "Not Read" mark (! -> ?) : Can specify whether to change the display or not. Reverse Marking Display : Reverses the display of Self Marking (defaults to all books with Self Marking displayed). Share Flier Mark : Can specify whether to share the flier marks. Share Brochure Mark : Can specify whether to share the brochure marks. Share Titled Literature Mark : Can specify whether to share the titled literature marks. Share Self Marking : Can specify whether to share the self marking. Known Issues : In Build 42.20 MP, vanilla does not retain the read status of map items after reconnecting. As a result, maps may be displayed as unread after reconnecting. If this bothers you, disable "Map" under "Target Items" in the mod options. This does not affect map areas that have already been revealed. For CD/VHS/Home VHS, only the "Not Read" mark is currently displayed. The "Not Completed" mark is not available, so partially viewed media is treated as unread. Future plans : Bug fixes (if needed) Remarks : Modded books should also work as long as they follow the vanilla book implementation. In Build 42, the read status of maps, fliers, brochures, and titled literature is determined from the vanilla per-character reading history. Items read before enabling this mod can therefore be recognized. In Build 41, maps, fliers, brochures, and titled literature must still be read after enabling this mod before they can be recognized as read. Read status is managed separately for each character. In the case of maps, revealed map areas may be shared between characters in the same world, but whether the map item itself has been read remains character-specific. description: Overview : Extend the existing occupation "Burglar" to "Thief". In addition to the existing features, new skill and abilities will be added. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 Stable, Single-Play only. Features : Add a new ability "Stealth". Add a new ability "Stealing". "Stealth" and "Stealing" can be leveled up as skills. "Stealth" and "Stealing" skill books (Vol. 1-5) will be added. New Ability - Stealth : You will be able to move while remaining hidden. It can be executed from a dedicated icon or context menu. To hidden, you need to break the line of sight from zombies or maintain a certain distance. There is a limit to how long you can stay hidden, which is affected by your skill level, traits, and actions. There is a usage delay (10 seconds, regardless of game speed), and it cannot be used continuously. As your skill level increases, it becomes easier to hide, the duration of effectiveness is extended, and the delay time is reduced. At higher levels (Lv. 8 and above), you may be able to attack while remaining hidden. New Ability - Stealing : You will be able to steal items from zombies. It can be executed from a dedicated icon or context menu. Various types of items can be stolen, but items above a certain weight cannot be taken. To perform stealing, you need to stand very close to the zombie. It is not guaranteed that you will steal every time; there may be cases where the zombie has no items, or you might fail or fumble (a major failure). The types and probabilities of items that can be stolen are influenced by traits and location. There is a usage delay (10 seconds, regardless of game speed), and it cannot be used continuously. As your skill level increases, the range of stealable targets expands, the success rate increases, the fumble rate decreases, and the delay time is reduced. Traits that affect new abilities : Graceful : Increases stealth duration (large). Clumsy : Decreases stealth duration (large). Inconspicuous : Increases stealth duration (small) and makes it easier to hide. Conspicuous : Decreases stealth duration (small) and makes it harder to hide. Dexterous : Increases success rate of stealing, decreases fumble rate, and increases maximum weight that can be stolen. All Thumbs : Decreases success rate of stealing, increases fumble rate, and decreases maximum weight that can be stolen. Eagle Eyed : Increases the probability that zombies have items and the chance to steal useful items. Short Sighted : Decreases the probability that zombies have items and the chance to steal useful items. Skills that affect new abilities : Lightfooted : Increases stealth duration with each level up. Sneaking : Increases stealth duration with each level up. Options : These options are available with Mod Options in B41. Show stealth button : A button to toggle stealth mode will be shown on the screen. Show stealth menu : A "Hide" command will be shown in the context menu. Show stealing button : A button to attempt stealing will be shown on the screen. Show stealing menu : A "Steal" command will be shown in the context menu. Sound Volume (Stealth On) : You can adjust the sound volume when stealth is on. Sound Volume (Stealth Off) : You can adjust the sound volume when stealth is off. Sound Volume (Stealing Success) : You can adjust the sound volume when stealing succeeds. Sound Volume (Stealing Fumble) : You can adjust the sound volume when stealing is fumbled. Transparency during stealth : You can change the character's transparency when stealth is active. Sandbox Options : These options are available in Sandbox Options. description: Brings spear traps to the game. How to build a spear trap? First you have to dig a grave. Then you need one or more spear in your inventory (up to 5 spears per grave). Finally, simply right-click the grave and you'll see a menu option: Add Spear to Grave Once a spear has been added to the trap, it can also be retrieved with the menu option: Remove Spear from Grave Beware, spear traps are dangerous! It's a double-edged sword. While it can kill zombies quite efficiently, you will also die if you walk on the trap!!! Features When zombies walk over a grave with no spear, they'll get knocked down. When zombies walk over a grave with at least one non-broken spear, they'll get killed instantly, breaking one spear. When players run over a grave with no spear, they will get injured (foot or lower leg). When players walk over a grave with at least one non-broken spear, they will get killed instantly too. If you don't want to risk dying by walking over a spear trap, you can disable this behavior in Sandbox settings. In that case the players won't die, but will receive as many injuries as there are spears in the grave: Sandbox settings -> Sadistic AI Director -> Spear Traps Kill Players Version Latest version: 0.0.9 Can I use this mod in a modpack? description: DOESNT WORK WITH VERSIONS ABOVE 42.15+. This mod is intended for players who are confused about what effects each trait and profession has on the character. It adds description to the traits that need it to describe their effects on the character in detail, instead of leaving people guessing with vague sentences. This way, players can have an easier time imagining their own builds by themselves. It also adds the description on mouse hover in the character's info screen, in game. This works with descriptions of traits from other mods too, like Banjo's item kits or Dynamic traits for example. This is based on a combination of my own knowledge, the game's non-exposed Java files (that I learned how to decompile), the game's exposed Lua files, your feedback, and the wiki of PZ. Most of what I added in the traits' descriptions are in parenthesis so you can distinguish what is vanilla description and what is not. If you notice a typo, or know of an effect that is not listed, or spot something that is wrong or poorly worded, please leave a comment to point it out to me. I don't think I got every single effect that could be listed, and I may have made a mistake somewhere, so I'm relying on you guys for that. Compatibility Works with build 41, in multiplayer b41. DOESNT WORK with 42.15+. It should be compatible with any mod that adds traits or skills. Translations B41 translations are CLOSED. B42 translations are open , but be advised that it risks becoming obsolete soon as B42 gets more matches, and I will most likely take a couple weeks to add the translation. Anyone is welcome to volunteer to translate to their language. Foraging stats: The mod details the foraging stats bonuses for each trait and profession. Stats are : Foraging radius bonus, Weather Effect reduction, and Darkness Effect reduction and also Specialisation bonuses for every foraging category. All foraging stats are added dynamically, which means any balance changes will be automatically updated, and other traits that get foraging stats in their descriptions (if they have foraging stats). Source file: media/lua/shared/Foraging/forageDefinitions.lua Character Info Screen Tooltip: The mod displays the detailed description of each trait in the character's info screen window on mouse hover. Works for professions too (except Unemployed since it doesn't have an image). Works with traits of other mods too! Although their descriptions probably won't be as detailed. Dynamic Free recipes Free recipes have been dynamically added to each trait and profession description, which means any future free recipe changes in vanilla will automatically show up on this mod, without needing to update the mod. Modded traits will also have their free recipes added to their description, just like the foraging stats. And modded recipes will also dynamically show up if they are given for free to a trait or profession. As of 42.8 I limited the number of recipes that can show up on one trait. Mod Options There are now 3 mod options : Show more description Show Free Recipes Show Foraging Stats So you can now disable the things you don't want to see. Give your feedback I've tried to be as exhaustive as possible, but I'm sure I've made some mistakes or interpreted things wrongly here and there. Please tell me in the feedback & bug reports discussions , or just leave a comment. Workshop ID: 2685168362 Mod ID (b41): MoreDescriptionForTraits4166 Mod ID (b42): MoreDescriptionForTraits42

description: Craft Spare Engine Parts yourself! This mod adds the magazine "The Machinist". Find it and read it! This adds three different recipes for making spare engine parts. Alternatively, you can unlock them by reaching a certain level in each required skill without ever reading the magazine (B42+ only). Needs metal working skill and more metal parts Needs mechanics skill and some additional uncommon parts Needs electronics skill and additional electronic parts It can be used for single player but the true reason I created this is multiplayer. Because often vehicles of entire towns are stripped of their engines to get these juicy spare parts, and this mod is meant to help with exactly this issue. Version and language support This mod is compatible with B41 & B42 MP (B42.13.0+). It is safe to add or remove in existing games. In version 1.4 English, German, Russian, French, Spanish (ES and AR), Traditional Chinese, Hungarian, Italian, Dutch, Polish, and Portuguese (PTBR) are supported, but on player requests and with a little help I will definitely add more. Future of the mod As B42 progresses, crafting is expected to get a great revamp, and a lot more recipes and items will be added. In response to this, the recipes in this mod will likely be changed in the future to better match B42's new crafting system. Reuploading and modpacks For server owners it can be very useful to have their own modpack. That's why I allow reuploads of my mod as part of a modpack for a server if credit is given and if the modpack is unlisted on steam and only shared with the server members. Under all other circumstances please abstain from reoploads. Important: balancing settings When installing the mod, it comes as four separate ones named "expensive - original", "moderate", "cheap", and "cheapest". These four mods all do basically the same, but the cost, results, and requirements of the crafting recipes are hugely different as can be seen in the images above. This allows you to choose a difficulty, how much impact you want this mod to have on your gameplay, and how much you would like to spare those poor car engines from looting. Only choose and activate one of the four mods. If more are activated, it won't break the game, but it will cause a recipe redundancy. I chose to implement difficulty / balancing settings this way and not via actual options within a single mod in order to prevent the need to add the ModOptions mod as a dependency. I have done this to avoid breaking people's save games and servers which already used the CEP mod before Version 1.2 and haven't got the ModOptions mod. description: Update 7/29/2026 Updated with new features for B42 Stable. Should be compatible with all future B42 updates. You can now set up to 30 days per month per season (previously capped at 15). Setting it to 0 in a season sets it to vanilla same as before. Skipping now uses each month's true length (28-31 days, leap years included) instead of a fixed average, so months stay accurate all year round. As before: set a season to 0 for normal-length months, or set all seasons to 0 to disable the mod without unsubscribing. Save game compatible, safe to add/remove mid-save (you may need to run your game with -debug mode to update your sandbox variables on an existing save else they will default to 10). Update 12/11/2025 Updated for B42 Multiplayer (Should work with future B42 MP Updates) Mod Summary: Experience a multi-year/season playthrough without having to put in hundreds of hours or have incredibly short days to do so. Always have something to prepare for eg. cold and scarce winters, hot and dry summers. This mod allows the player (or host of a world) to set the max amount of days in a month. Min 1 to Max 30 (set to 0 to disable for that season). Based on the value set, the mod will dynamically simulate a shorter in-game month. NEW 11/8/2024: You can now change month lengths per season (Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter). So you can have shorter spring months, and longer winter months for example. You can also now disable whole seasons or all seasons without having to unsub from the mod. Should be compatible with all mods. Example: 10-day months create a 2 day skip. At every end of the day, 2 days will be skipped. See time-lapse video and pay attention to clock which simulates roughly 7-day months Time-lapse of Seasons: How does this affect water/electric shut-off, farming, erosion, days survived, etc.? Time-based sandbox settings (zombie/loot respawns included) will only progress when time progresses normally through gameplay and or sleeping (also sped-up time in singleplayer). Example: Lets say your world starts on 7/9/1993 (MM/DD/YYYY) and you set water/electric to shut-off on day 10. If you set this mod with 10-day months. Your water/electricity will NOT shut-off on 7/19/1993. Instead it will shut-off around 8/13/1993, almost a month later because you've only played 10 in-game days but simulated a month of time passing. More Info and recommendations: If playing with 10-day (or less) months, set vanilla hours per day to 2+ so you have more time per day for tasks. Generally, players may want to increase farming speeds and yields if playing with 10-day (or less) months. Compatibility: Tested w/ B41/B42, can be added/removed from an existing save. (Likely works w/ B40). Multiplayer and dedicated server compatible. Shouldn't conflict with any other mods. Future plans: Additional settings to allow specific seasons or quarters of the year to be longer (such as winter). If possible, develop settings to automatically scale farming speeds, erosion etc. Known issues: Because day-skips are spread randomly, individual months may land a day or two above or below your target (they average out to your setting over time). Credits: Inspired from Initial mod: nigel A faster months mod Workshop ID: 2753086629 Mod ID: survivingthroughseasons

description: The vanilla game added automatic item return behavior in Build 42.8.0. However, some actions are still not covered by the vanilla implementation, including certain firearm operations and restoring items to their original placement on the ground. Tidy Up Meister complements the vanilla behavior and is designed to work alongside it rather than disable or replace it. Overview : Automatically restores your equipment and returns temporarily moved items after an action is completed. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 Stable and in MP. Features : After an action temporarily changes your equipment, the items in your hands and worn equipment are restored to their previous state. Items temporarily moved out of a bag or other container are returned to their original container. Items taken from the ground are returned to their original square, position, and rotation. Replacement items, such as food left after opening or partially consuming an item, can also be returned to the original location. You can toggle automatic re-equipping from the context menu. This setting is stored separately for each character, making it useful when you want to perform several actions continuously without restoring your equipment each time. For a visual demonstration, please check the introduction video above. Build 42 V2 : The Build 42.20 implementation has been completely redesigned. Instead of individually modifying every supported action, V2 observes the Timed Action queue and identifies sequences in which equipment or items are temporarily moved for another operation. This allows V2 to support a much wider range of vanilla and modded actions without requiring a separate patch for every action. Explicit player actions, such as manually equipping, unequipping, or placing an item, are distinguished from temporary equipment changes and are not automatically reverted. Because actions from other mods may use unusual queue behavior, compatibility with every modded action cannot be guaranteed. Please report any action that is not detected correctly. Options : Build 42 options are available from the built-in Mod Options screen. Build 41 uses Mod Options, and the available legacy options may differ. Show Re-Equip Toggle in Context Menu : Adds an option to the context menu that enables or disables automatic re-equipping after actions. Re-Equip Held Items After Interruptions : By default, interrupted actions do not restore your equipment. Enable this option to restore only the items that were in your hands before the interrupted action. Return Materials from Dismantling : Returns materials obtained by dismantling an item to the container the dismantled item came from. Diagnostic Output : Outputs troubleshooting information to the game log. Detailed logging may affect performance, so enable it only while reproducing an issue. Compatibility : V2 is designed to work alongside the automatic return behavior included in the vanilla game. Because V2 observes general Timed Action sequences instead of modifying individual actions, many modded actions can work without dedicated compatibility code. Inventory placement information is preserved where the current game APIs provide it. Compatibility with unusual or custom Timed Actions cannot be guaranteed. Please report any action that does not restore correctly or is reverted when it should not be. For Modders : Most Timed Actions do not require any special integration with Tidy Up Meister. However, compatibility registration may be necessary if your action intentionally changes equipment, clothing, or an item's container as its final result. Without registration, Tidy Up Meister may interpret those changes as temporary preparation and restore the previous state. Please consider implementing the compatibility enhancements based on the For Modders: Compatibility API thread. Known Issues : No known critical issues. Some modded actions may use queue or cancellation behavior that V2 cannot identify correctly. If you encounter a problem, please report it in Bug & Issue Reports. Use the character context menu to disable re-equipping, reproduce the problem again, and state whether this changes the behavior. If the issue occurs only when this mod is enabled, please follow the steps below to gather and report detailed information. Enable "Diagnostic Output" and select "Log only" or "Log + overhead text." Reproduce the problem. Open the "console.txt" file in your Zomboid user folder. Include the lines containing "[P4TidyUpMeister]" in your report. description: This mod will add several vehicles to the game. The vehicles are vanilla-styled (including lore-friendly names, or optional real names), era appropriate (1993 and earlier), and support all the features of vanilla vehicles. The pack will be a variety pack, aiming to add a little bit of everything to the game from everyday sedans, vans and SUVs to sports cars, with sports cars being much more rare than everyday machines. For higher resolution textures, check the separate mod here. All cars that are capable of it also support Paint Your Ride in B41, or HDCP Immersive Vehicle Paint in B42! If you were using my existing standalone vehicle mods, it is safe (and best) to switch to this mod. This mod contains the following vehicle mods of mine: Lancia Stratos, R32 Skyline, Supra, Fox Body, Kei Sports, LM002, 240SX Coupe, Diablo, 300ZX, GT40, Miata, Toyota X90s, and Reliant Robin Mk. II. Disable these mods and use this instead if you plan on using this mod, as they can cause issues when used together. You can choose which cars you would like to spawn naturally, from 3 selections of car lists If you want all cars to spawn, you don't need to enable the optional Spawn Selection sub-mods To choose which types of cars you'd like to have spawn, enable the Spawn Selection sub-mods of the cars you would like to allow to spawn in addition to the main mod. There are 3 lists to choose from, and you can select any combination of them: US Motors: This list contains cars that were available and sold in the US. Examples include the Bronco, Mustang, and 240SX. Imports: This list contains cars that were not available and sold in the US, but common in other countries. Examples are the R32 Skyline, Toyota Mark II, and Reliant Robin Rares and Exotics: This list contains cars that are either very expensive or produced in very low numbers. Examples are the GT40, Diablo, and Stratos. Also note that the imports and exotics are both very rare in the base spawn lists, and the Spawn Selection sub-mods will not make them more common. Additionally, the mod has been translated to German thanks to Eaglefire. Check out their German Project Zomboid community here! This mod pairs well with Vehicle Spawn Zones Expanded. (B42 Update pending) Since the exotic and import cars are very rare, I started work on the spawn zones to give some specified areas for these cars to spawn, so there is a decent chance to find them on a save without it potentially becoming overwhelming. It eventually became more, adding a variety of new spawn areas beyond that. It works very well with this mod, and has many spawn lists for cars in this pack. Also check out these complimentary MZ-themed mods! FAQ Q: Multiplayer compatible? A: Yes! In general, all of my (and many of others') vehicles will be MP compatible unless stated otherwise. Q: Can this be used with other vehicle mods? A: Yes! It will work with other vehicle packs, and standalone vehicle mods. This mod was even made with use alongside mods like Filibuster Rhymes' Used Cars in mind, and has its spawn chances based around it. It doesn't alter anything vanilla either, so anything that changes vanilla vehicles will also work! Q: What are the vehicle IDs? A: I've set up a post in the discussions with each vehicle ID and some small information about each car, check it out if you need the IDs. Q: How rare are the exotic/import cars? A: They are very rare, exotics in particular will be difficult to find on default (low) and normal car spawn rates. Exotics and imports will mostly only spawn near high-end houses, or anywhere else you can find the Cossette and Lang 4000 in vanilla, at a lower spawn rate. Some Easter Egg cars will spawn in similar areas to the Easter Egg cars from Used Cars. For some more specific hints, Riverside has a very large amount of possible spawn zones, and the bar across from the junkyard contains only sports car spawns, so that is the best place to look. Q: Can this be added mid-save? A: Yes! Vehicles will only spawn in areas you have not explored yet however, so if you or your server have been all over the map, you may have trouble finding the vehicles. I'd recommend using Udderly Vehicle Respawn if you want to use this on an existing save, it will allow new vehicles to spawn in explored areas the world. Q: I'm having issues joining/starting a server in MP (File mismatch, or connection lost after starting) A: First, check AuthenticPeach's guide about these issues here. For more info, check the first post of the "Bug reports" thread in discussions. Q: Can you make (x)? A: If you're going to request a car, note that my main focus at the moment are cars that fit the game's time period (1993 and earlier). I do have cars outside of this timeframe on my list, but it may be a while before I get to them. I also already have quite a few on my list, so there's no guarantee I'll get to all of them. Q: What about animations? A: Animations are planned to officially come to vanilla vehicles, so they are planned for this pack as well. While I will redo some cars before TIS' animations are officially available, they will be released as separate mods for the time being with options to replace the ones in the pack, due to some features not working with animated parts. I'm still going to add vehicles in the current vanilla style to the pack, better set up for the upcoming animations. description: Mod is MIT licensed. No further support will be provided. Old Description: NOTE: Panic seems to be disabled or bugged in B42 MP, so the mod doesn't actually do anything in MP right now. Adrenaline is a mod that adds a new mechanic to the panic and fatigue (tiredness) systems in Project Zomboid in a way that feels realistic. Now With Sandbox Options! (only in b42) Adrenaline Boost Speed - How fast panic wakes you up. Adrenaline Crash Speed - How fast drowsiness returns once you calm down. Adrenaline Crash Multiplier - How much extra drowsiness is given to the player when they calm down. What Does It Do? Adrenaline makes the Panic moodle temporarily reduce your character's fatigue, proportional to how panicked your character is. This simulates an adrenaline rush, waking the character up and reducing (or even removing) the Tired moodle, allowing the character to perform and fight at a higher level. This provides a final burst of performance out of the character before they truly require sleep, potentially allowing you to escape dire situations or secure an impromptu safehouse. Why? In vanilla, when the 'Drowsy' moodle appears, the character receives a whopping 50% damage debuff, increasing to 80 / 90 / 95% as the character becomes more tired. (Vision and endurance are also reduced) Because this debuff is so large and it is applied instantaneously upon hitting 60% fatigue with no prior warning, I felt that it would be more balanced to allow the moodle to be temporarily reduced under stressful circumstances. However, there are limits and drawbacks: After calming down, all the fatigue that the adrenaline took away (and then some), will sweep over your character, making them more tired than they were before. Only so much fatigue can be countered by adrenaline. A ridiculously tired character will still keep their Tired moodle, even if at the max panic level. Sleep is still a necessity. Adrenaline does not change how tired your character actually is, it only disguises it up to a point. If you go into a long, grueling fight, you might not realize you are tired until its over and calm down. description: Introduction Please be aware this mod is for myself and a friend and uploaded to steam as a backup This mod adds 231 American Vehicles to Project Zombiod. The mod focuses on vehicles that would have been seen on US roads in 1993. The mod focuses not just on cars but transport vehicles, emergency service vehicles and utility vehicles, to make the world feel believable. All vehicles in this mod are american vehicles only. The mod currently spans 2 decades, the 1990's and 1980's. Later updates will go back further in time. Each major update will be classed as a wave. There will be smaller updates for patch fixes and smaller car packs. The mod is currently designed to fit with the game art style and does not have opening car doors like other mods to keep the mod stable when game updates release (this is due to Indie Stone changing the engine constantly). Each vehicle will be updated down the road to have opening car parts when the official release is announced. The code currently is old code that will be updated in future updates as Indie Stone isn't happy with current vehicle mechanics. Wave 1, Late 1980's - Early 1990s (15/05/22); Sedans Small Box trucks Police Cars Muscle Cars Coupes SUVs Wave 2, 90's expansion more late 80's cars (21/09/2022); Vans Ambulances Fire Engines Large Box Trucks Fire Support Vehicles Buses Station Wagons Wave 3 late 1970's - 1980's (Next Major Update) Important If You Own A MP Server I have been having issues joining/starting a server with the mod This is a known issue with steam Workshop when a mod updates, the mod itself is fine. Usually deleting and redownloading the mod will fix the issues. You may have to delete files manually. If you are having issues, AuthenticPeach has a walk through guide on issues and how to fix them. You can find them on the Indie Stone Forums here[theindiestone.com] This issue with the steam workshop effects all mods from the steam work shop especially when a mod updates. https://theindiestone.com/forums/index.php?/topic/42925-how-to-fix-updated-mods-in-build-41-multiplayer/ Please be aware I do not help with support on how to install the mod onto MP servers Or how to fix the mods on servers if they stop working. This is due to how massively different mod installation is for servers and how steam updates mods. FAQs 1. Important Big Vehicle Issues Buses, Fire Engines, Truck Ambulances and Trucks have multiple issues that we have done our best to fix or lower. This is due to game engine currently does not support big vehicles as many of these vehicles are larger than editor space. Issue bellow that we are hoping the engine is updated to support; - Towing vehicles/towing each other - Pulling trailers - Mechanic menu closes when opening engine bay (this is seen on other large vehicle mods) - Vehicle cabs being to high to break windows - Weight above 600 will cause suspension to drop on large trucks 2. Why did you choose this art style and why do doors, trunk and hoods do not open? I choose this art style as it fits the games art style while being more detailed. Car parts not opening is a design decision as the code being used is experimental and hidden in the files. Indie Stone has decided that they will be changing this in the future and I don't want the mod to break every time there is official update by the devs. The cars will be updated to feature opening parts when the official update from Indie Stone releases 3. Will you be doing other manufacturers that are not American? When I released this mod there where not many American cars, most modders where making European and Asian more than US cars so I have focused on American cars as this was towards the end of the height of American cars. All my free content will US cars or US branded cars only. 4. Do you do commissions? I do commissions which are not limited to US car manufacturers or era. See my contact details further down the mod page if you want to get in contact. 5. Do you plan on making motorbikes and trailers? I don't plan on making motorbikes and other mod makers are already making them - bike physics have not yet been implemented into the game engine. I will only be doing tractor trailers for big rigs, no small trailers as Filibuster Rhymes has done this as made custom code for them. 6. Do I need other mods to play this mod? You do not need any other mods to play this mod. The mod only uses vanilla code to run and has no dependant mods. However I do recommend other mods with this mod to improve your experience and get the feel for this era. 7. What does the mod actually do? The mod does not "replace" vanilla cars - this causes a lot of problems if the mod actually replaced vanilla cars. The mod adds 220 cars to a spawn list that game engine will choose by rolling a "chance". Cars spawning is very random with a spawn chance between 1% - 15% with the game choosing a vehicle skin. As this mod adds a lot of cars it balances out other mods due to large number of cars in this mod which will make rare cars rarer and not turn the streets in to a car show - mod users have reported that this mod does a good job of balancing cars and balancing other car packs from other modders. 8. How will future Updates work? Updates will have major and small updates with patch fixing updates between. Each major update will be classed as a wave and will also target a certain decade. The next major update will be wave 3 focusing on the 1980's and late 70's. These updates take longer due to amount of effort and work done to make as many vehicles as I can - I am a single developer so major updates will take a few months between releases. Small updates are for cars that didn't make it into a wave or I came up with the car after full production (I plan what cars go into what update to manage my time efficiently). Finally small patch updates are mod fixes where bugs are found or if the game updates and causes errors or at worse case scenario game crashes - these are quite frequent Recommended Mods (Not needed to play); 1995/1996 Chevrolet Caprice Impala (Updated: 23/10/2022) https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2709006393 Filibuster Rhythms Used Cars; https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1510950729&searchtext=used+cars fhqwhgads Car Pack; https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2791656602&searchtext= Authentic Peaches Zombie Variety Pack; https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2335368829&searchtext=authentic Sharks Clothing Pack; https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2684285534 Shark and Peaches Improved Military Zombies; https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2530389024 Clothing Box; https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2507488373 Authentic Era Police Uniforms (Swat); https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2616752828 Special Thanks to fhqwhgads (who made the preview image and helped with some of the backend scripting) and Filibuster Rhymes (general Tips and tricks) for helping make the mod. description: Compatible with version 41.76 (solo & multiplayer). This mod lets you customize how many zombies of each type (crawler, sprinter, smart, tough, etc.) appear in your game. Inspired by Customizable Zombies. Please make sure you've read the FAQ below before commenting if you have any issues. Features easily customize how many Crawlers, Shamblers, Fast Shamblers or Sprinters appear in the world easily customize how many Smart zombies, which can open doors, appear in the world easily customize how many Tough and Fragile zombies appear in the world more consistent and less CPU-intensive approach than other mods, with customizable update rate How to customize spawn rates and update rate go to the Random Zombies page during Sandbox creation (make sure the mod is enabled at the main menu for the Random Zombies sandbox tab to appear) or edit your (servername)_SandboxVars.lua file note that Crawler%, Shambler%, FastShambler% and Sprinter% must add up to 100% note that Fragile%, NormalTough% and Tough% must add up to 100% speed defaults to 2% crawlers, 15% shamblers, 78% fast shamblers, 5% sprinters toughness defaults to 100% normal, 0% fragile, 0% tough cognition defaults to 0% smart you can disable the check in the sandbox settings if you know what you're doing/can't be bothered configuring the mod Frequently Asked Questions & Troubleshooting Can you use it in an existing save? You can safely enable/disable this mod in an existing save. How does using Random Zombies compare to the sandbox settings available in B42? With 42.20.0, this mod is retired. This mod was indispensable for me and many in B41, but the value added in B42 is small, and I cannot justify the time spent working on it any longer. I'm getting a lot of red box errors This is most likely due to a misconfiguration. Please make sure you read the How to customize spawn rates and update rate section above. If you're still having issues, check the actual error messages in your console.txt file or comment below with a link to your console.txt file (it can be found at C:\Users\(yourname)\Zomboid\console.txt, or ~/Zomboid/console.txt on macOS and Linux). I am not seeing the exact number of sprinters I configured There is a random component to the algorithm, but the probability distribution has been tested to be accurately represented (in the limits of what computers can do, i.e. pseudo-randomness). If you notice a consistent large disparity, please check for conflicts with other mods. If you're still having issues, please run `BLTRandomZombies.fullCheck()` in your Lua console in Debug mode and comment below with a link to the 5 generated files (placed in C:\Users\(yourname)\Zomboid\Lua, or ~/Zomboid/Lua on macOS and Linux). Do I need to set Zombie Lore Speed to Random? No, the mod will overwrite zombie speed regardless of that setting. What is the Frequency parameter? Because of how the game works (modability, zombie recycling, etc.), Random Zombies has to check at regular intervals if the zombies are properly configured. Frequency allows you to choose how often RZ should do the check. In practice, the default setting (7500) works really well and you should not have to worry about it. Can you allow the customization of strength, sight, memory as well? Unfortunately, there's no way to do that that I know of today. Is this mod compatible with Night Sprinters? Yes, thanks to TheIlluminati! Enjoy! Workshop ID: 2818577583 Mod ID: BLTRandomZombies

description: Overview : Expand the existing "Perfume" and "Cologne". Confirmed to work with Build 41.78. Features : Perfumes and colognes will be available (drainable) items. To use it, select "Apply perfume/cologne to the skin" from the item's context menu. Perfume can be used 10 times when full. Cologne can be used 20 times when full. Perfume or cologne reduces Stress and Unhappy moodles through fragrance. Every minute in the game, Stress and Unhappy moodles are reduced by -0.1 and the effect lasts until the fragrance is gone. The duration of effect is up to 8 hours (480 minutes) for perfumes and up to 2 hours (120 minutes) for colognes. Duration of effect is affected by below. If the body is wet, the duration will decrease depending on the degree of wetness. description: Water Goes Bad This mod makes the water still stored in sinks, baths, etc after the water shutoff become unsafe to drink after a customisable amount of time. Off-grid water containers, such as water dispensers, stored water containers, and player plumbed sinks are not affected. This aims to make keeping track of water more engaging. In Vanilla, stored-up water leaves a near infinite supply of easy safe water even after the water shutoff, making keeping up with thirst trivial. Water Drain This mod also features water draining from the taps over time to add further urgency to securing a water source. Filters This also introduces the need to filter plumbed taps. You'll need to additionally craft and install a filter after plumbing a tap, unless the source has safe water (not rain). Customisability Sandbox variables allow you to customise how many days after the water shutoff the water becomes tainted (including instantly). The filtering and water drain features can be turned off entirely, and the rate of drain can be changed. Makes it easy to add moodles for modders. Moodle Framework Configuration If you want colors to be easier to distinguish, you can set to white the reference color for moodles. How to create a new moodle If you wanna create a Moodle * then follow the next steps, replacing * by your moodle name. 1/ Moodle Texture Add Moodle *.png under media\ui. Should be 30 by 30 pixels png with alpha enabled. 2/ Texture Add the following text under media\lua\shared\Translate\EN Moodles_EN { Moodles_*_Good_lvl1 = "text_1", Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl1 = "text_desc_1", Moodles_*_Good_lvl2 = "text_2", Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl2 = "text_desc_2", Moodles_*_Good_lvl3 = "text_3", Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl3 = "text_desc_3", Moodles_*_Good_lvl4 = "text_4", Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl4 = "text_desc_4", Moodles_*_Bad_lvl1 = "text_1", Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl1 = "text_desc_1", Moodles_*_Bad_lvl2 = "text_2", Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl2 = "text_desc_2", Moodles_*_Bad_lvl3 = "text_3", Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl3 = "text_desc_3", Moodles_*_Bad_lvl4 = "text_4", Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl4 = "text_desc_4", } You can implement only a subset of this as long as you call only the implemented part. 3/ Moodle object creation Add these lines in your mod: require "MF_ISMoodle" MF.createMoodle(*); 4/ Moodle value updates Access your moodle from your code with require "MF_ISMoodle" MF.getMoodle(*,playerNum):setValue(myNewMoodleValue)--float 0.0 <= myNewMoodleValue <=1.0 Missing playerNum will make the mod incompatible with SplitScreen. description: ✅ The mod is working fine on B42.20 (public stable release) ✅ A minimalistic wounds display without the need to open the health panel. Can be disappeared when no wound need to be treated. Updated for Build 42 The add-on has been updated for Build 42 while a separate version for Build 41 remains untouched and fully compatible, thanks to a new files structure system where each version of the mod is only visible by its respective game build, ensuring seamless functionality for players on both versions. Only for B42, It now includes a new muscle strain indicator for each body part. The indicator evolves by becoming less transparent and changes color from orange to red as muscle strain worsens. If auto-hide is enabled, the silhouette is revealed with a brief blinking effect when a strain threshold is reached. This feature can be toggled off if not needed. What does it do? It give a permanent overview of your character's wounds on a minimalistic display. The body silhouette disappear when there are nothing to treat and appear when there is a wound. When a body part is flashing red, there is a wound that needs to be treated. When it's white, the wound is either bandaged or splinted. When it's orange, the bandage is dirty and needs to be replaced. If the wound is bandaged but it's still flashing that means you didn't fully treated the wound (glass still lodged, deep wound needs to be stitched, etc...) How to use it? Right clicking on the component will bring a contextual menu with all wounds and the settings of the addon. Left clicking just brings up the classic health panel of the base game. You also can drag it around and place it where you desire. Optional mod Mod Options is optional and adds an option to disable my mod (mainly for public servers) Compatibility This mod should work with any other mod (no incompatibility has been reported so far) This mod works in single and multi-player. (such as Neat UI Framework) If this happens, disable any mod that alters the game's user interface, close the update notice (it will not appear again), and then you can re-enable the mod that was causing it. description: THIS MOD IS NOT YET AVAILABLE FOR 42.13.x Philosophy behind this mod The first iteration of this mod I Don't Need A Lighter missed the balance I was aiming at when writing it. It made the Smoker trait even more a freebie point than it should. With this version I want to keep the vanilla's lighters as the best option to light a cigarette, but also provide the player with more risky and/or scarce alternate options . DISCLAIMER : You can submit bug reports (here <3) Changelog : https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails//changelog/2883633728/ Car lighter overhaul : Car lighters are no longer guaranteed to be found in every car. The car lighter socket can be empty or even in need of repair before becoming usable. Car lighter is now an object that can be carried by players, removed from cars containing one or installed in cars in need of one. The time it takes to warm up a car lighter is now directly tied to the car battery durability and charge level. Stove smoking overhaul : Lighting a cigarette on a stove top now comes with a risk. If you accumulate too much malus(possible malus are currently coming from : Fatigue/Pain/Panic/Drunkeness/Hand Injuries) you risk having an accident when doing so. The time it take to light up a cigarette on a stove top is now directly tied to multiple current stat of your survivor ( Panic / Pain / Fatigue / Drunkenness / Hand injuries ) Mod Compatibility Smoker : https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2026976958 Green Fire: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1703604612 More Smokes : https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2923439994 (not yet thoroughly tested) Planned to be added Add more possible outcome when failing to light a cigarette on stoves Add the risk of breaking the car lighter and/or the car lighter socket when using it with a low durability/charge level car battery Add a 3d model to the car lighter Update translation strings (to all supported language in the v1) Want to help translate this mod ? Join here : https://crowdin.com/project/i-might-need-a-lighter Github My other mods: I Don't Need A Lighter : https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2714198296 Fasten You SeatBelt : https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2722218474 Workshop ID: 2883633728 Mod ID: IMightNeedALighter

description: Overview : Add new sneakers (Pump Pury) and related items (backpacks and fanny packs). Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 Stable and in MP. Features : Pump Pury It is a type of sneakers and its performance is as follows compared to regular sneakers. Instead of shoelaces, a pump can be pushed to inflate and fit the foot. "RunSpeedModifier" improves while air is being filled. Air is gradually released over time, and the "RunSpeedModifier" also gradually decreases. Air lasts for several hours, but can be shorter depending on the condition of the shoes. To add or remove air, you can do so from the context menu. RunSpeedModifier from clothing items exists in vanilla but is not used. Therefore, I recommend using ShoesSpeed mod to enable the RunSpeedModifier effect for the Pump Pury. Box / Empty Box (Pump Pury) You can open the box and take out the sneakers. After taking it out of the box, it will be empty, but you can use it for containers or interior decoration. You can stack up to 5 empty boxes (via the context menu), but the contents must be emptied when Stack and Unstack. Pump Pury Backpack This backpack has the same design as the Pump Pury. Performance is same to a Large Hiking Bag, but lighter and with less penalty to run speed. It can be upgraded to Backpack+ by recipe with obtained from a magazine. Please note that backpacks of the material have specifications that distinguish between normal and rare colors. Pump Pury Backpack+ This is a High-end model of the Pump Pury Backpack. Performance is same to a Large Backpack, but lighter and with less penalty to run speed. Pump Pury Fanny Pack This fanny pack has the same design as the Pump Pury. Slightly larger than a regular fanny pack, and more functional. Pump Pury Fanny Pack+ (B42) This is a High-end model of the Pump Pury Fanny Pack. Poster This is a poster related to Pump Pury. It can be placed on any wall as well as vanilla posters. You can also view the real poster from the context menu. Magazine This is a magazine about the Pump Pury. You will learn the recipes by reading this magazine. Color Lineup : Sneakers, backpacks, and fanny packs are available in normal and rare colors. Normal Rare Poster How to get : Sneakers (Box) / Backpacks / Fanny Packs Cute female zombies equipped with these items spawn and can be obtained from them. All colors (including rare ones) can be obtained from these cute female zombies, although the probability of obtaining them varies. They can also be found in the following locations, too. Storage spaces in private houses Wardrobes in bedrooms and other rooms in private houses Shoe stores and sports-related facilities ProceduralDistributions information is below. (spoiler alert) ClosetShelfGeneric, WardrobeMan, WardrobeWoman, WardrobeManClassy, WardrobeWomanClassy, ClothingStoresShoes, FitnessTrainer, GymLockers, ClothingStorageFootwear, CrateFootwearRandom, CrateSports, SportStoreSneakers, CampingStoreBackpacks Posters Posters can be found with a certain probability when opening a box of Pump Pury. Magazines Magazines can be found on bookshelves in various locations, but the odds are low (Same as Generator Magazine). Options : These options are available with Mod Options in B41. Sound Volume (Inflate) : You can adjust the sound volume when inflating the Pump Pury. Sound Volume (Deflate) : You can adjust the sound volume when deflating the Pump Pury. Known Issues : On some costumes, the sneaker display may be corrupted when there are holes in the costume. I'm currently working on a solution. Future plans : Bug fix (if it exists) Add other colors. Remarks : This mod requires that "DISPLAY > Textures > Double-sized Textures" in GAME OPTIONS is ON. If this option is OFF, the correct size will not be displayed. I don't plan to support this option now, but I will consider it if there are enough requests. You may add it to your mod pack without confirmation and credit. description: A mod to add a method of restoring all guns whether from the base game or any mod. Overview Any gun can be restored using the process of disassembling, cleaning/repairing, and then reassembling. This mod is safe to add mid-game but you will need to visit new locations to find the items added by this mod as loot. If you decide to remove the mod, you should reassemble any gun parts before doing so or they will be lost. Items added by this mod are Firearm Maintenance Kit Gunsmithing Tools Cleaning Solvent Premium Cleaning Solvent Firearm Lubricant Disassembly Using either a Firearm Maintenance Kit or a set of Gunsmithing Tools along with a Screwdriver, break down the gun into parts Note: Any loaded ammo, inserted magazines, or installed gun mods will be removed from the gun before disassembly The Disassembled Gun Parts will be named "{Original Gun's Name} Parts [{Current Condition}/{Max Condition}]" and will encumber you 20% more than the original gun From this point you can Clean, Repair, or Reassemble the gun parts Cleaning Cleaning requires a Firearm Maintenance Kit, some Cleaning Solvent, and a Ripped Sheet Additionally the gun may need at least a certain amount of Condition remaining to be able to restore Condition through cleaning (by default 5, though this is configurable in the Sandbox options) Cleaning will restore as much Condition as you have Solvent for A normal Cleaning Solvent has 10 uses and will restore 1 point of Condition per use it has remaining A Premium Cleaning Solvent has only one use but will restore all Condition when cleaning Repairing Repairing requires a set of Gunsmithing Tools and Scrap Metal You may need a certain level of skill in Firearm skills (Aiming or Reloading) before you are able to repair guns (default 6, though this is configurable in the Sandbox options) Additionally the gun may need at least a certain amount of Condition remaining to be able to restore Condition through repairing (by default 0 so even broken guns can be repaired, though this is configurable in the Sandbox options) Each Repair will consume 1 Scrap Metal and restore 1 Condition Reassembly Once you are ready to put the gun back together simply use Firearm Maintenance Kit or a set of Gunsmithing Tools along with a Screwdriver and a use of Firearm Lubricant to put the gun parts back together Sandbox Options In the Sandbox Options you are able to set The minimum level of Condition on a gun to be able to restore Condition through cleaning (default 5) The minimum level of Condition on a gun to be able to restore Condition through repairing (default 0) The required skill level in Aiming or Reloading to be able to perform repairing (default 6) And adjust the rarity of Firearm Maintenance Kits, Gunsmithing Tools, Cleaning Solvents, and Firearm Lubricants. Compatibility This mod should be compatible with all guns added by mods. I've tested it with Brita's and Vanilla Firearms Expansion. Please let me know if you encounter any incompatible guns. Should modders want to allow their items to work as alternative restoration items for Universal Gun Repair Items tagged with UGRToolClean will be able to be used as a tool to clean guns Items tagged with UGRItemClean will be able to be used as a consumed item to restore 1 Condition per use when cleaning guns Items tagged with UGRItemCleanFull will be able to be used as a consumed item to restore all Condition per use when cleaning guns Items tagged with UGRToolRepair will be able to be used as a tool to repair guns Items tagged with UGRItemAssemble will be able to be used as a consumed item to reassemble guns Special Thanks Spanish translations courtesy of XpaDDer Russian translations courtesy of Avelavi Brazilian Portuguese translations courtesy of gccoiahy Italian translations courtesy of TheSanctuary0 Korean translations courtesy of BLUmountain Thai translations courtesy of Riko Prushka Check out my other mods Workshop ID: 2899457928 Mod ID: 2899457928/UniversalGunRepair Mod ID: UniversalGunRepair

This would help you to go from your average Joe to actual GigaChad in-game. You repair a lot of cars? You get better at it. You train yourself to take long-range kills with proper rifles? Why wouldn't it warranty getting Eagle-Eyed? You pick up thousands of plants through your lifetime and still can't call yourself Herbalist? Yea, that doesn't sound right to me. You maintain great sleeping schedule but for some reason you still need same amount of sleep as when you were sleeping whenever? Not anymore. Welcome to the Dynamic Traits World, ladies and gentlemen! Features UI with all needed mod information in-game! Default hotkey is "[", changeable in settings. 70+ dynamic traits (vanilla + added by the mod). FULL sandbox customization. Choose which perks you want to be dynamic, choose how fast you get them, choose how fast you lose them, customize anything with more than 150 sandbox options. Nothing is forced upon player, if you like 1% of the mod, you can literally set it up so you get to use that 1% and nothing else. Advanced systems that affect a lot of traits. Affinity system, that allows you to stick to your starting traits better. Delayed traits system, that allows you to get/remove traits with random delay. Supported by Mark Dynamic Traits Framework (MDTF) For new traits (aka not vanilla game), customization is also present. Want Hoarder perk to give you more carry weight per point of STR? Go adjust it in Sandbox. Want to be even happier under rain with Pluviophile? Sandbox it is. Optional Trait Sandbox submod: choose which ETW-added traits appear during character creation and change their point values. Requires Starlit Library. Client-sided configuration available. Legacy (b41) version can be found here. Compatibility and Installation Installation instructions can be found in this discussion. List of compatible/incompatible mods can be found in this discussion, including details on: Dynamic Traits, More Traits, zRe ARMOR PACK by kERHUS, Simple Overhaul: Traits and Occupations (SOTO), More Simple Traits (MST), Explorer Trait, SixthSense, Superb Survivors! GitHub and Discord If you want to submit translation files, make suggestions or report bugs, the easiest way to do it would be on Discord. Credits and Translations List of credits, contributors and translators can be found in this discussion (hitting description limit so had to move it).
