description: Characters turn way too slowly in this game. Enabling this mod applies tweaked speed & angle variables that change how your character turns, overall buffing your mobility and combat. It is near-instant pivoting. This mod aims to increase the control given to the player. Overall it's pretty balanced: if you just right click behind you, your character will still play the normal turn-around animation, but if you physically trace the circumference of a semicircle the full 180 degrees around your character, you can do it much faster so it's left to your physical reaction speed and how fast you can perform that motion. This tends to speed up the gameplay loop quite substantially and make fighting zombies generally "easier" (I think it's important to have more control over your player). At the very least, the skill ceiling is much higher, it's not just completely unbalanced. I suggest buffing the zombies in some way. ══════════════════════════ NEW — FULL B42 & B41 REWORK ══════════════════════════ Default out of the box functionality is Instant, Global, set it and forget it, same as previous versions. However, this is no longer just a flat speed tweak. This B42-focused update adds a complete options page and several ways to play: • SANDBOX SETTINGS — enable/disable the mod and tune everything when you create a world. A 5-step speed scale from Vanilla to Instant, tuned to stay fast but smooth. • SEPARATE TURN SPEEDS — set your aiming (combat-stance) pivot and walking (WASD) turn speeds independently. Movement turning is no longer locked to vanilla. description: About Tired of scrolling to your equipped section of the inventory to check your weapon's status and attachments? This mod allows you to inspect your currently equipped weapon on your primary hand at anytime, by: - Hold down the reload button and choose "Inspect Weapon" - Right click on any weapon in your inventory or a world container and choose "Inspect Weapon" will automatically try to equip it in your primary hand slot and inspect it - Pressing ; button to inspect current weapon. You can rebind this button through PZ's default option menu This mod comes with a simple UI and a terrible animation that took an hour to make :) Stats & Navigating UI Unlike the exact stats that are shown within the weapon's tooltip, the "condition" and "number of repair" stat are shown in estimation text (yes, I took this out of the DayZ book). I personally think that this will give players a better immersion on how their characters physically see the condition of the weapon, rather than numbers on a datasheet. Condition - Pristine: This weapon has a perfect 100% condition, and on top of that, it was never repaired - Used: This weapon has a condition between 50%, all the way to 100%. Weapons that are 100% but were repaired even once will get knocked down from "Pristine", to this category - Damaged: This weapon has a condition between 30% to 50% - Badly Damaged: This weapon has its condition less than 30% Number of repair - No sign of repair: Pretty self-explanatory, this weapon hasn't been repaired even once - Slightly repaired: This weapon has been repaired, but less than 3 times - Heavily repaired: This weapon has been repaired at least 3 times It is sort of hard to determine what's the good number for "Number of repair" stat. Realistically, I think 3 times duct taping or replacing some parts of a firearm would look noticeable enough to be deemed "Heavily repaired" Repair If weapon is damaged, an "information" button will be shown next to "Number of repair" stat. You can press on it and directly fix your weapon from the pop-up context menu, just like how you usually do it within the inventory pane Attachments This section is only shown for ranged weapon. I am not too sure if the melee weapons can use attachments (or any mods out there that allows it), prove me wrong :) Attachments can be equipped by clicking on a blank attachment slot, and a list should show options for compatible attachments for that slot. To un-equip it, double clicking on a currently equipped slot. For "Magazine" slot specifically, ammo will be shown for each one, and you can choose to load or unload them by right clicking on them. For controller You can navigate the UI using D-Pad buttons, with A (South) Button as accept, B (East) Button as Back/Close, and X (West) Button as Context/Sub menu Also please be advised, I am aware of the issue that the radial menu entry not showing. This has to do with other gun mods overwriting all the radial menu entries. For VFE specifically, I am working with the devs to figure out a solution to that. description: Build Support: B41.78 and B42.12 to B42.20 B42.20 compatibility reviewed. SP / MP Host tested on recent builds. Dedicated server feedback is welcome. Trees Have Loot Trees Have Loot adds contextual interactions to trees, letting you search them for small foraging loot or cut branches from large trees with the right tool. You may find twigs, branches, bugs, fruit, pine cones, wild eggs, dead critters and other small surprises depending on the tree, season, temperature, tree size and your character’s skills. This version keeps PepperCat’s original gameplay idea while updating the mod for recent Project Zomboid versions, including Build 41 support, Build 42 multibuild support and multiplayer handling. Difference vs the original Trees Have Loot This version is based on PepperCat’s original Trees Have Loot and adds: Build 42 multibuild support, from B42.12 to B42.20. Legacy B41.78 support for older saves and setups. Multiplayer support for B42.13+. Server-side handling for tree search and branch cutting results in MP. Updated B42 item, tool and tag compatibility. Improved pathing to trees using a vanilla gardening-style approach. Updated translation support, including B42.15+ JSON translations. Updated B42.20 tree definitions, including new larger JUMBOXL and JUMBOXXL tree variants where relevant. Features Search in tree Search a tree for small loot. Your character will walk to the tree, turn toward it and search inside it. When the action finishes, the mod rolls for possible loot. The result depends on several factors: Tree size. Foraging skill. Season and world temperature. Tree type. Whether the tree has already been searched recently. Possible finds include: Twigs and branches. Bugs and small foraging finds. Fruit from fruit trees when conditions are right. Pine cones from pine trees. Wild eggs in warmer seasons, especially from larger trees. Rare dead critters. Seasonal behavior Winter: mostly twigs and branches. Autumn: twigs, branches and a few bugs. Spring: twigs, branches and more bugs. Large trees can also have wild eggs. Summer: twigs, branches and many bugs. Large trees have better chances for wild eggs. Extra search details The Foraging skill improves the search chance. Pine trees can drop pine cones, with chances affected by tree size and player Strength. Fruit trees can provide fruit when the season and temperature allow it. Searching large trees without hand protection can scratch the player’s hands. Pulling twigs or branches from a tree can slightly reduce Endurance. Searched trees become available again after about 1 in-game day. Cut branch from tree Equip a suitable sharp tool and cut branches from large trees. Supported tools include knives and axes, with behavior depending on the tool type: Knives: the cut branch is added to the player’s inventory. Axes: the cut branch falls to the ground. The result can be a tree branch or sapling, depending on the current build and available items. Extra branch-cutting details Only large enough trees can be used for cutting branches. Cutting branches can reduce the tool’s condition. The action slightly tires the player. Pine trees can also drop pine cones. Dead squirrels or birds may fall from the tree. Trees can run out of available branches for a while, preventing infinite branch farming from the same tree. Branch cutting has a longer cooldown: branches regrow after about 30 in-game days. Builds / Multiplayer Build 41 support: compatible with B41.78. Build 42 multibuild support: compatible from B42.12 to B42.20. B42.20 compatibility: reviewed against the current vanilla files. B42.20 tree update: new larger tree sprite variants are covered where relevant for pine-tree and fruit-tree checks. MP support for B42.13+: search and cut results are handled server-side to reduce desync. Priority support: focused on the latest tested Build 42 version. Compatibility Notes This mod adds context-menu interactions to trees and should be compatible with most mods that do not heavily replace tree or world-object behavior. Mods that change tree objects, foraging loot, item definitions or tool categories may affect results. If testing on a server, please verify item spawning and inventory sync before using it on a live save. Dedicated server reports are especially useful. Existing saves should work, but testing on a copy of your save is recommended. Credits Original mod, concept and design by PepperCat: PZ Workshop Build 42 compatibility update and maintenance by Afyrmo, with PepperCat’s permission: PZ Workshop Special thanks to everyone reporting issues, testing multiplayer behavior and helping keep PepperCat’s mods updated for newer Project Zomboid builds. description: This mod adds an event that takes some inspiration from the "You Have One Day" challenge. Zombies migrate away from the player and form massive hordes, which, after a certain period of time, return to hunt the player. This mod is intended to work in both singleplayer and multiplayer (albeit limited). This will work on both new and existing saves. The event cycles through three phases: The Cooldown Phase - The time between events. Gameplay is normal and zombies will behave as usual. The 'Calm' Phase - The period in which mass zombie migration occurs. Towns and cities will seem deserted and eerily quiet. This gives players the opportunity to scavenge and build defences before the inevitable horde arrives. The 'Storm' Phase - Zombies return in massive hordes and persistently hunt down the player(s). Zombies are, by default, always aware of the player's position, which can be changed in the sandbox menu. Players will be notified of the start of the storm phase by the sound of wind and distant zombie noises. Note that unlike mods such as Horde Night and Here They Come, this does not spawn any zombies, but rather moves the existing ones in the world to form hordes. The mod is very customizable through the custom sandbox menu and allows you to adjust the duration of each phase, as well as the radius and distance of the horde. Workshop ID: 2953621037 Mod ID: CBTS

description: Tired of zombies splattering their brains all over your pretty lawn? Well no more! Just wait for some rain or snow and watch it all fade away. What gets cleaned? Blood on the ground, walls, and floors Ash left behind by burned corpses Animal droppings (dung) on the ground (B42+) Blood and dirt on your worn clothing (B42+) Blood on nearby vehicles (B42+) Everything fades gradually, only while it's raining or snowing (unless you turn that off), and every part of it is configurable. Does it work in multiplayer? Yes, fully server-authoritative. Can I add this to my current game? Yes, you can add or remove this mod at any time. It contains no save-breaking features. How does it work? Every game minute the mod checks the weather intensity against a configurable threshold. If it's raining or snowing hard enough, it randomly selects a number of nearby tiles and cleans them. Clothing and vehicles are cleaned incrementally on the same tick. Why not always? Immersion — watching blood fade in the rain just feels right. The gradual approach also keeps the performance impact minimal. That said, there's a sandbox option to always clean regardless of weather if you prefer. Sandbox options Everything is configurable: cleaning speed, weather threshold, tiles per minute, and toggles for ash, animal droppings, indoor cleaning, vehicles, and clothing. description: Hello survivors, Another Vehicle Claim System (AVCS) is a vehicle ownership system designed for MP. Yes, there is indeed already a vehicle claim system feature in a mod called Valhalla Community but this mod works differently and is a complete standalone mod with no other features except vehicle ownership. This is primarily made for KWRR community server as I want a mod that do a particular thing and I don't need any other features. Features Ownership tracking We track ownership very differently from Valhalla mod, so differently that it is made possible to remotely revoke claims via UI while being on distant edge of the map. Location tracking We tried really hard to find a way to track locations without putting much overhead on the server. This location tracking is not real time but good enough. It won't track vehicles that disappeared to the void. Actions probations KWRR is a community server thus we do not want to prohibit positive community behaviors thus we block very specific behaviors with primarily intention to prevent your vehicles to be stolen or griefed: Uninstalling parts Taking engine parts Deflating tires Siphoning gas Entering driver seat Opening (closed) trunk Attach or detach vehicle That is to say we allow everyone to Repair parts Repair engine Be a passenger Inflate tires Full access for Safehouse or Faction members Depending on sandbox settings, fellow safehouse or faction members will have full access to your vehicle which include the ability to unclaim them. AVCS is a simple personal vehicle ownership mod, not a comprehensive vehicle ownership which include separate system for faction and safehouse. As a middle ground, we simply provide the option at the discretion of server owners to allow fellow safehouse or faction members to have access to each other vehicles. Claim limits Through sandbox settings, you can set maximum number of vehicles one can claim. Mysterious Vehicle Claim Orb You are require to have a claim orb item to claim vehicle. Depending on the server, it can be sold on server shop or be simply be crafted. This is intended to act both as a economy sink for server with shop system and prevent claiming abuse. Vehicle ownership timeout Through sandbox settings, you can set the number of hours owner have to be offline before vehicle automatically release itself. description: IMPORTANT This mod is the legacy version of the mod. It will no longer be updated. Instead, you should use: Overview Vanilla sound events can feel repetitive after many hours. The same dog bark, the same distant gunshot—always random and disconnected from what is actually happening in the world. Reactive Sound Events reworks this system by making sound events context-aware. If it’s nighttime, maybe someone is being overwhelmed by zombies. If the weather turns extreme, chaos may be unfolding somewhere else. If survivors are nearby… you might hear the consequences. With this mod, sound events have meaning, not just randomness. Current Features 51 handcrafted sound events divided into several categories: Animal Sound Events (6) Gunfight Sound Events (12): Survivors fighting zombies or other survivors Gunshot Sound Events (11): Isolated gunfire in the distance Screaming Sound Events (5): Survivors in panic or pain Vehicle Crash Sound Events (5): Accidents gone wrong Weather Sound Events (8) Zombie Sound Events (4): More frequent during nighttime Event Preference System Each event type has conditions (“preferences”) that affect how likely it is to occur: Weather: Normal or extreme conditions Time of Day: Day or night Player Playstyle: Passive, aggressive, or passive-aggressive World Age: As the world evolves, some events become rarer while others become more common Player Location: Certain locations increase or reduce event priority Compatibility Compatible with all mods (no known conflicts so far) Mods that add sound events (e.g. Random Sound Events) are compatible; adjust settings to avoid overlaps Primarily designed for Singleplayer Worlds started with this mod enabled remain save compatible after updates Planned / Completed Features [strike]Add save compatibility[/strike] — DONE [strike]Complete sound rework (normalization and cleanup)[/strike] — DONE [strike]Separate Weather Events logic[/strike] — DONE [strike]Player reactions (panic, waking up)[/strike] — DONE (2.0) [strike]Expanded preference system[/strike] — DONE (2.0) Event Scenes: Environmental storytelling tied to sound events — DONE (visit Reactive Sound Events for the lastest version) Credits The Indie Stone — for creating Project Zomboid SonidosparavideosSINCOPYRIGHT, Sound Effects Library: Tema, squareal (freesound.org), and STALKER Anomaly developers — for sound assets Project Zomboid content creators — for keeping the game alive 5tratz, for pointing out what was no longer working in the 42.13 update and providing a temporary fix so the mod could remain playable until I updated it properly. description: Build Support: B41.78 and B42.12 to B42.20 B42.20 compatibility reviewed. SP / MP Host testing is recommended before using it on a live server. Dedicated server feedback is welcome. Surviving The Storm Surviving The Storm makes bad weather more meaningful and dangerous. Rain, snow, wet clothing and thunderstorms can now affect survival in a more noticeable way. Staying dry matters more, long storms become more threatening, and thunder can influence zombie movement through world sounds. The mod keeps PepperCat’s original gameplay idea, while the internal structure has been updated for newer Project Zomboid versions, with Build 41 support, recent Build 42 compatibility and improved multiplayer handling. Main Features Rain Rain can wet equipped clothing and the player at a more noticeable rate than vanilla. Rain wetness is affected by rain intensity, wind intensity and clothing protection. Clothing water resistance and wind resistance help reduce rain exposure. Umbrellas and ponchos can reduce rain exposure. This mechanic was originally inspired by the rain behavior from PepperCat’s older Dynamic Traits work. Snow Snow can slightly wet equipped clothing. Snow exposure is affected by snow intensity, wind intensity and fog intensity. Clothing water resistance, wind resistance and insulation help reduce snow exposure. Umbrellas and ponchos do not reduce snow exposure. Wet Clothing Wet clothing can increase the player’s body wetness over time. The effect is based on the total wetness of equipped clothing. Keeping clothes dry becomes more important during long storms, cold weather or travel. This can combine naturally with vanilla cold/wetness behavior and other survival systems. Thunderstorms Thunderstorms can generate world sounds where thunder happens. These sounds can attract or move zombies, depending on your sandbox and zombie hearing settings. The sound can happen far away from the player, so zombies may move in another part of the map without you directly noticing it. The thunder sound radius can be configured in Sandbox options. By default, the radius is 500. For comparison, the vanilla gun event radius is around 600. Since v2.0.2, thunder handling also supports rumble-only thunder events, making thunder world sounds more reliable during storms. Sandbox Options Thunder world sound radius can be configured. Weather effects can be tuned through the mod’s sandbox settings. Server owners are encouraged to test values before using them on a live multiplayer server. Builds / Multiplayer Build 41 support: compatible with B41.78. Build 42 multibuild support: compatible from B42.12 to B42.20. B42.20 compatibility: reviewed against the current vanilla files. MP handling: gameplay effects are handled server-side where appropriate to reduce desync. MP Host testing: basic MP Host behavior has been tested, but server owners should still test before using it on a live server. Dedicated servers: reports are especially useful. Known Notes This mod affects clothing wetness, body wetness and weather-related survival behavior. Existing saves should work, but testing on a copy of your save is recommended. This mod does not add new clothing, items, tiles or world objects. If you use other mods that modify weather, wetness, body temperature, colds or zombie sound behavior, their effects may stack or interact. Credits Original mod, concept and design by PepperCat: PZ Workshop Build 42 compatibility update and maintenance by Afyrmo, with PepperCat’s permission: PZ Workshop Special thanks to everyone reporting issues, testing multiplayer behavior and helping keep PepperCat’s mods updated for newer Project Zomboid builds. PepperCat's mods :) Dynamic Traits and Expanded Moodles Expanded Moodles Trees Have Loot Surviving The Storm Wash Or Rot If you wish to support the development of PepperCat’s mods, you can do it through PayPal: Copyright 2025. This mod does not have authorization to be published on Steam, except under the account name PepperCat. Afyrmo has been authorized to upload new versions on this Workshop item. description: Works with B42 MP update While shooting a firearm, if you are within extreme proximity of the target zombie, the target will instantly die. (Or take a lot of damage, if you configure it in sandbox options) Recent Updates Fixed a bug where one shot could kill a zombie that wasn't in your line of fire. Point Blank now resolves its kill before the engine decides what the bullet hits, so the shot can't go on to put down a second zombie. Controlled by the new PointBlankExperimentalHitLimitations option (on by default) — turn it off to restore the old behaviour. Fixed the sandbox options showing raw/garbled text instead of readable labels. Point blank now has a cooldown between kills — .5s by default, dropping to .1s as your Aiming skill levels up. You'll barely notice it with pistols/revolvers; automatics will feel it more. Want point blank more restricted for balance? Bump PointBlankCooldownDuration up to 1-2 seconds — PointBlankCooldownDurationMin can be adjusted too, and it'll still scale correctly with your Aiming skill. Two-handed weapons (rifles, shotguns) now get a larger point blank range than one-handed ones (pistols, revolvers), since the muzzle sits further from your body. Added rough translations for the remaining languages. Preview https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bnbjy8FDgCo FAQ Multiplayer? Yes. Can this be added/removed mid-save? Yes. Works with Advanced Trajectory / Brita's / Arsenal / Realistic Guns? Yes. Other Mods Ever find another vehicle with a dead battery and be like "where the fk are my jumper cables?" ... i found them in this 90's infomercial: https://youtu.be/OwuG9AleQS4 Sandbox Options Point Blank - Aiming Xp Multiplier Any xp gains from killing a zombie will be multiplied by this value. Default = .05 Point Blank - Effective Range Zombies shot at a distance below this value will take point blank damage. Applies to one-handed weapons (pistols, revolvers). Default = 1.85 Point Blank - Effective Range (Two-Handed Weapons) Same as above, but for two-handed weapons (rifles, shotguns). Set higher than the one-handed value, since the muzzle sits further from the player's body. Default = 2.3 Point Blank - Cooldown Between Point Blank Kills at Min Aiming Skill (seconds) Real-world seconds required between point blank triggers at Aiming skill level 0, regardless of game speed or framerate. This is the longest the cooldown gets — it scales down toward the value below as your Aiming skill increases. Default = .5 Point Blank - Cooldown Between Point Blank Kills at Max Aiming Skill (seconds) The cooldown used once you've reached Aiming skill level 10 — the shortest the cooldown gets. Scales linearly between this and the value above based on your current Aiming skill level. Default = .1 Point Blank - Experimental Hit Limitations Limits one trigger pull to a single point blank victim. Point Blank picks the closest zombie in range and resolves the kill before the engine chooses what the bullet hits, so the shot can no longer put down a second zombie out of your line of fire. Note that this means a point blank kill consumes the shot — a zombie further down range won't also be hit. Turn this off to restore the previous behaviour. Default = true Point Blank - Min Ticks Between Point Blank Kills Set this higher to enforce a "cooldown" between point blank kills. By default, this ensures point blank can't trigger multiple times in a single tick. Default = 1 Point Blank - Disable Multiplayer Command Updates For debugging purposes — you shouldn't need to change this. If you're having server/client/networking issues, this disables synchronous server/client updates. Without it, there can be a delay before a point-blank-killed zombie appears dead to other players. Default = false Point Blank - Instant Kill If TRUE, when shooting a zombie within point blank range, they die instantly. If FALSE, the bonus damage options below apply instead. Default = true Only relevant if Instant Kill (above) is disabled: Point Blank - Minimum Bonus Damage The minimum amount of bonus damage applied. E.g. if your base damage is .0001, this raises the effective bonus damage to at least this value. Default = .15 Point Blank - Bonus Damage Multiplier This multiplier is applied to your bonus damage from above. Does NOT affect BASE damage, ONLY bonus damage. Default = .4 Damage Equation TotalDamage = BaseDamage + PointBlankDamage PointBlankDamage = Max(BaseDamage, PointBlankMinimumBonusDamage) * PointBlankBonusDamageMultiplier (BaseDamage is your weapon's own damage stat — the "MaxDamage" value from its item definition) Hidden from sandbox options, for debugging, punch this into lua console: HF_PointBlank.Debug() If ARTO is enabled, Point Blank is disabled for shotguns. Workshop ID: 2990322197 Mod ID: hf_point_blank

description: 42.20 update Once again thank Lenniitsch for updating the mod to 42.20! without him the original mod probably wouldn't have been fixed. He's another mod creator in the community so go check out his stuff :) https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3660382016 Are you tired of backpacks being too small? Have you ever spent 3 hours digging around looking for a decent bag only to get stuck with the school bag? Do you want a backpack upgrade mod that works with all modded backpacks? This is the mod for you! Introducing Dynamic Backpack Upgrades! The only backpack upgrade mod that can upgrade EVERY inventory container item in the game! Upgrade Mechanics Explanation Each container item will now have 1 or 2 Upgrade Slots. Containers that can be worn on your back get 2 slots. all other containers get 1. To add an upgrade you will need the upgrade item you want to add, a sewing needle, and at least 1 unit of thread. To remove upgrades you will need a pair of scissors. At level 10 tailoring, you can add an additional upgrade to any bag. Upgraded bags retain their upgrades until the item is destroyed or the upgrade is removed. This means you can add an additional upgrade to other people's bags if you have level 10 tailoring. Obtaining/Crafting Upgrade Items All upgrade items can be looted in the world, and all but the best ones can be crafted. The stats for each upgrade and spawn rates for each tier of item can be changed in the Sandbox settings. These stats are always displayed as part of the Upgrade Items tooltip and changes dynamically based on the sandbox settings of the world. Military upgrades cannot be crafted, but you can convert Military upgrades into their opposite type if you have level 10 tailoring. (Meaning you can turn a Military Capacity upgrade into a Military Weight Reduction upgrade) Capacity Upgrades Bag capacity upgrades have 2 components to them. Flat Bonuses and Multipliers. The Bonus will add a flat amount of capacity regardless of what kind of bag its attached to. The Multiplier will add a percentage bonus to the bags existing size, rounding to the nearest whole number. Example; a 10% bonus for the duffel bag would increase its capacity from 18 to 20. the bonus from the multiplier is +1.8, rounded up to to a +2. Formula; Capacity = math.ceil((BaseCapacity*(1+SumMultiplierBonus))+SumFlatBonus) Container Capacity is still affected by the Organized and Disoragnized traits. This leads to some pretty insane bag capacities with modded backpacks. (Brita's) Default values for Capacity upgrades; Weight Reduction Upgrades Weight reduction upgrades only have 1 component, their Weight Reduction Efficiency bonus. This value is not a flat bonus to the weight reduction of an item, and the math is fairly complicated compared to the capacity bonus. The weight reduction increase is a bonus based on the difference between its current value and 100%. Simply put, increasing a bags weight reduction efficiency by 50% will cause the items in the bag to weigh half as much as they did before. Increasing the efficiency by 25% will make the items in the bag weigh 25% less than they did before. and so on. Example 1: the Big Hiking Bag has an 80% weight reduction value. giving it a 50% bonus adds an even 10% bonus (20*0.5) bringing it up to a 90% reduction. Example 2: the Duffel bag has a 65% weight reduction, giving it a 35% bonus results in a bonus of 12.25, rounded to 12% totaling a 77% reduction Example 3: the Military Backpack has a 87% weight reduction, giving it a 20% bonus would add 2.6 (13*0.2), rounded up to 3%, totaling 90% Formula; Weight Reduction = 100-( (100-BaseWR)*ProductEfficiencyBonus ) Is this mod compatible with Inventory Tetris? Yes and no, I've never used inventory tetris so i don't know how it works. I've been told in the vanilla game it segments the bags into various compartments. and that does break with modified inventory size values. turning it into quote "one big box" but otherwise I've been told it does work functionally. I can't pick up my backpack / My backpack is stuck in a container Yeah.. this is an issue caused by the 50 weight hard limit on every character. Weight reduction doesn't apply until you have the bag equipped, which means you need to put the full weight of the bag in your normal inventory before you can equipo it But, when dealing with upgraded or modded bags, its possible to fill a bag so much that picking it up would put you over that 50 weight hard limit before you can equip it, which prevents you from picking it up in the first place. To fix the problem, move the bag to the floor if its not already there. Then you can access its inventory and move things out of the bag to make it lighter, then equip it and put the stuff back in. Crafting Upgraded Items Warning When you upgrade an item with this mod, that upgrade info is saved as part of the items Mod Data. If you use the upgraded item to craft another item, it will be deleted and the upgrades will be lost. This isn't too likely, as very few mods use backpacks as crafting ingredients, but it's worth a warning anyway. Known Issues This mod has text clipping issues with pretty much any other mod that adds custom Tooltips. Sometimes items have their stats reset. Upgraded items will not automatically fix their stats by default. This was done to hopefully avoid conflicts with other mods that change item stats. If an item has unexpected stats then an option to Fix Upgrades will appear in the context menu for that item. If you'd like to help translate one of my mods or just need help sorting something out feel free to join the discord and message me. https://discord.gg/FgvW5vDyYV Workshop ID: 2996978365 Mod ID: LazoloDynamicBackpackUpgrades

description: This mod allows you to change most of the walls in game both prebuilt and built by players. I also lowered the consumption of paint, wallpapers and plaster so you do not need lots of buckets or rolls for your renovation project. Mod works in SP and MP both on B41 and B42 but there are some differences (see below). B42 Works via vanilla Building tab What you can do exactly: Plaster wooden, brick and cinderblock walls. This is an extended vanilla plastering function. Also removes any cracks, dirt, blood and graffiti from walls. Requires level 6 of carpentry, a bucket of plaster and a plaster trowel. Paint not only plastered walls, but also brick, cinderblock and siding ones. I added a lot of colors that you could previously see in some vanilla buildings but they weren’t available in painting menu. Removes only dirt, blood and graffiti from walls. Cracks stay. Requires a bucket of paint and a paintbrush. Apply Wallpapers same as in vanilla you can apply wallpapers to any plastered or painted wall. I extended the amount of wallpapers available and also made more walls count suitable. Removes only dirt, blood and graffiti from walls. Cracks stay. Requires a paintbrush, scissors, a bucket of wallpaper paste and a roll of wallpapers. Apply Woodstain on wooden walls. This is a fully custom option and due to game code limitations you can’t choose what woodstain will be applied in the building tab if you have multiple of them in your inventory. So please make sure you have the exact one that you want. Requires a bucket of woodstain and a paintbrush. Apply Ceramic Tiles on plastered walls and some others that you can see in garages, churches and malls (basically white and grey ones). Same as woodstain you need to have an exact pack of tiles in your inventory to apply on a wall. Requires level 5 of masonry, a pack of tiles, a mason’s trowel and a bucket of cement or concrete. Apply Siding to wooden walls. by default you will get brown siding the same color as basic wood planks. You can paint it in any color as usual. Removes any cracks, dirt, blood and graffiti from the wall. Requires a hammer, 3 wooden planks and 3 nails. Remove siding from walls, including the ones from trailer parks. Requires anything that can remove barricades. Remove ceramic tiles from most of the tiled walls. This will result in a clean plastered wall. Requires any hammer. Compatibilities Neat Building and Project RV Interior mods should be compatible now. What types of walls can be changed Plain walls Window frames Door frames Corner pillars Double door frames Double window frames Arches B41 mod has 2 versions and won't be updated any further: “Wallpapers” - Main version of the mod. “WallpapersBM” for ones who use Building Menu Mod You need to choose ONLY ONE of them. What you can do in B41: Plaster. I added an option to plaster all brick walls, all wooden walls, all cinder block walls. You will need a bucket of plaster and a trowel (Hand Shovel item, NOT a brush) and 4+ carpentry. You can not plaster walls covered with siding or tiles (ceramic or stone), for them you have next option. It doesn't replace the vanilla plaster option for player-made-walls. In case of misunderstanding this is Trowel: https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Trowel (couldn't add image to text, sorry) Remove siding or tiles. If you don't like plastering your walls you can apply siding. Use a wooden plank and a wooden mallet. You will get brown siding, which can be painted in any of existing paint colors. Wood Stain. If you prefer plain wooden texture, but want a different color you can apply a wood stain on a wooden wall. Use a paint brush and a wood stain. You can see swatches on screenshots. Wallpapers. All plastered or painted walls (not siding, bricks or cinder blocks) can be covered with wallpapers. Swatches are on screenshots. Vanilla and Manik's wallpapers available. Requires wallpaper and wallpaper glue. Wallpaper glue can be only crafted from 5 glues, water and an empty water/pop bottle. Tiles. All plastered walls and garage walls can be covered with tiles. description: Description Immersive Lore is a mod that breathes life into the post-apocalyptic world. Immerse yourself in the raw emotions and untold stories of survivors and victims who have left behind fragments of their existence. Scattered throughout the world, these weathered papers hold precious thoughts, heartfelt letters, and intimate reflections from the early days of the apocalypse. NOTE: The vegetation in the preview images are from the 10 years later mod. Q&A How does this mod work? Immersive Lore introduces a new item, "Tattered Paper," to the game. These weathered remnants serve as vessels for the poignant thoughts and messages of those affected by the apocalypse. As you explore the world, you'll stumble upon these items, granting you the opportunity to delve into the narratives they hold. Unfolding the stories within, you'll gain insight into the lives of survivors and victims, immersing yourself in their experiences during the apocalypse Where can I find the item? This item can be discovered in a variety of locations scattered throughout the game world, such as offices, kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and more. Each spawn location holds the potential for a unique story, ensuring that you encounter a diverse range of narratives as you explore. How many stories are there? At the time this mod was last updated (6th of May, 2025), there are a total of 188 stories Is it possible to come across the same story twice? Technically speaking, yes. The mod employs a prioritization system that aims to present you with new and unseen stories whenever possible. However, there are still rare cases where you'd see a repeat story, such as having already read all stories the mod has to offer. How do I blacklist certain stories from spawning? Each story has a unique ID. To find the ID of the story you want to block, head to mod directory/media/lua/shared/Translate/EN/UI_EN.txt. Press Ctrl + f and search for the story you want to blacklist. The ID of the story will be in the translation name. For example, UI_ImmersiveLore_Story_1_Title points to story with id 1. Compile a list of ids you want to block separated by semi-colons, like 1;14;16;32;94, then go to sandbox options of the mod and paste it into the "Blacklisted Stories" field. Compatibility Other Mods - No known incompatibilities with other mods currently. Game Version - Tested and works on 41.78.16+. Not tested on earlier versions. Multiplayer - Functional in multiplayer. Pre-existing saves - Can be added to your pre-existing save, although the item most likely won't show up in areas you've already looted. Known Bugs/Issues None at the moment. If you come across any, feel free to report them so they can be fixed as soon as possible Translations Translations are in progress for this mod. If you'd like to contribute to translating it to your native language, the help would be greatly appreciated and you'll be credited on the mod page! Feel free to head over to the translations discussion. Links - Join us on Discord - I love Coffee. Perhaps you'll consider buying me one? Feedback Whether it is a suggestion, feedback, or something else you've got on mind, it'd be hugely appreciated! Credits The letters and notes found in this mod have been authored by different people. Huge thanks to all of them! Background image used in the video by kjpargeter on Freepik The voice in the video is generated by ElevenLabs This mod's permissions fall under TIS's policy Ask for permission This mod can only be added to and extended with the express permission from the original creator. description: NOW IN BETA FOR BUILD 42! Have you ever wondered what a real-life furry might experience during the zombie apocalypse? Choose between traits like Carnivore, Herbivore, Hoofed, Beast of Burden, or even... Stinky? Customize almost everything about these traits, including how strong they are, how many points they're worth, and more! Roleplay your fursona, a popular character, or any other Anthro in your quest to Die Just the Way you Want! Compatibility Generally, Anthro Traits is compatible with other mods. Anthro Traits has built-in compatibility for, but may not work perfectly with: Expanded Traits More Simple Traits Simple Overhaul Traits and Occupations More Traits Anthro Traits may not play nice with mods that: edit item tooltips. edit character creation GUIs. affect timed actions. affect how food is eaten by players. are "overhauls". add the same sort of traits. Positive Trait List Anthro Immunity Knox Infection is rare, even from bites. Optionally, be infected as normal from anthro zombies. Beast of Burden Carry additional weight. Bug-o-ssieur You don't gain unhappiness or boredom when eating bugs. Will find more insects when foraging. Carnivore Meat is more beneficial for your character, plants less. Will find more dead animals when foraging. Carrion Eater Can eat rotten meat without getting sick (boredom and unhappiness still displayed in tooltip, but don't actually apply), is more beneficial than usual. Will find more dead animals when foraging. Digitigrade Feet cannot be scratched. Stomps do more damage, but carry weight is slightly decreased. +1 Sprinting. +1 Lightfoot. +1 Sneak. Feral Body +1 Strength. -1 Fitness. Food Motivated Food makes you slightly less unhappy and bored. Dog/cat food doesn't make you unhappy. Herbivore Plants are more beneficial for your character, meat less. Will find more vegetables, fruits and berries when foraging. Unguligrade (UN-gyuh-lih-grade) Feet cannot be scratched, lacerated, or bitten and won't bleed, but glass or bullets are still dangerous and will leave deep wounds. Stomps do much more damage, but carry weight is decreased. +1 Sprinting. +1 Nimble. Natural Tumbler The damage and severity of your falls are reduced. Tailed Reduces trip chance from zombies. Vestigial Wings Don't take fall damage. Bird-like/Feline/Sheep-like Voice, Adds a mitigation chance to the Exclaimer trait: sometimes zombies will mistake your warnings calls for real animal calls and ignore them. Also changes the phrases of your warnings calls :) Negative Trait List Exclaimer Scream frequently when above panic level 1. Feral Digestion Chocolate and other foods poison you somewhat. Lonely Gain unhappiness every hour when away from other players too long. Stinky Attract zombies nearby when too dirty. Other players may comment on your smell. Torpor Lose a percentage of max endurance during winter. Unwieldy Hands Actions requiring fine motor control are slower. description: Adds a new trait that may save your life when zombies surround you. Just a moment before you are eaten alive, you gather all your strength and push zombies back, earning the chance to escape. Do check your wounds, though. You might've only delayed the inevitable... ⚠️ Does not work in Multiplayer ⚠️ ⚠️ Does not work in B42 ⚠️ There's Perseverance mod that is way more interesting than this, and it's tagged with B42. There's also Indefatigable trait in More Traits which heals you after preventing death, with B42 and MP support Usage The ability is activated automatically, in two cases: 1. "Drag Down" In vanilla, if you are surrounded by enough zombies you get locked into "Drag Down" animation that always results in your death. The ability may* trigger immediately when this animation starts, preventing you from dying. 2. "Hit Activation" Since the "Drag Down" can be disabled in vanilla settings, this serves as a fallback option. With default settings, the ability may* trigger when you take damage by a zombie and there are more than 8 zombies in 1.5 (tiles?) radius. * note that there is an Endurance Cost & Requirement for the ability to actually activate - read more below. Endurance Cost & Requirement Ability consumes 20% of endurance and adds 40% of tiredness (fatigue) when triggered. It will not be triggered if your endurance is <50% (High Exertion & worse) or your tiredness is >80% (Very Tired & worse) All these values can be changed or disabled completely. Balancing Everything is customizable! Use Change Sandbox Options (by Star) for changing sandbox options at any point in the game. Trait Cost The trait costs 10 points by default. You also earn it at 10 strength. You can change the cost by enabling one of the submods. Current options are: 12, 16, 18, and 20 points. To remove the trait from character creation enable LastPushTraitNotPickable submod. This makes the trait only accessible when a customizable strength level is achieved. Inspiration (The Walking Dead series spolier - do not read unless you watched it all) The scene where Rosita fell down and was swarmed by the dead, but when it seemed like she's done for, she pushed all the walkers back and escaped. Too bad she got bitten... description: This is a realistic overhaul of a mod called Advanced Trajectory. It tries to involve as much player skill as possible while having PZ's RPG mechanics such as moodles play a big role during gunplay. If the mod is too easy or hard, nearly everything can be customized in the sandbox options. If hosting a server, disable Anticheat 12 to prevent players from being kicked from no clipping from True Crawl/Crouch mod. If you are running into any errors, make sure you are not subscribed to any third party ATRO patches as they may be outdated. B42.14 Update 2/17 + 2/21: Check change notes to see info about previous updates. Fixed mod not working when playing 42.14 Fixed revolversfx not being removed in MP Many changes and fixes to Advanced Trajectory. Watch the video for an overview of the core changes. A lot has changed so make sure to also read past change notes. Gunplay (keyword is bloom) At levels 3 to 10, the gunplay works similarly to Resident Evil 2 Remake meaning the player has to wait a bit for the character to "focus" and aim for their target before hitting an accurate shot. For example, when a player is aiming and standing still, bloom value will reduce from 100 to 30. Once the bloom reaches 30, it waits for a second or two before reducing to 0. A value below 5 (crosshair changes color) is what you want as it allows you to deal the most damage when aiming for the head, otherwise, it will be treated as body damage. So don't waste your ammo spraying bullets because you'll either miss or do little damage. Let's call this whole thing the "focus mechanic" for the sake of naming. Higher level = higher accuracy and crit chance, less chance of missing levels 0 to 2: very bad at shooting with anything but shotguns; player is limited to only dealing body and foot damage, but is not limited to dealing crit damage level 3: focus mechanic is unlocked which allows the player to get an accurate shot on a target from afar (can hit headshots) level 6+: bloom reduction rate is capped and no longer scales, however the crosshair will continue to get smaller the higher level you are level 10: player can run n gun and is a headshot machine (if stationary) Hit/Miss (Can be disabled) When the crosshair is slightly transparent at a certain bloom (which is dependent on aiming level), RNG will begin to play a role in determining whether or not the individual projectile will hit their target. Shotguns give a significant buff in increasing the bloom in which the RNG will be in effect. Distance Penalty (Can be disabled) Crosshair will get bigger after a certain distance. The penalty is less severe the higher the aiming level and the longer the weapon range. Moodles Has a Cold: sneezing adds a big burst of bloom whereas coughing adds a little Drunk: more bloom is added when moving and turning Endurance: aim sways a lot Hyperthermia/Hypothermia: slows bloom rate reduction Fatigue: slows bloom rate reduction drastically Stress: limits the value of how small bloom can reduce to and makes crosshair shaky Pain: slows bloom rate reduction, adds shaky visual effect to crosshair, and limits how small bloom can reduce to Panic: increases effect of distance penalty and makes crosshair shaky Heavy: Similar to drunkness, penalty when moving and turning is amplified. In addition, stamina consumption when switching stances is increased and more bloom will be added when switching between crouch and stand stance. Weapon Attachments If you deck out your weapon, you will have a much easier time shooting. It can even nullify negative effects at a certain level. AimingTime(+) => Increases bloom reduction HitChance(+) => Shortens focus timer Recoil(-) => Reduces recoil Range(+) => Increases range True Crouch and True Crawl Support Not required, but a necessity for a full and funner experience. Switching stances will consume stamina based on fitness level and heavy moodle level. Switching stances between crouch and stand adds bloom while aiming. Crouch When performed, bloom is reduced for levels that have not unlocked the focus mechanic Bloom reduction rate is increased for all levels, helps a lot when exhausted Can burst a few bullets while ignoring the focus timer depending on the level and recoil Is OP when your gun is decked with attachments Crawl/Prone you get effects from crouch but better and faster time to focus (less time waiting at minaimnum) recoil reduced by half Suggested Mods [B41] Alternative Crosshair for ammo counter near crosshair To set it up, you'll need the "Mod Options" mod to make changes to the Alt. Crosshair. Go to your settings and locate Mod Options -> Alt. Crosshair, then set Ranged Weapon Crosshair to "IsoCursorFade" or "IsoCursorOpaque". After that, turn down the transparency of the vanilla isometric cursor in the main settings tab. Brita's Bow Dupe Fix for ATRO (Brita users only) To get the bows to work properly, download the fix and have it loaded after Brita's Weapon Pack. Then go to sandbox options -> ATRO[DEBUG] and check debugEnableBow. That's all you need to do. FAQ (MORE IN DISCUSSION SECTION) Does this work with multiplayer? Yes. Do I need the original Advanced Trajectory mod? No, this mod is all you need. Does this work with existing saves and can I remove them mid save? Yes and yes. Does this work with splitscreen or controller? No. Does this work with other weapon mods? Yes. Do I really need True Crouch and True Crawl [B41] or Lethal Stealth [B42]? No, but it is RECOMMENDED for a full experience. I'm missing my shots on zombies with 0 bloom. Why? The mod's crosshair is not always accurate. Sometimes, you must use the vanilla's isometric cursor. Make sure the base of the cursor is on their center of gravity. It takes too long for the bloom to get to 0, how do I make it faster? You can go to the sandbox options and increase the value of "Focus Counter Speed". How do I get rid of the crosshair's low framerate? Uncheck "UI Offscreen Rendering" in your settings. Does this work with Superb Survivors or any NPC mod? Yes, enable "Ignore PVP Safety" in sandbox options so you can damage NPCs with guns. How to get rid of iso cursor? Go to Sandbox options -> Advanced Trajectory (CROSSHAIR) -> set Iso Cursor [Transparency] to 0 I'm seeing 2 bullets being shot at once. How do I fix this? [B42] One bullet is from ATRO and the other bullet is from vanilla. PLEASE LOCATE ATRO MOD FOLDER THEN GO TO "42\media\effects" and read the README file for instructions. Do not enable hide tracer option in sandbox. description: Welcome to Tikitown! Tikitown sits between Riverside and West Point, near Fallas Lake. Use it as a long-term base, a supply run, or just another place you clear out and move on from. Walk the old main street, pick through the downtown shops and offices, or move into one of the custom houses and rebuild it however you want. It mixes familiar Kentucky sprawl with a lot of new ground to fight over and fortify. Some of it's comfortable. Some of it isn't. A few spots are better left alone. Tikitown's Own Powerplant We're BACK! The Powerplant has been tested on Single and Multiplayer and works on both now The power plant is the biggest addition to Tikitown. It's a separate add-on mod you enable on its own, but it ships bundled with this workshop item, so there's nothing extra to download. The user guide is still being written and the current version is already a little behind thanks to some last-minute changes, but it's here: Tikitown Power Plant User Guide Give it a run and leave feedback. Wear rates are in the mod options so you can tune them to your playstyle, and I'll keep making small changes as I go, including a fueling requirement down the line. What's new in Tikitown Tikitown has picked up hundreds of new locations for Build 42, with over 250 new buildings since launch. If you knew the B41 version, a lot of the town is different now. • Downtown rebuild: A reworked business core with new landmarks, side streets, and trouble spots. • Rail and docks: A commuter rail line plus a large warehouse, railyard, and docklands for late-game looting and base builds. • Blackshields Sheriff's Office: A large police station themed around the Blackshields. • FBI field office: A small federal site with security, offices, and higher-end loot if you can clear it. • Tikitown University: A full campus with lecture halls, dorms, and a to-scale baseball and football field. • Mansion Row expanded: More big houses on the hill if you like gated compounds and long driveways. • New underground spaces: Tunnels, garages, and service corridors that link parts of town and give you more ways to move around or disappear. • Industrial sector overhaul: Factories, depots, and yards built out as a proper industrial belt on the edge of town. • Tikitown Power Plant add-on: A fully mapped power station behind the hospital, with repairable equipment, custom loot, and an optional system to bring the town's grid back online for a while. • Expanded docks: A built-out Port Authority and northside docks, with more warehouses, offices, and room to stash a boat or a safehouse. Will you claim Tikitown as your own, or will it just be another place you passed through? Tikitown in B41 requires the following tilepacks: Melos Tiles Daddy Dirkie's Tiles Newburbs Drazion's Tilepack B41 Tikitown sits on the following cells: 23,23 23,24 23,25 24,23 24,24 24,25 25,23 25,24 Tikitown is getting rebuilt piece by piece and it's not done yet. Some of what's still coming: • High-rise work: More attention to the taller office area and business district. • Extra underground links: More service corridors and tucked-away connections between key blocks. In Build 42, keys no longer spawn on doors. However, the logic for obtaining keys from doors remains intact. Therefore, this mod has been updated to be compatible with Build 42 in case door key spawning is reintroduced in the future. It's difficult to check the implementation frequently, so if you can confirm that spawn on the door have been restored with this mod for B42, please let me know! Overview & Features : Car keys spawn in the ignition, glove box, buildings near the vehicle, on the ground, and on zombies, but there is also a low probability that they will spawn on the "vehicle door". However, when it spawns on a vehicle door, there is no way to confirm that it has spawned, and it seems that the key can only be retreived under certain conditions. Therefore, this mod will add the feature to automatically retrieve the keys from the door and notify the player with a message when the player attempts to enter a vehicle whose keys are spawned on the door, regardless of the conditions. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 and also work on MP. Q&A : What is the probability of a key spawning on a vehicle door? It is 1/4 probability compared to the spawn to the glove box. Of course, spawning keys on the door is not a feature of this mod, but of vanilla. This mod only reteives keys that have already spawn on the door. Is it possible to retrieve the key from the door without using this mod? Yes, it's possible. If a key is spawned on the door, it can be retrieved when trying to enter through a locked door. However, there is no notification, and the key is only silently added to your inventory. Do I need to try entering through every door to retrieve the key from the door? No, as long as the key is spawned on the door of that car, the key can be retrieved by entering through any door. Does it work even if it's enabled in the middle of the save data? Or do I need a new game? This mod makes it easier to get keys spawned on doors, rather than having them spawned on doors. Therefore, a new game is not required. Options : These options are available with Mod Options in B41. Finding Message Notification : Can specify whether to enable or disable. Sound Volume (Found) : You can adjust the sound volume when you find the key on the door. Known Issues : Nothing Future plans : Bug fix (if it exists) Release Notes : v1.5 - Compatible with Build 42. v1.4 - Added Sound Options. v1.3 - Added ranslation (ES). v1.2 - Added sound effect file for replacement. v1.1 - Added ranslation (KO, PTBR, TH). Please refer to "Change Notes" for the older history. If you enjoy this mod and would like to support its development, donations through Ko-fi are greatly appreciated. Donations help cover the cost of a dedicated server for MP testing and AI services used during development. Thank you for helping me continue maintaining and improving my mods! Overview : A deadly weapon that's somewhere in this world... Super bat which can do everything, Excalibolg... Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 Stable, Single-Play only. Features : Add the new item "Excalibolg" and related items. Excalibolg It's a blunt weapon that is renowned as the strongest. As a grade of weapon, a total of 3 types (Tier1 to Tier3) exist. Tier1 : Re-enhanced Excalibolg, available by upgrading from Tier2. Tier2 : Enhanced Excalibolg, available by upgrading from Tier3. Tier3 : Initially, only one exists somewhere in this world (fixed spawn) The following special abilities are common to all grades. Very high damage and criticality Very high damage to obstacles (doors, trees, etc.) Very high durability Self-repairing (cannot be repaired, but if in inventory, durability is automatically repaired every hour) The concept of "Master Level" exists. The more you use Excalibolg, master level also increases. The master level improves performance (boost) when equipped. Total 5 levels, and the more you master it, the higher the boost rate. You can be confirmed in the context menu of the Excalibolg for the current level. You will be more hungry with attacking by Excalibolg, Legend of Bludgeoning Angel It contains recipes for updrading Excalibolg. Like the other books, it can be found in bookstores and on bookshelves. The chances of finding it are the same as in generator magazine. Options : These options are available in Sandbox Options. Meta > Excalibolg World Spawn : Enables world spawn for Excalibolg. This is an option in MP for cases where admins want to limit the availability of the item. Q&A : Can this be enabled on mid-save? Yes, possible. Where does Excalibolg spawn? Please see the introductory video for a hint if you like. If I were to give you a hint in writing, it would be "It's on the most expensive bed in the world". Enjoy for exploring! How can I get Excalibolg in other game modes? Except for Knox Country Map, the settings must be made individually, and at this time, the "Kingsmouth" and "Studio" modes are supported. Hints on the location of the spawns are below. Kingsmouth : It spawns in a place where a large number of weapons are stored. Studio : Spawn on a film set somewhere. *choo-choo* Why doesn't Excalibolg spawn when I go to the place you explained? First, check to see if the mod is enabled; mid-save often does not have the mod enabled. If it still does not spawn, try waiting up to 10 mins in-game time near the spawn location. To reduce game load, spawns are determined once per hour. What's the secret feature? Please make the master level the highest! Known Issues : Nothing Future plans : Bug fix (if exists) Remarks : Mod icon is illustrated by @lgnd_flatter_3, special thanks ! description: There is also a 42 stand alone version: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3631572046 True Music Radio Default Radio Stations: 94FM (92FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal A playlist at the station 94.2FM (92.2FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal B playlist at the station 94.4FM (92.4FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal C playlist when activated by an admin at a terminal 94.6FM (92.6FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal D playlist when activated by an admin at a terminal 94.8FM (92.8FM in B42) plays from the global list or the Terminal E playlist when activated by an admin at a terminal True Music MTV TV Ch.211 in B42 plays from the global list or the Terminal MTV playlist when activated by an admin at a terminal Stations can now be changed in the sandbox settings, it is possible to change them mid-playthrough but you will need to restart a server if involved or replace the sandbox file in a solo game. These radio stations were made compatible with the True Music player mod and it's cassettes and vinyl. Without True Music song mods loaded, you will only hear the game's theme song and the terminals will only have a single tape and a single record. New! Song announcements, weather reports, and Horde Night compatibility. When using Horde Night, the radio will display a warning every hour on the hour. You can turn these off in sandbox settings and in solo games in mod options. Horde Night! https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2714850307 If you make the trip out to this station in the west end of Riverside, you can update two special terminals next to the computer. Drop your music items into the terminal and update the music list. The only limit to the number of tape/vinyl tracks added is the weight that the terminal can hold. Alternatively all the radio stations start with a default list of all the True Music mod packs you have in your mod list. The terminals can also revert the music back off the playlist if you want to change it back. If you switch the terminal options, all radios on those channels will update and play a new song. So you can use it to resync immediately or switch songs but it's always random. Just added in v1.11 the terminals will now start with some random music media in them but it does not pull tracks to the terminal channels immediately. You still need to make the trip out. Also the terminal on the western wall has an option to eject media. It will allow random spawns of media from that terminal. I will be working on a way to choose a title in the future so you can download the songs of your choice. The new sandbox settings allow control of the amount of media found in each terminal. The west terminal eject system is also limited to the same spawn amounts and the ability disappears once empty. Added in v1.13 play radios everywhere in single player with immediate world sync. In multiplayer the music must stop and be restarted between world switching as radios in inventories and backpacks can only be heard by that player. Added in v1.18 you can now turn off all TMRadio station music on all radios with mod options. Great for streamers that need to control the music. Added in v1.21 an admin can now activate terminals to control the 94FM and 94.2FM stations that are not at the station. This will help custom maps to control the music. Even though multiple terminals can change the music, only one can control the music list at a time. The last one that updated will be the one in control. Added in v1.27 radio stations can be moved in the sandbox settings. Added in v1.29 an admin can now remove songs from the global list so that the 5 music stations will never play those songs unless overridden by playing them from the terminal list directly. The admin can go through the terminal menu and add and remove songs from the list. The sandbox is also updated to choose to remove the theme music with TrueMusic, the additional songs added by TCCacheMP, or just the holiday music from the TCCacheMP mod. Known issues: ***On servers you may need to set anti-cheat 21 as false if it kicks players, it seems to be a generic failure involving corrupted mod files that differ from server to client.*** They way this works now, no longer needing script codes from the broadcast, just turn on a radio and tune in to one of the 5 stations. It will start a song immediately but if someone already started a song on that station it will be out of sync until the next song is played. Then both radios will be in sync. Handheld and inventory radios are not heard by other players in multiplayer. Handheld radios are only heard by the owner in multiplayer but zombies will still hear them unless you use a headset. New in v1.13 zombie attraction has a toggle and is default to off. Disassembling running radios will cause the audio emitter to detach, have not written a fix for it yet but on the way. Station location in southwest Riverside: https://map.projectzomboid.com/#4835x6283x6360 Updates: v1.28 Added - ability for the admin to activate the other 3 channels for control through a terminal, by default only the first 2 could be controlled Added - ability to turn off the theme music from the radios in the sandbox v1.29 Added - Blacklist for admins to remove music titles from the lists Added - Sandbox settings so that the theme music, TCCacheMP music, or just the TCCacheMP holiday music can be removed from the lists v1.30 fixed - bug with empty blacklist causing client mod data issues on disconnect v1.31 Updated to 42, work around to get tapes and records to drop until True Music is updated, can be used without True Music or the cache for now. description: Have you ever thought that you enjoy multi hit but feels a little too OP? Then this mod is for you. It brings: RNG check on each swing, depending on skill level Configurable parameters in sandbox options for overriding the game's default max hit values, including unarmed (Now defaulted to 2, because you have two hands) Minimum str requirement for 2 and 3 hits, enabled globally, by default off Shoving with a snow shovel now is different than shoving with a knife B42: Shoving is vanilla for the time being. Muscle strain not accounted for, might see later as a sandbox option. B41 ONLY: For shoving to be moddable it requires a java fix Copy zombie folder from this workshop item (Default: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\108600\3138387399\mods\ProgressiveMultihit\zombie") over the main install of Project Zomboid (Default: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\ProjectZomboid\zombie"). It should ask you to overwrite file and you need to click yes for all. Change explained below. To revert check integrity of game files. There will be no errors if you don't do the Java fix, but the shoving will work like vanilla. How it works in vanilla Each weapon has a base max hits value, which the game flat out applies if you have multihit on, or treats it as 1 if you have it off. For shoving, if you have any weapon equipped it's always 3. Shoving unequipped is 1. How it works after java fix Shoving now actually uses the max hit stat while unarmed, and when shoving with a weapon equipped it uses the greater max hit value of the two. Because it makes sense to only shove 2 targets since you have two hands, but if you pick up a large stick to use it for shoving 3. How it works after mod It adds a chance for the swing to multi hit or not based on the following formula: 10 % chance per weapon skill level, averaged with 10% chance per strength level For example, having lvl 6 weapon with lvl 3 str gives 45% chance. 50% penalty applied if a two handed weapon is being used one handed. 25% penalty per Exhaustion and Exertion levels applied multiplicatively Max chance can be capped at a percent given in sandbox options. Works in both SP and MP. Only client needs java fix, can't really enforce it. Works in split screen. Should be compatible with any modded weapon, as long as there isn't another mod interacting with the hitcount when swinging. Now works with other mods such as Multihit Limiter, need to uncheck override hit count toggle in sandbox settings. Workshop ID: 3138387399 Mod ID: ProgressiveMultihit

description: This mod has been discontinued, the new version is here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3534101589 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- One day I was playing and I thought "Wow, I wish there was a wider variety of clothes in Zomboid like I have in my wardrobe…” and then I realized “oh… wait, I'm a 3D artist, I can literally add EVERYTHING I want to the game" and so the idea of "Bianca Wardrobe" was born. Bianca Wardrobe is an ongoing mod with the promise of colossal proportions, at the launch date there are already 1,751 different variations of items weighing only 80 mb and the plan is to increase exponentially and always keeping quality first! My goal is to always improve the items that have already been released and each time launch more beautiful and cool visuals to improve your gameplay This mod will have frequent updates with different types of visuals and new ideas. My wish is that there are infinite clothes in Zomboid, in all possible colors and tastes for everyone to feel comfortable and happy playing! I feel strange doing an F.A.Q before launching the mod... i mean, no one has even asked anything yet Q: “Bianca, what do you plan to add to the mod?” A: Everything, literally, everything involving clothes and style! all styles, all fabrics, shirts, all clothes, boots, pants,hairs, coats, overcoats, helmets, hats, scarves, bags, wings, ponchos, harness, lingerie, panties, underwear, bras, caps, capes, glasses, nails, tattoos, earrings! of all variations, sizes and colors and in the future you can be sure that I will also make optional clothes and skins for animals (I would also like to make clothes and cars with neon but unfortunately Zomboid doesn't support emissive map, maybe in the future) Q: “Are the models yours?” A: Yes, I created all the models from scratch! This mod will not have any models that were not created exclusively for it Q: “Can I use your mod in my modpack?” A: Of course, feel free to use. Q: “Is this mod incompatible with X mod?” A:anything should work, if there is an error it's not the mod's fault because it is very simple and just adds items known incompatible mods: Paw Low Loot Q: “Can you add X mod compatibility?” A:I'm not going to add compatibility with any mod because it takes time to learn how the other mod works and put it into practice, but if you want to add compatibility feel free! the more compatibility the better Q: “This mod must weigh a lot, won't my game have problems because of this?” A: I know how annoying it is to use a cool mod that is poorly optimized and disrupts your game! Don't worry, that won't happen here. As I said, there are currently 1,750 item variations and the mod only weighs 80 mb. I worry as much as possible about getting the most out of a model or texture that I can without consuming unnecessary weight. Furthermore, the mod will never stop being more and more polished! It is always possible to optimize further Q: “There are many items, how does the drop work? Will my game be full of items from your mod?” A: I also have a big concern about the drop table, I don't want to pollute people's games and hinder other mods from spawning their own items! That's why I did everything I could to make it easier to acquire items without having to pollute the game. The drop table won't be intrusive, you'll find mod items but not at a high frequency! and to compensate for this, the mod has 2 more possibilities to get the items: the selection of clothes in the home menu and the "Fashionmancer" This is a pretty big mod so it's understandable that errors will appear that I didn't notice before! It is very difficult to organize the workshop comments so if you are going to report an error, please do it on discord. Did you like our mods and do you play or know a friend who plays FiveM? Then go check out our Tebex store! Now, in addition to using Bloodforge items on your Project Zomboid character, you can also use them in GTA RP! Did you like my work and want to support me and help my mods have frequent updates? support me on ko-fi! <3 Special Thanks <3 Roddo Thanks for ES translation in both mods, Bianca Boxes and Bianca wardrobe WastelandCanid Thanks for your commission, trust, preference and for always being kind Did you like it? Go check out other mods we made! description: Contents First Aid VHS Tapes Adds 4 VHS tapes that can be found in VHS stores. Each VHS tape teaches the player how to treat a different type of injury. Episode 1 - Lacerations Episode 2 - Deep wounds Episode 3 - Bone Fractures Episode 4 - Burns Watching these VHS tapes will also increase the First Aid skill. Background Not sure about you, but I've always felt that the first aid skill was too difficult to increase naturally. Whilst I am aware you can simply roll around in glass shards and treat the wounds as they appear to help boost the first aid skill, it doesn't seem very immersive... Would you do such a thing in real life to learn first aid? While there is an official in-universe way of learning first aid, you need to find 2, hard to find 'Home VHS' tapes and I've never found them in all my time playing! There is also no official, in-game way of teaching the player how to treat specific wounds. For example, crafting a splint to help fix a fracture, I only found out you could craft one by looking at the wiki... With that said, I decided to make this mod. description: This mod provides the ability for players to repair their guns using a dish towel with expendable uses available, a toothbrush, and a screwdriver. The amount repaired is based on your maintenance skill, meaning the higher your maintenance the more you will see repaired to a certain degree since weapon condition is something that is typically represented by an integer value in Project Zomboid. ------------------ Default System ------------------ The math for determining how much you repair with each attempt is equal to: (Maintenance Level * 6/100) * Max Durability of weapon. Meaning at level 5 you will repair 30% of the durability per repair versus 24%-6% repair at level 4 or lower. You will also be given a small amount of Maintenance experience when performing the repair action. Unlike the normal repair system, these repairs are not counted. However, there is a chance that you will destroy the toothbrush being used while cleaning your gun. The chance your toothbrush will be destroyed is equal to the following: (11 - Maintenance Level) * 3. Meaning, at 0 Maintenance level you have a 33% chance to have your toothbrush destroyed and since you are more than likely going to need multiple attempts this adds up fast and makes it more likely you will destroy the toothbrush. At level 5 you have an 18% chance to destroy the toothbrush. ------------------ Feature Update ------------------ You can now customize this mod using ModOptions! You have the following options: Toothbrush Break Chance This allows you to set your own toothbrush break chance ignoring the default system parameters specified and ignoring your maintenance skill! Custom Toothbrush Break Chance? This enables the toothbrush break chance you specified. Repair Tracking? This enables the mod to track how many times you have repaired the gun giving you diminishing returns. Every 2 times you repair a gun the maximum amount you increase the durability drops by 1 (4 repairs = 2 loss in max durability). Custom Repair Cap This enables you to set the maximum % the gun can be repaired to, granted this does get rounded based on the durability of the gun. This is also reduced even further when utilizing repair tracking, so something to keep in mind. Custom Condition Repair? This enables you to set the amount you repair each time you make a repair ignoring the math formula in the default system. Custom Condition Repair Amount This sets how much durability you restore to a gun with each repair ignoring the math formula in the default system. Workshop ID: 3164282444 Mod ID: GunCleaningMod

description: "No dough, no go." - Quote from the Secure-Gas-And-Go Payments Processing Company Gas pumps throughout the country have been updated to the finest level of secure payment possible. To use a gas pump you will require either a Credit Card with a non-zero balance, or cash Money. Each time you pick up a blank Credit Card an amount will be displayed in its description in your inventory. When you use the gas pump it will draw down any Credit Cards and then Money in your primary inventory. To aid in budgeting, any Credit Cards and Money in your backpacks or other packs will not be consumed. There are sandbox options to all you to customise the cost of various fuels, and to set auto search for money in your bags. This mod is @Nightscale's fault; many thanks for the idea and the specification. Many thanks to @Khontac for assistance and advice in designing the payments handling from the inventory. Include the RicksMLC_PayAtThePump3rdPartyPatch if you use Treads and/or FuelAPI. This patch fixes a compatibility issue between Pay At The Pump and Treads and FuelAPI mods. ----------------------------------------- -- Note for modders: To add mod support for your fuel TimedAction handling there are three API methods to call: -- RicksMLC_PayAtPumpAPI.initPurchaseFuel(this) -- Call in :new(). -- Checks the source is a fuel pump and initialise the pay amounts. -- RicksMLC_PayAtPumpAPI.updateFuelPurchase(self, self.tankStart, self.tankTarget) -- Call in :update(). -- Checks the funds balance and reduce any credit card funds by the delta fuel amount. -- Note that the :perform() is not needed as the funds balance checking and reducing is handled in updateFuelPurchase. -- RicksMLC_PayAtPumpAPI.handleEmergencyStop(self) -- Call in :stop() and :complete(). -- Handles the take fuel action abort state by finishing the payment of the final amount. -- -- You can see this implemented in the RicksMLC_PayAtPumpAPI.lua file: -- \Workshop Files\Contents\mods\RicksMLC_PayAtThePump\common\media\lua\shared\RicksMLC_PayAtThePump.lua -- -- Example: you have a mod that adds a new TimedAction called "ISTakeFuelModExample" which is similar to the vanilla ISTakeFuel. -- You would add the following .lua module to your mod (with ISTakeFuelModExample replaced with your TimedAction name): return end require "ISTakeFuelModExample" require "RicksMLC_PayAtThePump" local overrideISTakeFuelNew = ISTakeFuelModExample.new function ISTakeFuelModExample:new(character, fuelStation, petrolCan, time) local this = overrideISTakeFuelNew(self, character, fuelStation, petrolCan, time) this.fuelType = "Gasoline" -- Set the fuelType if needed. -- Default is "Gasoline" if not set or set to none of overrideISTakeFuelComplete = ISTakeFuelModExample.complete function ISTakeFuelModExample.complete(self) RicksMLC_PayAtPumpAPI.handleEmergencyStop(self) overrideISTakeFuelComplete(self) end
