description: Overview : There may be multiple patterns of furniture overlay graphics, but the patterns are defined per coordinate, not per item. Therefore, when you bring furniture back to your base and place it there, you may see a different graphic than the first time you picked it up. This mod solves that problem and allows free selection of overlay graphics for furniture. And for world-placed items other than Moveable, the placement position can be adjusted. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 Stable and in MP. Features - 1.Change Furniture Display : You can change the overlay graphic freely by following the steps below. (1) Execute "Change furniture display" from the item or world context menu. (2) You can select the graphics to display from the configuration window. Press the "Select" button below the graphic you want to display. The currently selected graphic will be marked with a red circle icon in the upper right corner. "Default" will return to the original display mode. In this setting, the graphics displayed will change depending on the coordinates of the placement. Features - 2.Adjust Item Position : This feature has been integrated into vanilla as "Extended 3D Placement" in Build 42. Therefore, it has been removed from this mod in the B42 version. However, the vanilla functionality has been extended as follows: Expanded position offset range (range can be adjusted via options) Feature can now be accessed from the item's context menu You can adjust the placed item position by following the steps below. (1) Execute "Adjust item position" from the world item context menu. (2) You can change the item positions and rotations from the adjust position window. "--" button : Decrease value a lot. "-" button : Decrease value a little. "C" button : Clear value to zero. "+" button : Increase value a little. "++" button : Increase value a lot. Options : These options are available. (Only B42) Offset Range : You can extend the item's position offset range to span from negative to positive values. Sandbox Options : These options are available in Sandbox Options. (Only B41) Meta > Enable Adjust Item Position : Enables Adjust Item Position. This option is intended for cases where you want to limit this features to users in MP. Q&A : Which furniture can I select graphics? This includes container-type furniture such as shelves and furniture with overlay graphics such as chairs covered with sheets. Can furniture from other mods be made to work? It's possible, although it needs to be handled individually. Please request the mod name. How do I do a piece of large furniture that has been divided? You can select graphics in each divided part. What happens if I rotate the furniture? If the furniture is rotated, it will be processed as a different item. Therefore, please select the graphics for each direction. However, if the same direction is made again, the previous selection is kept. Already I have been selected, but before I know it, it's back to the default display..? It may have reverted to the default display for an unknown reason. Initially, small groups of armed bandits with melee weapons will appear after 24 hours in the world around ~55 tiles away from the player. description: !!! ATTENTION !!! Since build 41 is now moved into a legacy branch rather than being the default version, I am planning to remove Build 41 support from this workshop item. If you are planning to play build 41 and not lose access to the mod, please use Build 41 legacy fork of the mod instead of this one. (VVA) Vanilla Vehicles Animated What this mod does? There are many cool mods that add vehicles with openable doors, meaning the game can handle such animations. But vanilla vehicles remain as solid bricks. This mod fixes that. Vehicle models are reworked - split into multiple objects, and code added to display vanilla vehicles. As a free bonus of it - if a part is removed (or torn off) it would become visually missing, rather than tinted grey. Why are Dash Roamer, Drive90s and other modded cars no longer animated? Trying to keep the mod more focused so since they are not based on vanilla models and not all of them were transitioned to build 42 - that created a bunch of issues making sure stuff got updated correctly. So I made a hard decision to drop them from this mod. I am repackaging all the animated model patches for those vehicles and will publish them as a couple of separate workshop items - for build 41 and 42 separately. But at this moment they are just remived as a hotfix to them getting broken by latest code rafactoring. B41 or B42? Both. for now, but in near future I am planning to make this mod 42 only. Please see special notice at the top of description for a link to 41 legacy fork. Multiplayer? By itself only the local player would see animations in action. Remote players would only ubdate parts state when they moved far enough from vehicle and then returned to it so server sends current state for all parts. To fix this issue you need to use a mod that patches in server signals to update parts state when they change For build 42 use https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3685499657 For build 41 use https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2959512313 Existing save - safe? Yes. This mod only changes the way vehicles are displayed and does not interfere with save data in any way. It is safe to add or remove this mod on existing saves/servers. There are many mods in this item. Which ones I should enable? Vanilla Vehicles Animated - Main mod. Nothing works without it. disable passenger rendering (VVA_cullseats) - (optional) - The main mod enables rendering character model in the interior. But animations for characters switching seats, exiting vehicle or aiming a weapon if a window is rolled down, are not set up, so defailts ones (for character standing on ground) are used, resulting in character clipping through vehicle roof. If this bothers you - enable this mod. It will prohibit my mod adding passenger rendering. But if some other mod also enables interior character rendering it might not work. Standard Vehicle Upgrades Patch (VanillaVehiclesAnimated_SVU) - (optional) - If you wand to MadMax your vehicles using armor from Standard Vehicle Upgrades, by default the armor would be rendered static. So an open door would clip through armor plate. Enabling this optional mod patches armor definition scripts to make armor animated too. ApocalypticallySlowDoors (VVA_slowdoors) - depricated - In Build 41 version using Fancy Handwork together with this mod could cause a bug with door close animation being unable to play properly because it was running too fast. This mod slowed all animations down to avoid this bug. Pikamy's Delighter - depricated - Build 42 specific. A little mod created for Pickamy_ (follow her on Twitch!). Changes models and textures for seats of Lady Delighter specialty van to be pink with some embroidery. Snappy Doors Removes animated transitions between opened and closed states so doors/hoods/trunks snap open/closed. Requested for consistency with how building doors are not actually animated in B41, or mods that synchronize animations between different clients actually just synchronize end states. Just Vanilla Vehicles? No. Some mods that add reskins of vehicles based on vanilla models (i.e. Donny's Company Cars) are also supported. And if you know such a mod that is not supported - please let me know and I would gladly cover it in an update. Also Vanilla Vehicle Enhancer (both 41 and 42 versions) are supported, including custom models for all vehicles that match enhanced textures with geometry. Can a vanilla-model based vehicle mod hook into animations without requiring update to this mod? At this point - I feel the code is settled enough, so yes. If you are making a mod that adds more vehicles that are reskins of vanilla models - they can be easily added as long as you don't change shape of windows and headlights. Also if your mod is not based on vanilla models, I am eager to help you set up the models and scripts to have animations on their own. How many people are working on this mod? One. Just me in my free time. If you want to support me - the best way would be to show up to my Twitch streams 8am till 1pm GMT on saturdays and sundays. I mostly work on another huge mod adding animations to PZK Vanilla Like Cars pack... You can also support me on Boosty. Book 4 - Pages 500 - Available at Tier 7 - Awards 5,000XP on completion. Book 5 - Pages 800 - Available at Tier 9 - Awards 8,000XP on completion. With zero XP in a skill, Book 1 will provide all of the first level of the skill's required XP, and a small amount more. The remainer must be obtained through other means. This gives a boost initially into the skill, but still requires the player to level the skill to advance further, rather than simply skill up via books alone as some other mods offer. A character that already has the first level in that skill completed, such as a Repairman (Carpentry T1) will obtain 100XP for the second level of the skill, a decent amount but not enough to progress onto the next tier. A character that has progressed even further, such as a Carpenter (Carpentry T3) can still obtain the 100XP Book 1 offers, although for this level it is a drop in the bucket. That OCD satisfaction can be obtained without considering this a wasted effort. The same applies to every skill, for every level. As standard, the XP Multiplier that vanilla provides has been disabled, but there is a sandbox option available to restore it for those who want the easy mode. Build 42: All new skill books added. description: Build 41 & Build 42. World temperature affects the food spoilage rate as you experience seasonal and day-to-day variations. The game does not differentiate between items left outside and inside, where it is typically warmer, which is a limitation for this mod, but has been accounted for to the best of my ability. Items do not freeze unless are in the freezer, same as vanilla. Please see Outside Freezer by TwisTonFire for this functionality. Extra Notes: Because the refrigeration effectiveness sandbox setting is a flat multiplier against the decay timer, it is also adjusted to best fit realistic expectations. If I was to leave the settings alone, your food would spoil quicker if it's hotter outside. It is not possible to make food spoil faster in a refrigerator than outside, so when in doubt, use the fridge. I would recommend using Surviving Through the Seasons to make the year last less than 365 in-game days so that you can actually experience all the seasonal variations through your average playthrough length. I would also suggest KYR Real Weather with the base minimum temperature to -4°C if you want the fairly typical real-life winter lows of Kentucky. Permissions: Please do not modpack or reupload. description: Simple Silencers adds new weapon attachements to the game for vanilla firearms. They are: Suppressor: This is a factory made suppressor, and can be attached to rifles, assault rifles and pistols. This retail suppressor can NOT be attached to revolvers or shotguns. Suppressors can be found in gunstores, police stations and a few other places. Makeshift Suppresor: This has been hand-crafted, and can only be attached to pistols due to the poor quality. These can usually be found in crime-related containers. Additionally, this can be crafted by the player, provided they learn the recipe. I made this mod because the few silencer mods made specifically for vanilla firearms are either out-of-date, buggy with red errors, or apply to every firearm under the sun. Revolvers do not benefit from a suppressor - they exhaust from the chanber, not the barrel D: Shotgun suppressors are bulky - there is no universal size for every gun D: Finally, I wanted to add more balance between firearms. Revolvers are easy to reload, and shotguns are powerful from the onset, and do not need additional buffs from a suppressor mod. IMPORTANT I have added a picture that gives the general idea of how far sound will carry for each suppressor. The line designates the approximate safe distance, while the positions of the character is the point where the sound can be heard by the target group. Please note: This distance only applies to zombies with NORMAL hearing as per the "survivalist" default. Please understand that "apocalypse" zombies have RANDOMISED hearing, so different zeds will hear you from different distances! Hopefully this will finally put rest to the misconception that this mod is not working as intended. For B42: Options are back! MSR700 is default now. Yeah, I kinda got annoyed that I couldn't use a suppressor on my M3, so I took another stab at updating the mod. So, we're back to attaching suppressors uniquely. B42MP: Fixed to work for SP, haven't checked if it is working on MP. Please let me know. description: Thank you for 300k+! Massive thanks to the PZWiki and the modding discord (@StarkTruffle & @pwrcosmic) for all the super useful information on updating for B42MP. About Find and learn traits through trait magazines! All with unique and vanilla-friendly names and designs. Each magazine can also be placed on the ground and have their own unique textures! This mod is very customizable through sandbox settings, I recommend looking through them before starting a game. By default, if the player starts with a negative trait counterpart of a trait (like Disorganized vs Organized), reading the magazine will not give the positive trait but instead remove the negative trait only. This can be changed in the sandbox settings. Other sandbox settings include the option to choose which magazines spawn, toggling of a trait by rereading a magazine (for those who want to toggle Speed Demon), and an option to change the spawn rate of all magazines. Available Trait Magazines Simple traits: - Nutritionist - Outdoorsman - Handy - Ax-pert - Burglar Traits with negatives (in brackets): - Speed Demon (Sunday Driver) - Organized (Disorganized) - Fast Learner (Slow Learner) - Fast Reader (Slow Reader) - Inconspicuous (Conspicuous) - Graceful (Clumsy) - Dexterous (All Thumbs) - Keen Hearing (Deaf / Hard of Hearing) (*) (*) Reading the Keen Hearing magazine with deaf will not do anything. Finding Magazines All trait magazines can be found in common magazine locations like magazine racks and libraries. Some magazines have a higher spawn rate at certain locations. For example, "Fast Learner" can be found more commonly in schools and "Burglar" more commonly in police/evidence lockers. By default, the cheaper trait's magazines are roughly as common as Skill Vol. 1 & 2 books. The more expensive trait's magazines are roughly as rare as/rarer than "How to Use A Generator" magazines. Changing the sandbox spawn settings will multiply spawn rates accordingly: Very Low (0.05x), Low (0.25x), Default (0.5x), High (1x), Very High (2x) Supported Languages Please report any translation errors or improvements in the discussion thread. - English (EN) - Traditional Chinese (CN) - Spanish (ES) by @Trapito222 - Portuguese Brazil (PTBR) by @Rafakes - Russian (RU) by @Revil (B41) and @phxntom1213 (B42) - Korean (KO) by @MUKI - Polish (PL) by @Nacho Juarez - Turkish (TR) by @kazoo - Japanese (JP) by @sync01 - Italian (IT) by @Art Tippet - Indonesian (ID) by @Shieru - French (FR) by @Bobitec - German (DE) by @Beathoven Extra Notes I mainly made this mod because I wanted a way to learn Nutritionist, figured why not design and add magazines for other traits as well. FAQ Q: Does this work in multiplayer? A: Yes! Q: Can I add this mod mid-save / ongoing world? A: Yes, but the magazines will only spawn in unexplored chunks. If you're adding this mod on a late save, I'd recommend resetting chunks outside of your base(s) or using loot respawn. Q: Does reading magazines also give XP/level for skills? (E.g. Handy's +1 Carpentry & +1 Maintenance) A: No, reading magazines will only give the associated trait. Q: Can you add support for X mod's traits? A: Unfortunately there are too many trait mods to create magazine designs for, so I'm sticking with vanilla traits only. Though if you would like to expand or create an add-on for the mod, you have my full permission to look through the code and attempt it yourself. Q: Is this compatible with dynamic trait mods? A: Functionally, this mod simply looks through the traits you have and will add or remove it. If the mod changes the name for traits, this mod will not work. With dynamic trait mods, adding/removing traits may also be undone depending on how and when they check for conditions. Known Issues / Bugs - Some languages are missing translations, if you would like to help with translations please post them in the discussions! Before reporting bugs, please test this mod on it's own to ensure that the issue is coming from this mod, often problems reported are due to another broken or incompatible mod. If the mod produces errors by itself or if you find a mod that is incompatible, let me know in the Bug Reports discussion! Going forward, "broken build {version_number}" and similar comments will be ignored or deleted because they are frankly unhelpful and cause confusion. When posting a bug report, tell me what error you're seeing, how to replicate that error, what sandbox settings you have on, what mods you have on, and whether you are SP, Hosted MP or Dedicated Server. description: I'd like to thank everyone who supported and played this mod. Honestly i did not anticipate that it would be as popular as it turned out to be. My appreciation for TLOU series remains unchanged, as i still love The game and show but with that being said This mod will not be receiving any more updates. Over time my interest in developing this mod has degraded and ultimately i decided to focus on other projects. If there is someone who wants to patch/remake it and release it as separate mod for b42.13 and above, feel free. I'd just ask to be credited somewhere. What’s currently Included? The mod introduces a few new outfits and items inspired by factions from The Last of Us : Seraphite Outfit: -Represent the mysterious and devout Seraphites faction with this unique outfit. Jacket comes with 2 attachment slots, allowing you to attach items and quickly equip yourself with tool or weapon in times of emergency. Perfect for role-playing as one of the survivors in a more tribal-like, isolated group. Jacket can only be found on Seraphite's Zombies, spawn chance can be changed in sandbox options. FEDRA Hazmat Suit: -A specialized outfit used by FEDRA (Federal Disaster Response Agency) personnel for handling hazardous environments. Offers protection and enhances immersion, especially in dangerous scenarios. Whole outfit can be found on zombies, aswell as in military locations. FEDRA Uniform: -The standard outfit worn by FEDRA soldiers, who enforce martial law in the quarantine zones. It brings a militaristic and authoritative look to your character, ideal for role-playing as a post-apocalyptic enforcer. Whole outfit can be found on zombies, aswell as in military locations. Related Items: - The mod also introduces several craftable and faction-specific items that enhance the gameplay experience, giving players new survival tools and immersive role-playing options. These items are designed to fit the world of The Last of Us, focusing on practicality and customization. Craftable Leather Water Bottles: -Handcrafted, durable water bottles made from leather, essential for long journeys in the zombie apocalypse. Designed to help with hydration in a more rugged and immersive way, reflecting the scarcity of modern resources. Craftable Improvised Backpack: -A rugged, survival-style backpack that can be crafted by players. Unique feature: It includes 3 attachment points where you can attach various tools and items (such as melee weapons or bottles), making it versatile for carrying gear and essential supplies. Craftable Leather Pouches and Pockets: -A small, handy pouches that can be crafted and attached to your character’s Back Left or Back Right. -A pockets made from leather that can be worn on the Back Left, Back Right, Left Leg, or Right Leg of your character. Perfect for close combat, this scythe not only adds style but is a lethal weapon against zombies and other threats. Faction Armbands: Show your allegiance with unique Faction Armbands for the following groups: FEDRA (Federal Disaster Response Agency), Seraphites (The Scars), WLF (Washington Liberation Front), Fireflies, These armbands can be worn to identify yourself with one of the iconic factions, adding a layer of immersion and customization for role-playing or faction-themed gameplay. description: Map Mod Manager is a tool for managing and organizing your map mods. With a cell grid display, you can visually identify conflicts between maps, regardless of if you're subscribed to them or picked from the huge database of over 800 maps. Whether you're curating a fine collection of maps, checking your current subscriptions for conflicts or expanding your map collection, Map Mod Manager is the tool to help you do it. Now reads subscribed mod cells! The latest update enables Map Mod Manager to read your map files directly, so you don't need to wait for the database to update when a new map is released. As long as you're subscribed, it will know exactly where on the map it belongs. Currently available for Build 42 only. Features: Interactive Cell Display: View maps on a detailed grid that highlights selected mods to instantly spot conflicts - either with other mods or with vanilla map areas. Toggle Mods: Quickly enable or disable your subscribed mods and their dependencies directly in Map Mod Manager, you don't have to go back to mods to manage them. Quick Select and Filter: Quickly select map mods that don't conflict with your current selection or filter by specific cells to find compatible mods. Steam Links: Open any map or dependency workshop page directly from Map Mod Manager - if a map works with your current collection, you can update it in a few clicks and a refresh of the game. Dependency Checker: See required mods for every selected or enabled map. Hover over a dependency to see which maps are relying on it, so you don't miss anything essential - preventing in-game issues. Read Subscribed Maps (Build 42): Automatically reads the cells of any subscribed map, ensuring that even the newest maps are checked for conflicts with your collection. Export Data: The export function generates a list of selected maps, including their URL's, dependencies and multiplayer data, enabling you to quickly set up a server or share it with a mate. Re-Order Mods and MapFolders: Easily reorder both ModIDs and MapFolders. How do I use it? Enable Map Mod Manager in the mods menu, save and go back to the main menu. A button called 'Map Mod Manager' will appear under the Quit button. Select maps to show them on the cell grid, conflicting maps appear red, if they conflict with a vanilla map they appear yellow. Purple cells are map mods without conflicts, green and blue cells are vanilla maps. Hover your mouse over any cell in the grid to show what map/s are occupying that cell. If you're subscribed to a map, it will appear in the Subscribed Map Mods list, green maps are enabled. Dependencies will populate for both active mods and selected mods, active mods are green, required dependencies that aren't enabled are white, dependencies you aren't subscribed to are red. Hover over a dependency to see what map enabled it. Use the steam link next to any map or dependency to navigate to the workshop page, if you subscribe to a new mod, you'll need to quit and re-open the game for it to show up in your Subscribed Map Mods list. Buttons have tooltips, so you know exactly what they are doing. Mod changes are saved by closing the UI. Note, if you have increased your font size, you will have issues displaying the UI. Reduce your font size to default while using this mod. Important disclaimers about maps that aren't in the database: Uninstalled Dependencies: If a required dependency isn’t installed and isn’t already in the database, it won’t be listed as required. Always check the map Workshop page for any dependencies when subscribing to new maps. Mod Packs: Map Mod Manager will detect “mod packs” (workshop items that contain multiple mods). This can cause issues if you’re subscribed to both a mod pack and one of its individual mods. It’s best to avoid subscribing to both at the same time. Translations: French, thanks to Aatheom. Korean, thanks to Teray. If you'd like to translate it for me, please reach out! Check out my other mods: Quoted from JiizzJacuzzii: On Lockdown This mod cannot be modified by anyone else, for anything else, at all, ever. Even if the user disappears, he or she would much rather you didn't touch the fruits of their hard labour. You are not allowed to repack this mod under any circumstances, ever. Workshop ID: 3360392628 Mod ID: mapmodmanager

description: Overview : Adding the "Sound Scouter" to visualize sound information (Volume, Radius). This item is intended for testing purposes to understand the sound situation. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 Stable and in MP. Features : Equipping the "Sound Scouter" will visualize sound information. 1. Pin and Circle Display A pin is displayed at the sound source. The pin shows the volume (top) and radius (bottom). The color of the pin changes depending on the sound source. Player: Orange Zombie: Green Others: Gray A circle is drawn around the pin to represent the volume and radius of the sound. Volume: The color inside the circle; the larger the volume, the darker the color. Radius: The reach of the sound is represented by the size of the circle. 2. Scouter Display Equipping the Scouter will show a Scouter panel. The panel displays sound information (source, xyz-coordinates, volume, radius) in text form. Clicking the icon at the bottom of the panel will toggle the display of specific pin/circle/information ON/OFF. The panel can be moved freely, and you can close it by pressing the red button. If the panel is hidden, it can be re-displayed from the item's context menu. How to Obtain : You can obtain the "Sound Scouter" by selecting "Obtain the Sound Scouter" from the character's context menu. It can be obtained only once per character. After obtaining it, the menu will no longer be displayed. Options : In B41, These options are available with Mod Options. Sound Pins Display : When the Sound Scouter is equipped, the Sound Pins will be displayed. Sound Circles Display : When the Sound Scouter is equipped, the Sound Circles will be displayed. Scouter Panel Display : When the Sound Scouter is equipped, the Scouter Panel will display automatically. Sound Volume (Activated) : You can adjust the sound volume when the Sound Scouter is activated. Sound Volume (Deactivated) : You can adjust the sound volume when the Sound Scouter is deactivated. Sound Volume (Display Toggle) : You can adjust the sound volume when the Sound Scouter display is toggled. description: Auto Mechanics, the real one, not the AI copies. So you are here ? Ah.. you wanna play with cars but you lack experience. You've come to the right place. How to ? Get a Screwdriver, a Wrench, a Lug Wrench and a Jack. Ensure you've read the book associated with your car. Find a car you can spare, and just start training with serenity. On vehicle mechanics menu, right click any mounted part and left click on Train Mechanics button. Other Actions You can continue a previously interrupted training. You can uninstall all parts in one click. You can inflate all tires in one click. Mod Options You can set a waiting timer between mechanical actions. This allows to adapt to servers with high latency in multiplayer. You can select a threshold for uninstall attempts depending on risks of breaking the part. It is 100 (unrestricted) by default. You can use or not a pause at the end of all actions (e.g. when using time speed increase for a full training). You can re-try vanilla Uninstall and Install actions until they succeed. Verbose options are logs that reduce (a lot) performances: only for debug analysis. Sandbox Options You can enforce the failure threshold server side in multiplayer. The lowest (most restricting) value between the client value (mod option) and the server value (sandbox option) is used. It is 100 (unrestricted) by default. Tips and Tricks Any mod with invalid fixing recipe will induce errors when right clicking on some vehicle parts. "attempted index: isEmpty of non-table: null" ISVehicleMechanics.lua:224. description: You can jump. Up to 4 tiles. How to jump You must be running or sprinting. You must be in good health condition*. Press the Jump key, 'F' by default, configurable. Health condition* Each of the following points apply to the lower torso, groin, legs and feets body parts. Health must be above 50 percents. Exercise fatigue (stiffness) must be below 50 percents. No fracture. No deep wound. Endurance consumtion Run jump: 1.56% endurance. Sprint jump: 3.64% endurance. Jump distance Base Distance (Run): 1m. (1m = 1tile) Sprinting adds 1.25m (at best +1.25m). Each point in Strength and Fitness adds 0.1m (at best +2m). Each level of Endurance removes 0.5m (at worse -2m) Each level of HeavyLoad removes 0.8m (at worse -3.2m) Obese trait removes 1.25m (at worse -1.25m) Overweight trait removes 0.75m Minimum jump distance is saturated to 1m (impossible to jump 1 tile) Maximum jump distance is 4.25m (possible to jump 4 tiles). description: You can climb one level up. How to climb You can climb to a place one level higher but not directly over you. The target place must have a floor (but no stairs). The target place must have no wall window or fence blocking the climb. There must be nothing on top of your head blocking the climb. You must not be on stairs. You must be in good health conditions*. Press the Climb key, 'F' by default, configurable. Health condition* Each of the following points apply to the torsos, arms and hands body parts. Health must be above 50 percents. Exercise fatigue (stiffness) must be below 50 percents. No fracture. No deep wound. Success / Struggle / Failure Computation details: Base chance: 80% Each point in Strength and Fitness adds 2% (at best +40%) Each level of Endurance removes 10% (at worse -40%) Each level of HeavyLoad removes 16% (at worse -64%) Any trait among Emaciated / Obese / Very Underweight removes 25% (at worse -25%) Any trait among Underweight / Overweight removes 15% Each zombie attacking the player from its initial tile removes 25% (no limit) Each zombie not attacking the player from its initial tile removes 7% (no limit) Success chance: sum of all variables above - 25% Struggle chance: 25% (if Success chance < 100%). 0% (if Success chance >= 125%) Fail chance: 100% - Struggle chance - Success chance. Critical success: 1% (there is always a chance). Critical failure: 0% (no critical failure for PZ. player must be able to guarantee success if carefull). A struggle result leads to a new computation. Exemple 1 Fresh New Bill : Player with 5 fitness, 5 strength, no moodle, no trait, no zombie around. Base = 80% + 2%*(5+5) = 100%. Success = Base -25% => 75%. Struggle = min(Base,25) = 25%. Failure = 0%. Exemple 2 Zero (Wannabe Hero) : Player with 0 fitness, 0 strength, First Endurance moodle, Obese trait, one zombie attacking. Base = 80% - 10% - 25% -25% = 20%. Success = Base - 25% => 1%. (critical success only) Struggle = min(Base,25)-critical success = 19%. Failure = 80%. Exemple 3 Hero (Experienced Zero) : Player with 10 fitness, 10 strength, First Endurance moodle, no trait, one zombie attacking. Base = 80% + 2%*(10+10) - 10% -25% = 85%. Success = Base - 25% => 60%. Struggle = min(Base,25) = 25%. Failure = 15%. Endurance consumtion Success: 6.24% endurance. Failure: 6.24% endurance. Struggle: 2.6% endurance per struggle. Warnings Animation is clunky. You will get access to places you usually don't: beware the holes in some roofs. Close range teleport is used. I've not had any death while climbing, but I cannot guaranty you wont. description: CDC RAPID RESPONSE 2 IS OUT NOW FOR B42! ALSO RELEASED ON B41 FOR YOUR MP ENJOYMENT! Check out CDC Rapid Response II - Air Traffic, out now! The CDC is Responding to the Knox Event The CDC has organized an emergency response to what they call the KX93185 virus. Viral test kits, medications, and antidotes have been made available via airdrop and checkpoint distribution. The county has been flooded with supplies to combat this plague, and the DoD has responded with forced quarantines. The response was impressive and calculated. The CDC reported that the virus was simple in nature and easy to cure. This effort seemed hopeful as the National Guard delivered what was needed by land and air. But as time passed, it became clear that it was too late. The remnants of this effort are all that remain... Drug Overhaul All drugs have been overhauled and are now more dangerous to use, with delayed and/or prolonged effects. Misusing CDC drugs can severely harm or even kill you. Viral Test Kits - Viral Test Kits provide an overly complicated and adequately frustrating experience to ensure you test yourself correctly. - Consumer Grade Tests: Provide solid results quickly (if you read the directions! "Did we remember to put those in?", wonders a lab tech). - Premium Grade Tests: Provide better results and are easier to use. - Weathered Test Kits: These might help you... or just give you false hope. - Packaged Viral Test Kits contain everything you need, but you're more likely to find loose components of these kits. - The Viral Test Kit system now requires the user to use a sialogogue or equivalent. (Built-in PZ systems allow for other methods—figure it out, or die trying.) Kit Types: - Consumer Viral Test: Test for the virus. - Premium Viral Test: 100% accuracy. - Weathered Test Kits: Good luck! Medications Medications are now more dangerous. Use them cautiously and prepare accordingly—especially when using unfamiliar ones. Poor health or unknown preexisting conditions can lead to sickness or death. - Consumer Grade Medications: Assist with infections but may cause sickness or death, particularly for those with preexisting conditions. - Premium Medications: Safer and more effective but still require careful use. - Weathered Medications: These may have been sitting in filth for years. Would you trust your life to a pill found in a drain? - Medications can be found packaged or as loose pills. Medication Types: - Bitezapro: 24-48 hour protection (with side effects). - Fevarax: 48-72 hour protection (with side effects). - Humanox: 24-48 hour protection (with side effects). - Salivix: 48-72 hour protection (with side effects). - Zomboflex: 24-48 hour protection (with side effects). - Zedalis: 36-48 hour protection (with side effects). - Weathered Pills: Who knows what they do?! - Viazom: 5-day protection (no side effects, single-use inhalant). - Several secret medications—where could they be? Antidotes Antidotes provide a cure but come with risks. They allow you to start over and survive this terrible new world. - Low-quality antidotes are painful and risky—only the strongest will survive their effects. ("Burns like 1,000 suns!") - High-quality antidotes are safer but require proper preparation and a calm environment. - Weathered Syrettes: Found in the wild. Use them at your own peril. Antidote Types: - Globunex: Cures infection (with side effects). - Novaulin: Cures infection (with side effects). - Sovextin: Cures infection (with side effects). - KX9 Spike: Cures infection (no side effects). - Roto-mRNA: Cures infection (no side effects). - Weathered Syrette: Don’t do it!! CDC Packages and Airdrops - Over 1,000 tons of medical aid were delivered via air and ground. Supplies were distributed at checkpoints and public facilities or delivered directly to homes. As the virus spread, secure zones fell, and airdrops became the primary method of delivery—until they stopped entirely. Airdrop Types: - CDC Yellow Airdrop: Low-grade items. - CDC Orange Airdrop: Mid-grade items. - CDC Red Airdrop: High-grade items. - CDC Weathered Airdrop: Wet and gross! Package Types: - CDC Family Pack: Supplies for families. - CDC Clinical Pack: Supplies for clinics. - CDC First Responder Pack: Supplies for first responders. - CDC Weathered Pack: Looks beat up but may contain something useful. Hardcore Mode Packages For a more challenging experience with low drop rates: - Bundle of Items in Aluminum - Bundle of Items in Fabric - Bundle of Items in Bottle - Bundle of Items in Jar - Bundle of Items in Wallet - Large Bundle of Items in Paper - Small Bundle of Items in Paper Secret and Unknown Items - Military-use items with mysterious purposes. What do they do? How do you use them? Who knows! Literature As the virus spread, so did misinformation. The CDC responded with leaflets and printed guides, delivered en masse from the skies by helicopters. Literature Types: - CDC General Guide - CDC Medication Guide - CDC Antidote Guide - 7 Different CDC Leaflets Sandbox Settings - Customize loot rates and systems. - Control how medications and cures affect the player. Hardcore Mode - Simulate a smaller CDC response or experience the world years later, where CDC materials are nearly extinct. If you’re lucky, you may find old remnants (bundles of items). New Lore - Expanded lore around the DoD and CDC efforts in Knox County. Special Features - Dormancy (Default: Enabled): Improved dormancy features for better survival mechanics. - Wound Contamination (Default: Disabled): Risk of infection in exposed wounds. - Hardcore Treatments (Default: Disabled): Prolonged effects of CDC drugs may kill the player. Tested in single-player only at this time. Please report bugs in the comments. Support I love modding PZ—thank you for your support! Keep me caffeinated and coding Thank you! description: This mod has been officially integrated into vanilla in version 42.3, so it is no longer needed. It will no longer work in 42.3 and only functions properly in versions 42.0 to 42.2. Adds a rollback version of the rain collector barrel from Build 41. You can craft it by right-clicking on the ground -> Carpentry -> Furniture -> Rain Collector Barrel. When crafted through the ground -> Carpentry -> Furniture, it becomes the Build 41 version of the rain collector barrel. If crafted through the Building Menu -> Outdoors menu, it becomes the Build 42 version of the rain collector barrel. 1. Fully functional in Build 42.2 2. To connect plumbing, the rain collector barrel must be crafted through the right-click Build menu and must not be pickup after crafting 3. Compatible with lifestyle mod like bathing and showering 4. Plumbing can be connected in basements. Since the visible basement terrain often doesn’t match its actual location, if you wish to connect plumbing in a basement, it is recommended to use the Plumb Helper PLUS [B42] mod. 5. To ensure rainwater accumulates even outside loaded chunks, enable the "Fixing the Rain Update Bug" option in the sandbox settings. 6. In Build 42, there are two types of garbage bags: TrashBag and GarbageBag. The rain collector barrel can only be crafted using GarbageBag. The mod includes a recipe to convert TrashBag into GarbageBag, which can be used if needed. 7. The capacity unit of the rain collector barrel is in liters (L) instead of milliliters (ml). When pouring water into the barrel, make sure to do so in 1000ml increments. 8. This mod is compatible with the Irrigation Pipe Mod. Water synchronization and watering crops work correctly. If vanilla fertilizer is fixed in the future, an automatic fertilizing feature will also be added. How to Connect Plumb 1. Sinks and washing machines must be located indoors. 2. The rain collector barrel must be newly crafted through the right-click "Carpentry" menu on the ground. 3. The rain collector barrel must be placed "Outdoors" (otherwise, rainwater won't accumulate). 4. Demolishing the walls or roof of a pre-existing building on the map does not change its designation to "Outdoor." (The "Indoor" designation is fixed based on coordinates.) 5. A pipe wrench is required. 6. The rain collector barrel must be located directly above the sink or washing machine within a 3x3 range. 7. For the same reason as above, it is not possible to connect pipes across more than two floors simultaneously. 8. Once all the preparations above are complete, right-click the sink and select "Plumb" Sandbox Options 1. Fixing the Rain Update Bug Currently, in version 42, water in rain barrel is updated only while it is raining If you move to a region with rain barrel after the rain has stopped in another area, the water that should have accumulated during the rain will not update and will instead be updated all at once the next time it rains. Enabling this option fixes this issue. However, as the status of rain barrel is checked every 10 minutes, there may be slight frame drops depending on the number of rain barrels 2. Allow snow to fill the rain collector barrel However, the fill speed is 1/4 that of rain. Workshop ID: 3392186516 Mod ID: RollBackRainCollectorBarrel

description: With this mod looting is done automatically. With this mod store your loot in one click. So you are here ? Ah.. you're bored of spending your life looting dead corpses and searching through furnitures.. You've come to the right place. How to access your loot selection You can (and should) change your configuration. You can access the configuration page: By pressing the key selected under OPTIONS >> MODS >> Auto Loot >> Change Configuration (default key is NONE). How to modify your loot selection On the configuration page, you have tools to help you change your configuration quickly: Filter on unique ID. Filter on displayed name. Filter on category through a combo box. Filter on display category through a combo box. Green and red buttons apply on current filter. Double click on an item for individual selection. See this video for a full exemple of the configuration interface. Alternatively -I do not recommend but- you can add/remove an item type through contextual menu. Toggle ON / OFF Toggle Auto Loot ON / OFF by pressing the text button on vanilla inventory window, next to vanilla "Transfer All" button. Toggle Auto Loot ON / OFF by pressing the key selected OPTIONS >> MODS >> Auto Loot >> Toggle On / Off (default key is NONE). How to store your loot ? This functionnality is an evolution of the great mod SmartStack. By clicking on Store All icon/button (next to "Auto Loot ON / OFF" button), all items that are not equipped or favorite will be spread onto any reachable container that already has an instance of the same item. Annex functions Sandbox option Loot Mode allows select one single mod for the whole server. Sandbox options allows to deactivate bag priority option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu). Sandbox options allows to deactivate bag filter option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu). Sandbox options allows to deactivate bag activation/inhibition option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu). Sandbox options allows to deactivate item type add/remove option (if you find the function useless and do not wanna clog your contextual menu). You can permanently inhibit Auto Loot on a furniture or vehicle through a contextual "Inhibit/Activate" toggle. Inventory icon of modded item is corrected in the Item List (for the Autoloot configuration). Inventory weight overlap is corrected. You have questions ? Works in solo and multiplayer. Can be added / removed mid game. The mod still works, it will be tagged obsolete otherwise. Check the tutorial video. This version si for B42 and further. Check this other mod for B41 version. Many other questions are answered in the FAQ. If you still have questions or problem reports, ask on Official PZ Discord: mod_support channel. Tips & Limitations Keep default settings (except loot configuration) for a vanilla friendly experience. Set Auto Loot OFF in order to not plunder your own carefully ordered base. This comes with these constraints: - New member will be spawned next to your leader (the character you created in the main menu) and you can only add new member when controlling the leader - When a member dies, they cannot be revived and is removed from the party - When the leader dies, you can create a new character as the leader, and your party would be kept the same - When someone in the party sleeps, their fatigue status will be set for all other party members when they wake up, since sleeping in this game is weird and also UI based, not all player based Vehicle constraints Due to vehicle registering and rendering differently than player, I have to enforce this so no one can crash their game. If there's at least one out of all local members (members within the currently rendered cell, about 300x300 from the selected member) inside a vehicle, you have to make sure they exit the vehicle before being able to switch to members that are outside of the currently rendered cell. If you , however, walk away from members inside a vehicle until they are outside of render range, open the party radial menu will force kick them out of the vehicle. tl;dr: if you wanna switch to a far away member, make sure all the closeby members (usually the one that you can select) are not in a vehicle. Simple AI (Experimental) When unfocused member are close, they will: Attempt to drink / eat when thirsty / hungry, only when drink (only select few liquid container for now) / food is in inventory Read existing books, newspaper and magazine when bored. Note that for B42, the reading system is reworked. The AI may reread an already read book and yield no benefit, other than immersion Command (Experimental) You can ask a member to follow you by right click on top of them and choose the "Ask ... to follow" option You can ask a member to stop follow you by right click on top of them and choose the "Ask ... to stop follow" option Random event (Experimental) When switching to a member that is far away, there's a 10% a random event is trigger on that member. Random events currently available are: Eat when hungry, even if no food is in the inventory prior to switching Drink when thirsty, even if no drink is in the inventory prior to switching More events will be added in the future! Controller You can access the party radial menu by selecting the new "Party" option in your "Select" radial menu. Once the menu pops up, use right thumbstick to highlight slice and confirm the slice with "Right Bumper" Note that the character creation does not work with controller yet, it's currently still cooking! Known bugs - On Build 42, the characters that isn't the currently controlled one have their model disappeared. This is due to the new lighting change and for some reason IndieStone specifically told the renderer not to render another player object (FBORenderCell @ line 3527). Thanks Naneek for the FBO cell rendering discovery! There is now a temporary fix for this, but you need to patch your game by overwriting some game files, instruction is provided here. Frequently asked questions Why is the limit 8? - I ran out of distinguishable color. Are non-leader members their separate entities, with their own moodles and stats? - Yep. Every character has their own moodles and stats, just like in multiplayer. The only thing that they share right now is level of exhaustion, since there's the limit in the base game where each player can only sleep once every certain amount of time. It's a pain in the neck to get them all to sleep though, I wouldn't think anyone would like to tuck them all to sleep at the same time, so it works out this way. Does this work with B41 / B42? - Yes, the mod works with both B41 and B42 Is this multiplayer compatible? - I haven't tested it, but I would say no, since a lot of things are hardcoded for 1 player. Try it if you want, but you have been warned. What mods are compatible? - Mods that modifies character such as traits, stats, etc. are most likely not compatible (unless they have a module for integration). You can always try and let me know which one is and which one isn't. If you found it incompatible, why not just ask if they can integrate? It's easy, I promise! Just send them this thread Why are some members disabled on the radial menu? Why can't I select them? - Check the Vehicle constraints section above! Mod integration You can learn more on how to integrate your mod into this system thru this thread Credits Massive thanks to: - nolanritchie for his work on Superb Survivor, a lot of discoveries helped making this mod - Naneek for the FBO cell rendering discovery - Jianghao for CN translation - JimmyCC for KO translation And all early subscribers for testing out and reporting issues! Like the mod? Buy me a coffee if you can :) Workshop ID: 3395761583 Mod ID: RiskyPartySystem

description: Fellow modders: IsoPlayer ModData.Moodles was removed. If you own a mod accessing it directly, please remove that access. Use MF.getMoodle and check against nil. That should be enough. Makes it easy to add moodles for modders. This version may have frequent updates that we do not wanna bother B41 MP players with. Moodle Framework Configuration If you want colors to be easier to distinguish, you can set to white the reference color for moodles (default on). This applies to both vanilla and modded moodles. You can also deactivate various displays to enhance mod compatibility. Modded Backgrounds with small extensions right or down are now handled too. How to create a new moodle If you wanna create a Moodle * then follow the next steps, replacing * by your moodle name. 1/ Moodle Texture Add Moodle *.png under media\ui. Should be 30 by 30 pixels png with alpha enabled. Note you can also has specific textures per moodle level: e.g. *_Bad_2.png or *_Good_4.png 2/ Texture Add the following text under media\lua\shared\Translate\EN\Moodles.json { "Moodles_*_Good_lvl1": "text_1", "Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl1": "text_desc_1", "Moodles_*_Good_lvl2": "text_2", "Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl2": "text_desc_2", "Moodles_*_Good_lvl3": "text_3", "Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl3": "text_desc_3", "Moodles_*_Good_lvl4": "text_4", "Moodles_*_Good_desc_lvl4": "text_desc_4", "Moodles_*_Bad_lvl1": "text_1", "Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl1": "text_desc_1", "Moodles_*_Bad_lvl2": "text_2", "Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl2": "text_desc_2", "Moodles_*_Bad_lvl3": "text_3", "Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl3": "text_desc_3", "Moodles_*_Bad_lvl4": "text_4", "Moodles_*_Bad_desc_lvl4": "text_desc_4" } (json format: don't put a comma on the last entry) You can implement only a subset of this as long as you call only the implemented part. 3/ Moodle object creation Add these lines in your mod: require "MF_ISMoodle" MF.createMoodle(*); 4/ Moodle value updates Access your moodle from your code with require "MF_ISMoodle" MF.getMoodle(*,playerNum):setValue(myNewMoodleValue)--float 0.0 <= myNewMoodleValue <=1.0 Missing playerNum will make the mod incompatible with SplitScreen. For tuning options see dedicated discussion Limitations Not tested with splitscreen. (it is expected to work since last version) Oscillations are not based on vanilla value and the behaviour may depend on performances. Credits where it is due This is inspired from the (removed) mod Zombie Camouflage moodle management by the awesome Dislaik. description: Introduction A realistic/hardcore Ammo Reloading mod. You can find "basic"/"easy mode" version here: - Ammo Crafting (Simple) There's a compatibility submod for Rain's Fireams and Gun Parts mod, enable it only if you use Rain's mod Find the Ammo Reloading Toolset in various locations where you may find ammo or guns, as well as in pawnshops. It is initially found inside of containers and can be placed like toasters/microwaves, and relocated later. The drop rates are balanced for single player game, with rare random chance to find it in select locations. How to obtain it - There's a minimal chance to randomly find it in various locations and containers with tools. - There's a very small chance to find it in metalworking shops, among ranger tools and in survival gear locations. - There's a small chance to find it in all locations where you may find firearms or with hunting gear/army surplus rare crates. - There's a noticeable chance to find it in Gun stores, in hunters' caches, in pawnshops and in safehouses. - Once you obtain Metalworking level 5, you can craft it from multiple tools (check screenshots). What does it do The mod adds: - A portable "Ammo Reloading Toolset" furniture item that can be found in pawnshops/safehouses/gun-related areas. - Empty ammo casings, bullet cores of each caliber. - Ability to disassemble ammo into components and reload it. - Lead scrap and ability to break items into lead scrap. Turn lead scrap into bullet cores. - More ways to obtain brass scrap. Turn brass scrap into empty ammo casings. - Distribution of lead/brass scrap items into the world. With the toolset, you obtain a variety of new reactions. The mod also adds Scrap Lead. It also adds Scrap Brass and Lead Pipe to various junk/bin containers. New Recipes - Make Scrap Brass (any surface). Hammer brass nameplates, brass ingots, saxophones and trumpets into 2 Scrap Brass. - Make Scrap Lead (any surface). Hammer Lead Pipe, DumbBells, BarBells and Car Batteries into 1 Scrap Lead. - Melt bullet cores into lead chunks (furnace). Takes 1 bullet core, returns 1 scrap lead chunk. - Melt scrap lead chunks (furnace). Takes 10 scrap lead chunks, returns 1 scrap lead. - Forge <caliber> bullet mold (in any forge). They are made out of "Iron Blocks" (check attached image to see how to get them) using a hammer, tongs and a chisel. The bullet mold requires you to find the recipe in "Moden Metalworking at Home", "Small-Scale Smithing" or "No Man's Land". The recipes are auto-learnt at Blacksmith skill level 5. - Make <caliber> bullet core (in any furnace). Use a bullet mold, tongs, lead scrap and charcoal to create 10 bullet <caliber> cores. - Make Empty Casings (Ammo Reload Toolset). Press [Scrap Lead/Scrap Metal/Scrap Sheet Metal] into 10 Empty Casings. - Disassemble 1/5/10 <caliber> bullets (Ammo Reload Toolset). Receive 1/5/10 GunPowder, Empty Casings and <caliber> bullet cores. - Reload 1/5/10 <caliber> ammo (Ammo Reload Toolset). Takes 1/5/10 of [<caliber> bullet core, empty casing, gunpowder], produces 1/5/10 <caliber> ammo. All vanilla ammo types are supported (9mm, .38, .44, .45, .223, .308, 5.56, shotgun shells). Recommended mods - Make gunpowder from charcoal and fertilizer. - Make Charcoal in kiln to craft gunpowder from. - Process scrapmetal for more crafting options regarding scrap metal, including more ways to obtain it. Future plans - Once Beta42 introduces Brass economy (the metal is already in the game, albeit barely used), the mod will receive more advanced features. - Once Multiplayer is working, a Multiplayer-friendly drop rate will be released as a separate mod, to allow more people on servers playing with these tools. description: This version of True Music Jukebox is exclusively for Build 42. If you are still playing Build 41 for the better gamepad support and multiplayer, please follow this link to True Music Jukebox B41. Are you tired of swapping cassettes and vinyls after every track? Is the effort to find batteries doing more damage to your sanity than the zombie apocalypse, itself? Well, now you can load hundreds of cassettes and vinyls from the infamous True Music into a handy multipurpose jukebox and dance until you're undead! Unfortunately, Build 42 does not yet have multiplayer, but we will look into that in the future. 1. First remove and then unsubscribe from the old version of True Music Jukebox! (!!!) 2. Get True Music (and it's prerequisites) 3. Subscribe to some good True Music track packs. 4. Find or build yourself an epic jukebox (but don't forget electricity)! 5. Turn it on, fill it with cassettes and vinyls, and crank it up to ELEVEN! * How to Use Jukeboxes To use a jukebox, simply interact with it once after finding or placing it in the world and turn it on. This will convert the jukebox into a container object. After that, you can move (or "load") True Music cassettes and vinyls into the jukebox. Once tracks have been loaded, you can play them using either any loaded track's inventory menu or the jukebox interaction menu. Powered jukeboxes will play continuously. You can create a queue of specific tracks that will play next in the loaded playlist, and you can lock the queue if you want to loop through a subset of loaded tracks. Jukeboxes can hold ELEVENTY arbitrary Zomboid weight units (110 AZWU) of your finest tapes and vinyl records. There is no track limit. By default, zombies will be attracted to the sound of the jukebox up to 50 squares away. The range at which zombies can hear a jukebox at full volume can be set using sandbox options. * Jukebox sound is controlled by Ambient Volume in sound settings. Jukebox Therapy and Nutrition Jukeboxes can be given the power to improve the moods and health of players who hear them in many ways; they can even quench your thirst if you want them to be that magical. These features are off by default; enable them in sandbox options if they are up your alley! Jukebox Icons This mod features icons to help people navigate its menus nonverbally. All buttons still do what their button text says they will do; buttons that say "play", "enable", or "turn on" do exactly that. However, the icon for buttons that toggle things on and off will reflect the CURRENT state of that option, not the state it will be in after it's pressed. We made this decision because we wanted the icons to appear "on" when the associated toggle is "on" - e.g., the Jukebox icon is green when it's on. This pattern can be inverted on our game options page. Portable Jukebox Keys Want to remotely access a jukebox's playlist and queue? Simply enable portable jukebox keys via sandbox options, add a jukebox to your key ring via the jukebox's main menu, and open the context menu on your (or any) key ring to control the box at any range. You may rename jukeboxes to remember locations more easily. Controller input is supported via the in-game keyboard. Range Options In sandbox options, you can determine the audible sound range of the jukebox (a special setting exists for zombies); note, however, that our option for players will only work if you use our custom sound mode (the default sound mode of this mod). If you are using Project Zomboid's 3D sound effects, however, be aware that we are not able to control the sound range; it will drop off in volume according to whatever is deemed realistic by Project Zomboid. Jukebox Hero Want to get a jukebox as fast as possible? Just choose the Jukebox Hero trait at character creation, and you will spawn with a Jukebox Starter Kit for building your very own jam station! You will also learn a recipe for making jukeboxes out of scrap. 3D Audio Effects True Music boomboxes and cassette players use 3D audio effects that many people find annoying because they have excessive bias toward one ear, and that ear is often the wrong ear (it's based on player position, not head orientation). We do not like the sound of that audio, so we replaced it with something we like much better. However, you may enable that form of 3D audio using both game options (for the individual level) and sandbox options (if you want to force your entire server to use the same 3D sound as True Music). Just be aware that we do not control the audible range of that sound mode. Multiplayer Sync We have spent many hours confirming that you will hear the same songs as other people, and tracks will change at almost the same time. Feel free to contact us if you believe you have ideas that can significantly improve this aspect of the mod! We have not seen any desync in testing lately; however, if for some unexpected reason a jukebox does become desynced for one or more players, there are two things that will likely fix this. If the data is only wrong clientside, reconnecting should fix the issue; if the jukebox data is somehow corrupted serverside, then picking up a jukebox and putting it back down will reset its data. Game Options True Music Jukebox now has its own page in the Game Options menu, where players can control a wide range of settings from jukebox volume to hiding menu options. Translations We want True Music Jukebox to be available to every player in every language! Please learn more via our permanent discussion about language support. Update Schedule We will push feature updates on Sundays at 10 PM EST whenever those updates are ready. Discord Server Come join the True Music Jukebox community on Discord! In the future, we plan to warn people there if we need to do an unscheduled update for any reason (such as bug fixes that we consider urgent). We are also able to respond to usage questions, bug reports, translation requests, and feature suggestions faster on Discord. Please join us! Compatibility This mod was written and will continue to be improved with compatibility as a high priority. It was tested alongside hundreds of mods, and it was fully compatible with all of them. It also integrates smoothly with Lifestyle: Hobbies. If you have any information regarding a potential incompatibility, please visit us on Discord and ping us! You can add this midsave. Starter kits and manuals will not spawn in places that the server has already initialized with items. *** may have compatibility issues with other b42 mods as not everything has been tested together *** Modpacks Please read our Modpacks discussion. Other Mods by Norby007 See my other mods for mixed insanity: FunctionalAppliances - Now with More Brews! Other Mods by Burryaga Burryaga is a Wookiee. Check out his Steam Workshop for a variety of useful mods! Workshop ID: 3398874593 Mod ID: TrueMusicJukebox

description: Does not work yet in 42.13.1 MP, it will require a complete recode because all item movement is server side now Welcome to the Industrial Revolution B42! Added new functionality for Industrial Revolution Vehicle Parts to spawn vehicles. Use factory pieces to build an auto-sorting lair, machines that build and repair items, or saw everything down to dust... This release version uses Factory Pieces add on to run. In order to build the machines you need to find the 5 magazines from Factory Pieces first: Factory Life Magazine Volume 1: Go Conveyourself! Factory Life Magazine Volume 2: CNC & Me! Factory Life Magazine Volume 3: I SAW it all! Factory Life Magazine Volume 4: Sorting out your life! Green Oven Silo Generator Design Manual With these mods combined, you can build factory pieces from scratch and use them to activate existing factories or make a new fresh factory of your own. The launch version has a limited recipe list with the idea for growth, please drop your ideas for recipes on the discord, discussions or in the comments below. https://discord.gg/W5zapqD9JD New Exhaust Fans in B42! Build them in a square where you place your generator to extract the fumes from it out of the building. All automatically, but the fans will not start until power is there and will not extract unless a running generator is under the fans in the same square. Conveyors These will push items from place to place and in factories these will come pre loaded with items based on the factory type. Added the ability to push items to the vehicles through the conveyor belts. These now add items to multiple containers in a square. Conveyor Lifters These will push items from floor to floor. (You will need to read the magazine if you haven't since the update to get the lifters) Track Lifters These will take items from place to place up high and will also fill multiple containers in a square. They can filter by item type. Example: They can pull wood planks only or a list of items. Robotic Claws These will take items from vehicles and containers. They can sort into a separate direction items based on conditions and move the rest a different direction. They will also attack zombies in the target pick up square, strip the bodies of items, place the items into the deliver to square, and dispose of the body. Should one wander in... UPM - Universal Production Machines These will sort items based on display categories and is compatible with Better Sorting. There is also a consolidation mode that will hold back partial items until a full item can be created. During the process it also kicks forward any empty containers with version 1.13. These machines can now change direction as well, the other outputs and filters switch to match as it turns. Saws These can be used to cut logs to planks, planks to sticks, sticks to scrap wood. They can also cut metal sheets to small metal sheets, small metal sheets into scrap metal, and scrap metal into unusable metal. With Authentic Z loaded, you can throw corpses onto the belt and the saws will turn them into tainted meat chunks. Control terminals These can be configured to control 3 milling machines at once. Drum and Tower Hoppers These are used to hold secondary materials that can be used in automated production. Milling machines These can have recipes added into them to repair some basic items as well as create new items. The drum and tower hoppers need to be placed alongside the mill for it to find them as seen in the photos. Mills will show the materials needed for the items to be made. The primary item needed should enter via the conveyors and the secondary materials should be in the hoppers or on the conveyor input. The repair process can now repair items with less than max condition so you don't need to wait for something to break. Recipes can now include fluid input, with a placeholder item in the recipe and a container of the right fluid in the hoppers. Industrial Conveyor Ovens Used to thaw or cook foods with a trip through the machine, one for each step in the process. From frozen to thawed and then room temp to cooked. No chance of burning. Auto Butcher Used to attack zombies and animals that wander too close, cutting them up, taking their items and depositing them inside it's storage compartment. Blood from the butchering can be stored in fluid containers placed on the west side of the butcher for collection under the fluid output. It can be configured to push items in a direction of choice which will fill stacked boxes, conveyors, or load into vehicles. Any sprite based containers will do. See video for more information. https://youtu.be/MhHh-kHEwkw Volume Slider: All New! A volume slider for the machines has been added to the mod options screen. Saws are terrible at perfect component extraction, so a deconstruction option was added to milling machines. Example: the baseball factory by default can convert logs into baseball bats, add nails into a drum or tower hopper and switch the recipe to spiked baseball bats and it will create them from baseball bats. Set direction and power on any of the devices. Right clicking on the objects will bring up basic menus to configure them. One of my favorite parts is coming home and dropping all my loot on a conveyor, the conveyor brings them through the sorters and dumps the materials by category into the boxes or on more conveyors. For instance, you can put a freezer next to the UPM in sorting mode and set food to be pushed into them. You can also configure the directions for the filters to send multiple categories into the same box with one sorter. Recipe Add-Ons Now Possible! This new version in v1.17 now unlocks the hard coding between this mod and the recipes it uses. It also pulls in lists using event triggers (Thank you, Elyon!). In the coming days I will explain how to make the add-on mods to pull outside recipes into this mod. Add-ons already created by other modders: Industrial Revolution Craftable Projectiles Add-on https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3364732874 Industrial Revolution Brita Add-on https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3364732562 Now compatible with Organized Categories. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3370707195 **Added an update with a sandbox option to force add-on mod categories to float to the top of the filtered category lists.** This has been tested in multiplayer and can be added to an existing game. Make sure you have the prerequisites! Workshop ID: 3400131934 Mod ID: IndustrialRevolution

But most of the people are not. Be careful, even in the beginning, the people are already nervous which is the first symptom of what is to come. There are many hidden features that you will have to discover yourself. Your will receive some clues during sleep. Please do not post spoilers in the comments. Instead, it’s supposed to be funny, so take it lightly when things don’t go as planned. Based on your feedback, I may refine it over time. Don’t expect a peaceful experience either. You won’t get a leisurely seven-day grace period without zombies to prepare. Things escalate quickly, and the intensity ramps up fast. Decrease overall operating system volume and restore in-game volume to 60%+ Q: Can I interact with NPCs? A: Press "T" to chat with them. Use American English, type simple sentences, avoid spelling mistakes. Q: Where are the trailers? A: Initially they are removed as they spawn in middle of the roads, which does not make sense. Later you can find them. description: B42.1.0 update: Sandbox options now includes a control for discomfort that will affect the maximum discomfort you will experience from your clothing. This mod affects the rate at which you reach the maximum discomfort level of your clothing, and still works in B42.1.0. If you just want to reduce/disable the total discomfort from clothing then use sandbox settings, if you want to keep the eventual discomfort but have a longer amount of time before it bothers your character then use this mod. Ever thought "wearing a respirator isn't nice, but it doesn't send me into a spiral of depression within five minutes" or perhaps "wearing a bulletproof vest all day would suck, but surely it takes more than ten minutes before I'm screaming in agony"? This mod slows the rate of discomfort increase, meaning you can wear protective gear for longer before you see the discomfort moodle and associated sadness increase. By default discomfort will go up at 10% but drop back down at 100% speed after removing gear, but these values can be adjusted in sandbox settings. This mod does not affect the maximum discomfort value reached, just how long it takes to get there. FAQ Can this be added to/removed from an existing save? Yes. Can this safely be added to/removed from an existing save? Also yes. Will this mod work in multiplayer? Yes. What does the "Ticks between checks" sandbox option do? For performance reasons this mod doesn't correct discomfort every frame. If you're using a mod that shows the discomfort meter directly this will result in it raising and lowering every X frames, which can be distracting. Either turn off the discomfort meter and just wait for moodles to show up, or lower the number of ticks in this setting. A value of 1 will run on every frame update and completely eliminate any flicker, and while I can't notice any performance issue like this it does seem excessive. description: Adds information about sowing season, optimal sowing months and risky sowing months to the item tooltip of seeds and (empty) seed packets. Only displays this information if seasons are enabled and the player knows the season recipe for the respective seed or has a Farming Level of 6 or higher (adjustable in mod options). Also updates the sowing context menu tooltip to correctly display available data about minimum water level needed, average time to grow, sowing season, optimal sowing months and risky sowing months. Update for 42.20.0 Removed a string that contained an unescaped percentage symbol. Update for 42.15.0 Removed the dependency on Starlit Library for now, since its tooltip rendering method broke after the latest update. The mod now uses a different tooltip rendering method instead. Update for 42.12.0 Mod still works fine without updates. Sowing months displayed in the "Known Recipes" or the right-click context menu have been fixed, so you wouldn't need my mod for this fix alone any longer. Update for 42.1.0 Please make sure to have the updated version of my mod or the months displayed in the tooltips and in the "Known Recipes" menu will be incorrect (shifted forward by one month). This mod automatically adjusts and sorts all vehicles into three distinct categories to emphasize the gameplay specific use The goal is to make every vehicle class feel good to have Quiet - The explorers choice, so quiet that barely anyone will know about your presence. Can reach good speeds, though avoid towing other vehicles and leaving the paved roads. (mostly Standard vehicles) Strong - The loot goblin delight, tow whatever wherever. Loud, sluggish and relatively slow. (mostly Heavy Duty vehicles) Fast - Fun and versatile vehicles, on the road they can tow other vehicles on par with Strong class while being quieter. (mostly Sports vehicles) General rules inside each class The heavier the vehicle, the more horse power it will have. This is static and not affected by installed parts or cargo More horse power == more speed == more noise Mod Compatibility Load it after other vehicle mods By default supports KI5 vehicles including Bikes and ATA Jaap Wrungel Should work well with other vehicle mods. You might need to add custom entries to Sandbox Options for example when Quiet (Standard) vehicle like Dash Rancher (OffRoad) is supposed to be Strong (Heavy Duty) follow the example of the default entries This is a direct successor to Offroad Go Brrr and is not meant to be used with it, especially in B42 Compatible with Effortless Towing Notes Should work well with everything Can be added/removed to/from existing saves. description: RESTORE UTILITIES IN B42 This is a simple port of Restore Utilities to B42, on a separate branch to hopefully make things less chaotic as this port is missing a critical feature of the mod THERE ARE NO AREAS TO REPAIR AT BY DEFAULT The official mapping tools have not yet been updated for B42, so the map part of this mod will not be brought over to B42 for now. However, as of March 2026, there is now a sub-mod you can enable that will add repair locations to the base map. In the sub-mod, the power repairs can be performed at a substation south-east of Louisville , the water repairs can be performed inside a small computer room in the water treatment plant, south of Rosewood If you'd like to automatically add these areas to the official PZ map, click here, then press "Add to existing markers". (Make sure you swap the map over to B42 in the top-left corner, it may be on B41 by default!) If I don't want to use the sub-mod, how do I perform utility repairs? The same admin/debug menu as before still works for you to place and delete repair zones. However, you may not want to use debug mode if you're doing a serious playthrough, so in another new sub-mod I added 2 new items that will let you place either of the utilities at a place of your choosing. They require level 1 electrical and 20 electronic scrap + 1 advanced electronic scrap to craft, once you have one you can right-click any square in the world to mark it as an area you can do repairs for the utility of your choosing. This works exactly the same as placing one in admin mode behind the scenes (meaning you can use debug mode to remove the spot). It should be noted these new items can only be placed once and cannot be picked up, though you can repair at them an infinite number of times. The repair square can also ONLY be removed in debug mode by right-clicking it and using the admin menu. Also without a coil fuse, repairs are... kinda loud (meaning it'll attract a lot of zombies!!). Do repairs from the comfort of your base at your own peril, you have been warned. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? Other than fixing any bugs that pop up, nothing. [strike]I'll wait for the official B42 mapping tools to come out and remaster the original Rosewood and Muldraugh repair buildings, then once that update is stable I'll push this B42 update to the main mod and set this beta build to private. Afterwards I'll start working on Restore Utilities 2.0... >:) [/strike] As of 2026 I'm not sure if I'll work on bringing the old buildings back, even if the mapping tools are updated. The sub-mod repair locations actually work pretty well and are roughly in the same area as the old ones anyway. However, there are very loose plans for a Restore Utilities 2.0 in the works that might see the light one day, we'll see. :) Workshop ID: 3409422147 Mod ID: restore_utilities Mod ID: restore_utilities_AiwRL Mod ID: restore_utilities_PRL

Overview : Adds a feature to easily unset alarm settings on Digital Watches and Alarm Clocks. Confirmed to work with Build 41/42 Stable and in MP. Features : These features are all enabled by default. You can toggle them enable or disable individually through the options. 1. Show Icon Displays an icon on items with an alarm set. Alarm is set Alarm is ringing If no alarm is set, the icon will not be displayed. 2. Show Unset Menu If an alarm is set, a menu to unset the alarm will be displayed. Executing this menu will unset the alarm without displaying the alarm settings panel. You can also unset alarms for multiple items at once by selecting them in bulk. 3. Auto Unset When an item with an alarm set is obtained, the alarm will automatically be unset. Automatic unsetting only occurs when the item is moved into your inventory or a container you are carrying. Options : These options are available with Mod Options in B41. Show Icon : Toggles the enable/disable setting for the "Show Icon" feature. Show Unset Menu : Toggles the enable/disable setting for the "Show Unset Menu" feature. Auto Unset : Toggles the enable/disable setting for the "Auto Unset" feature. Supported Mods : Equipment UI (B42) Inventory Tetris (B42) Known Issues : Nothing Future plans : Bug fix (if it exists) Release Notes : v1.2 - Hotfix for Build 42.15. v1.1 - Supported Inventory Tetris, Equipment UI Mod. v1.0 - New release. Please refer to "Change Notes" for the older history. If you enjoy this mod and would like to support its development, donations through Ko-fi are greatly appreciated. Donations help cover the cost of a dedicated server for MP testing and AI services used during development. Thank you for helping me continue maintaining and improving my mods!
