description: Project Seasons: If you're tired of that repetitive vanilla erosion, this mod will change that by changing the textures to make the erosion more varied and denser and matching the seasons, It will also add a little more of that apocalyptic atmosphere that everyone loves. Example: - dry leaves and pink leaves scattered across the roads at their respective times of year, and branches scattered across the streets. - more varied vegetation matching the respective time of year (no more of that repetitive grass that grows on the roads). - It also improves the final stage of erosion (after 6 or 12 months), changing the textures to leaving vegetation more denser - extra vines may appear, house interiors will appear dirtier and more abandoned, and roofs will have a more worn appearance, all of which will occur over a period of 15, 30, 50, 80, 90 days. (NOTE: At the moment this only happens in regions the player has never visited.) extra stages of erosion: 15 days: After 15 days you start to notice some changes in the world because of the abandonment, The interiors of houses will seem dustier, and the streets will be a little dirtier with twigs and small dry leaves. 30 days: 30 days later The environment becomes even more neglected, along with the vines that are already beginning to grow in the vanilla erosion, small cracks and loose stones begin to appear on the roads and houses, and the interiors of the houses become even more deteriorated and dirty. 50 days: 50 days later is when the vegetation really starts to grow, the cracks start to get bigger and small dry grasses start to appear on the roads, the roads get dirtier with more dry leaves and branches, the houses become more deteriorated now with small dry vines and roots appearing inside the houses, more dirt and cracks, loose wood too. (all this in addition to vanilla erosion) 80 days: Even more cracks and dirt, the houses are now much more deteriorated with more cracks, dirt, loose wood and vines/roots. 90 days: This is the final stage, and after this, it's just the growth stages of the vanilla erosion plants with modified textures. At 90 days, all the destruction and abandonment are doubled. Remenber At the moment this only happens in regions the player has never visited If you think everything is happening too fast, you can also change the erosion speed in sandbox mode (I recommend 200 days). Can I clean erosion from inside houses? yes, all you will need is a broom or a twig broom, right click on the place you want to clean and click "cleanerosion" (this does not work for cracks) mods that I recommend to enhance your experience: Visual Seasons B41&42: (adds even more erosion to the game, and it is configurable) https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3765777494 Beauty of zomboid - B42 (Retexture): ( I recommend placing Project Seasons at the top of the mod order list to keep the resources of both mods balanced). https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3333779609&searchtext=BEAUTY 10 years later: (if you want to play in a scenario with much denser vegetation with the extra details of my mod) https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3413130261&searchtext=10+years+later [B42] Barricaded World - Extended Erosion (Error Fix): https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3529472651&searchtext=erosion Trash and Corpses (B42.13+) MP unstable: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3662273535 Immersive Cars: Decay: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3495105059&searchtext=IMMERSIVE+DECAY Time Decrease Cars Condition: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3448375286&searchtext=time+decrease can it be added mid game? description: Add extra sandbox options to your Bandits experience Includes: NEW: Integrate modded weapons lists for NPCs using configurable weapons loadout options Prevent bandits from knowing your location without ever seeing you by disabling Raider AI type for all waves with a single option Rebalance bandit melee attacks by preventing them from cancelling their attack animations Global bandit spawn chance modifiers Random group sizes Random health, ammo, and loot amounts Prevent bandits from spawning near your base Adjust timer before bandits may occupy buildings you've visited Toggle gore/visible injuries on NPCs You can disable generators and vehicle sound effects for a years-later vibe Prevent duplication of weapons on dead NPCs Day 1: Randomise equipment of NPC groups, adjust starting companions,disable nuke Week 1: Randomise equipment of NPC groups, adjust time before you are attacked for trespassing, toggle air strikes Compatibility Notes For use with BANDITS, DAY ONE, WEEK ONE (B42) and WEEK ONE (B41) by Slayer As Bandits is still being developed by Slayer, compatibility issues may arise following updates to the main mod. Compatible weapon mods Brita's Weaponpack Firearms Firearms Revamped Vanilla Firearms Expansion CJ Firearms Rain's Firearms Real Firearms Guns of 93 Guns of 93 (B42) Post Soviet Armory If you encounter any issues please report them here. Credits Full credit to Slayer for his amazing creation, BANDITS! All functions of this mod are derived fromthe butchery ofhis code. Buy him a coffee! Thanks to Choko, Бен, VVentos and fleshka812 for translations! Thanks to DrStalker, Albion and Spongie for coding advice! Instructions If playing with Day One/Week One or weapon mods, you should ensure that all Extra Options mods are loaded afterwards in mod load order (bottom right of mods screen in B42) Most options are accessed from Sandbox settings. To customise, you'll need to start a new game, use Debug mode, or an appropriate mod Detailed options for the mod are found on the Bandits Extra Options sandbox page and are added to each Wave screen. Sandbox Options Allow "Raider" AI In the BANDITS release of 9/2/25 default Raider behaviour was turned off for most spawns. This setting still prevents Raider-type attacks in Day/Week One as well as random AI settings. New Melee Rebalance When a bandit engages the player from the zero distance, they perform a shove which knocks the player away or down, and start their next attack immediately, before the shove animation has played. This setting should prevent them from cancelling attack animations like this, making melee combat more intuitive. General spawn multiplier Percentage multiplier for NPC spawning chance, modifies base spawn chance for all waves, defender and camp spawn chances. Spawn chance in wrong terrain Chance for bandits to spawn in areas they avoid. World age for wave progression By default wave progression resets when you create a new character in the same world; this ties progression to world age instead. Random bandit group size Choose a minimum and maximum size for each bandit wave; invalidates the existing "Group Size" setting. Random bandit health Choose a minimum and maximum health for each bandit wave. Random bandit ammo Choose a minimum ammo count for each bandit wave. Mag count will be random between listed amount and minimum. Random bandit loot A multiplier that affects the chance for bandits to carry additional loot items. Player base minimum spawn radius Define a radius around player bases within which bandits cannot spawn. Days before visited building may be occupied Choose the number of days before defenders may occupy a building you have visited. For a building to count as "visited" you should remain inside for 10 game minutes. Occupied buildings have generators How often generators will spawn at bandit safehouses. Generator type will be randomly chosen. Allow sandbag roadblocks Sandbag roadblocks are a new option which can replace or complement the existing vehicle roadblocks. Vehicle sound effects on bandit spawning Large groups of bandits spawn with car or helicopter sound effects by default, which some players may prefer to disable. Allow gore Display injuries NPCs that take damage. Spawn icons do not show hostility Spawn marker icons will no longer show if NPCs are friendly or hostile. Who is there? You'll have to find out... Loadout and special weapons You can assign a weapons loadout of your choice for each bandit wave. You can also define the probability a bandit will spawn with a "special weapon" for that loadout type. Civilian: Handguns and single shot rifles. Police: Semi-automatic rifles and SMGs. Special weapons are automatic and sniper rifles. Military: US-type automatic rifles. Special weapons are sniper rifles and LMGs. Exotic: Weapons of rare and/or non-US origin. Special weapons include SMGs and sniper rifles. Looted: Lower quality weapons loadout for desperate bandits. Special weapons include automatics. Sandbox Options for Day One Starting equipment Start with some equipment to match your profession. Starting companions Start with a random family of NPCs, a group of co-workers, or nobody. Randomise groups NPC groups spawning during Day One will no longer carry identical weapons. Enable nuke Day One need not end with a bang. Sandbox Options for Week One Trespass grace period Choose how long it will take for inhabitants of buildings to attack, if you trespass. description: Adds faces, freckles, scars, visible muscles, and more This is primarily a mod framework that allows servers and other mods to add more variety to character appearances. SUPPORTS B42.20 STABLE - TESTED AND WORKS IN MULTIPLAYER B41 VERSION HERE COMMON ISSUES DISABLE LUA CHECKSUM IF YOU GET "FILE DOESN'T EXIST" ERROR IF CRASHING ON WORLD CREATION RESUBSCRIBE TO THE MOD AND IF IT STILL HAPPENS THEN REMOVE THE MOD AND RE-ADD IT AFTER STARTING THE SAVE DO NOT USE THE VANILLA FACE PACK WITH OTHER RETEXTURES IT ONLY WORKS WITH THE DEFAULT TEXTURES SET MAX TEXTURE SIZE IN SETTINGS TO WHATEVER PLAYER RETEXTURE YOU ARE USING OR YOU WILL HAVE SEAMS (VANILLA IS 256) NEEDS TO BE LOADED AFTER ELLIE'S TATTOO PARLOR ENABLING RETEXTURES THAT SUPPORT THIS MOD REQUIRES A GAME RESTART IN MULTIPLAYER EVERY PLAYER NEEDS THE MOD + RETEXTURES ENABLED ON THE MAIN MENU OR TEXTURES WON'T BE REPLACED ON STARTUP Included with this mod Base mod - Framework, doesn't add any customisation options Vanilla Faces Pack - Adds 4 male and 4 female faces. Only supports the vanilla body textures DO NOT USE THIS WITH RETEXTURE MODS Details Pack - Adds freckles, moles, scars, burns, and missing eyes. Missing eyes also affect the players vision cone. Details Pack HD Textures - 512x512 textures for the Details Pack. DO NOT USE THE HD TEXTURE PACK with vanilla textures or any retextures that are 256x256 or it will cause seams. Fully supported mods Spongie's Character Retexture Tomb's Player Body Overhaul Faces and Details Select from different faces and add additional detail textures to your character Faces work on all skintones and new options can be added by other mods. Visible Muscles Characters will have visible muscles at high strength levels Muscle intensity increases at level 6 and level 9 strength (Stout and Strong traits in character creation). Can be toggled globally or set to player preference in sandbox settings. MUSCLE TEXTURES DO NOT WORK WITH UNSUPPORTED TEXTURE MODS LIKE SIMPLE CHARACTER RETEXTURE. TURN OFF MUSCLES IN SANDBOX IF YOU ARE USING ONE THAT DOESN'T SUPPORT THIS MOD Body Hair Head stubble, beard stubble, and body hair (formerly chest hair) will grow in-game and can be shaved The button to shave your stubble and body hair is in the character info panel. Vanilla chest hair has been completely replaced with a new system that works on both body types. Can be toggled globally or set to player preference in sandbox settings. THIS MOD DOES NOT AFFECT HAIR OR BEARD GROWTH OUTSIDE OF SHAVING HEAD/BEARD STUBBLE Works in existing saves and creating a new character mid-save Joining a game with a character from before the mod was added will open the character customisation window so that you can pick faces and details. Stubble and chest hair will be converted to the new system. Change Customisation In-Game There is a sandbox option to allow players to open the customisation window and change their face or details in-game. The buttons to change your appearance and shave are in the character info panel. Sandbox Options Options for changing appearance in-game, toggling muscles, and changing body hair growth Admins can always change their appearance or add body hair but they can spawn an Appearance Changing Spiffo to give this ability to any player when held Customisation options with certain tags can be hidden from normal players. Admins can spawn an Appearance Unlocking Bear to unhide these options for any player when held Body hair growth and visible muscles can be enabled or disabled or set to player preference You can change the vision modifier used by missing eyes Technical Details See the readme and Example.lua to learn how you can make addons for the mod. The body hair textures in the base mod will cut off at the underwear which won't look right when using a nude mod. I've included nude versions of the body hair textures in the files for other modders to use if they want to make their mod compatible. The blood/dirt on the face and muscles are occasionally synced to the body's blood/dirt levels so there will always be a slight delay which I've never noticed during gameplay. To reduce strain on the server, every few ticks the server will try to sync the blood of a single player until it goes through the list of active players. The tick delay adjusts based on the number of players and currently it will take around 200 ticks to finish checking every player once. This means that in singleplayer it will do a check every 200 ticks but in a 100 player server it would be doing a check every 2 ticks. Basically there is always a roughly 2 second delay for blood on a player's face or muscle to become accurate. Incompatibilities Some clothing mods might cause transparency issues with customisation. This is caused by having a broken masks folder that is missing textures for bodyparts. To fix this you can copy the missing textures into the masks folder from media\textures\Body\Masks Mods that affect stubble or chest hair won't work (Ras' Body Mod, Reorganised Info Screen) Dynamic Body should work fine if you disable visible muscles Retextures that replace the chest hair textures with new skins won't be accessible because chest hair is replaced DOES NOT WORK IN SPLITSCREEN Known issues Having too many traits active may cause the info screen to break because of how small it is. You need to use Bigger Character Avatars to fix this No controller support Credits I had to take a lot of code from Improved Hair Menu by duckduckquak for the menus. Studying the code from the Furry mod by Jaql and Wuffwick as well as Ra's Body Mod helped me make this mod, but I haven't used any of their code. View on Github This mod is open source so you can do whatever you want with it. Workshop ID: 3414634809 Mod ID: SPNCC Mod ID: SPNCCDetails Mod ID: SPNCCDetailsHD Mod ID: SPNCCFaces

description: Compatible with Project Zomboid Build 42.12.3 – 42.20.0 Mad Crafter adds electrified melee weapons, improvised scrap weapons, custom crafting recipes, and a stronger reason to invest in the Electrician skill. Batteries, scrap parts, electronics, blades, pipes, spikes and odd tools can now become dangerous homemade weapons. Some are practical. Some are unstable. Most of them look like exactly the kind of thing someone would build in the middle of the apocalypse. Main Features Electrified melee weapons powered by batteries. Improvised scrap weapons and multi-purpose tools. A weapon status bar showing battery charge and malfunction risk. Sandbox options for battery drain and malfunction balance. Electric visual effects while electric mode is active. Unique electric impact sounds for electrified weapons. Zombies can stagger and be briefly stunned by active electric weapons. Weapon bonuses while electric mode is active. Pixel-art item icons designed to fit the Project Zomboid style. Recipe unlocks through magazines or sufficient skill levels. Electric Weapons Electric weapons can be used like regular melee weapons, but they can also be switched into electric mode when they have battery power and their circuitry is still functional. When electric mode is active, every swing consumes battery charge. Battery use depends on the weapon, and stronger weapons usually drain more power. Each electrified weapon also gains its own combat bonus. For example, spear-type weapons can gain extra attack range, while heavy blunt weapons can gain higher damage and critical hit potential. By default, electric mode can also increase the maximum number of targets hit, but this only matters when multi-hit is enabled. Circuit Malfunction System Electric weapons are made from scrap parts, improvised wiring and unstable circuitry. They are powerful, but not perfectly reliable. As you fight, the weapon's malfunction risk can increase. The higher the risk, the more likely the circuit is to fail. If that happens, electric mode becomes unavailable until the weapon is repaired. The malfunction system is mainly affected by: Electrician Level — affects the base malfunction probability. Maintenance Level — affects how much malfunction risk is added with each swing. Note: malfunction risk and malfunction probability are not the same thing. Risk builds up over time; probability decides whether the circuit actually fails. Electric Mode Toggle Electric mode can be configured in: Options → Mods → Mad Crafter You can also assign a hotkey to toggle electric mode. No hotkey is assigned by default. The G key is recommended. Scrap Weapons and Tools Mad Crafter also adds improvised weapons and tools inspired by apocalyptic survival gear, movies and games. Current scrap weapons and tools include: Cleaver Axe Dagger Trident Extinguisher Maul RailSpike Spear Nail-Spiked ShortSword Pipe Wrench Hatchet Saw Blade Claw Wrench Knife Zulu Short Spear Dagger Hatchet Saw Blade Bolt Cutters Keychain Screwdriver Yes, you can hang a screwdriver on your keychain. Recipe Unlocks Electric Weapons To craft electric shock weapons, you must either: Find Electrician Maniac's Diary, or Have an Electrician level higher than the recipe requirement. Wild / Scrap Weapons To craft certain improvised weapons, you must either: Find Hollywood Weapons Encyclopedia, or Have the required skill level plus one extra level. Sandbox Options Mad Crafter includes sandbox settings so you can adjust how reliable, fragile, efficient or battery-hungry electric weapons are in your world. You can configure: Electric weapon malfunction factor. Electric weapon battery consumption factor. Translations The mod currently supports: Chinese English Russian French Russian translation thanks to ph0. French translation thanks to Bobitec. Build 42 Compatibility Mad Crafter has been updated for newer Project Zomboid Build 42 versions. This compatibility work includes support for the newer B42 mod structure, item script changes, registered item tags, translation formats and Lua loading paths. Supported builds: from 42.12.3 to 42.20.0 Bug Reports If you encounter a bug, please report it in the discussion section. Useful information to include: Project Zomboid build number. SP, hosted MP, or dedicated server. The exact weapon, recipe, item or action involved. Any relevant console/log errors. What happened shortly before the issue appeared. Your mod list, especially if the issue may be caused by a conflict. Future Update Ideas Possible future plans include: Reworking some weapon textures to reduce the use of very dark colors. Adding more electric shock weapons. Adding more scrap-based weapons. Adding more convenient tools. Adding more world items to support crafting and exploration. Exploring dual-mode weapons. Possibly experimenting with flame weapons once B42 becomes more stable. Suggestions and feedback are welcome. Credits Original mod by Rocco: PZ Workshop Items Maintenance and compatibility updates for newer B42 builds by Afyrmo: PZ Workshop Items Workshop ID: 3418701509 Mod ID: Mad Crafter Workshop ID: 3418701509 Mod ID: Mad Crafter

description: True Smoking This mod provides a more realistic and immersive smoking experience. Smoking is no longer a short action but now a tracked and passively handled mechanic where the stats and effects are distributed over time while smoking. There is also a optional Nicotine System that implements Addiction and Withdrawal Smoking Light a smoke as normal, any restrictive headgear will be taken off. After lighting, a moodle will appear tracking the progress of your smoke. You can take puffs manually or enable passive smoking and your character will take puffs when idle or when the smoke is about to go out! Dynamic Burn Rate The smoke will burn faster as you puff or move around, when idle it will slowly go out. If it goes out you can relight it to keep smoking. Smokes can be put out and saved for later, the amount left will be visible on the item tooltip. Cigars, pipes, and cigarillos are more effective than a single cigarette so you don't need to smoke the whole thing to get the same effects as a single cigarette! Freedom Lighting, puffing, and putting out the smoke are timed actions that your character performs, after a smoke has been lit you can now do whatever you like while smoking. Take puffs whenever you want but make sure your smoke doesn't go out or you will need to relight it or save it for later! Nicotine System The Nicotine system adds Nicotine, Addiction, and Withdrawal. This system allows the Smoker trait to be dynamically lost and gained based on Addiction levels. Nicotine is accumulated while smoking and leads to Addiction over time. Nicotine provides small amounts of fatigue and hunger reduction. Withdrawal causes small amounts of boredom and unhappyness gain. There are various traits that effect the metabolism rate of Nicotine on the player and your tolerance level varies based on Addiction. The more addicted you are the less effective smokes become at completely removing your stress. This system is completely optional and can be turned off in the Sandbox Options if desired. Features Save Game Compatible! Controller support Split-screen support Compatible with Smoker Trait and most mods Options and Settings configurable via Sandbox Options and Mod Options All vanilla smokes compatible with visual item displayed on face! Controls Default Keyboard K - Tap to take a short puff, hold to keep puffing. Will light a cigarette or unpack one. Relights the smoke when if it goes out. ; (semi colon) - Puts the smoke out. Re-equips headgear that was taken off. Controller Button prompts will appear when the corresponding action can be done. LB is a modifier key that when held changes the B action as follows below: LB + B = Get/Light Cigarette LB + B = Put Out Smoke / Re-equip headgear B = (Hold) Take Puff / Relight Configurable I have made most of the mod configurable through Sandbox Options and in-game Mod Options. Most features can be toggled, or tuned to your liking. All vanilla smoke items can have their properties changed to have different smoking times, burn characteristics and effectiveness. The Nicotine system which adds more depth to the Smoker trait can be tweaked or turned off completely if desired, this system also allows the Smoker Trait to be gained or lost over time. Moodles can be toggled off or on if desired. I review comments almost daily and add options and fix bugs as quickly as I can so feel free to leave feedback or requests. I would highly recommend checking the in-game Mod Options to help configure the behaviour of the mod to your liking as there are many options to help automate smoking or you can disable them to make it completely manual. Mod Support Hemp & Tobacco N&C's Narcotics HGO Expansion (B42) Clove Cigarettes [B42] Tobacco Hotkey Mod <B42>Reefer Madness Smoking Sounds Overhaul [B41/B42]I Might Need A Lighter (IDNAL also supported) Most mods should be compatible, if not let me know and I'll look at making a patch. I've also added a config system for modders to directly integrate into the True Smoking system, some mods may require their authors to add a config to fully support their OnEat methods Future Updates Custom Animations Mod support as requested and needed Further tweaks, options, etc Do not modify or redistribute my mod/code without consent, ask for permission. ❄ SUBZERO ZOMBIES TWD ❄ ACTUALIZADO PARA BUILD 42.20 ESTABLE No fue probado con Ragdolls! La idea surgio en el foro reddit cuando debatimos acerca de como afecta las temperaturas bajas a los zombies. Soy fanatico de los comics de Walking Dead por lo que siempre me gusto la idea de un invierno gelido en el cual la supervivencia pasa mas por sobrevivir a las duras condiciones junto a la falta de comida por lo que queria dejar a los zombies de lado por un tiempo. Si quieres este estilo de juego este mod es para vos. Los zombies se congelan cuando llegan a una temperatura baja indicada como pasa en los inviernos de TWD.. Nueva UPDATE con caracteristicas nuevas. Ahora puedes elegir una fase previa a la congelación, haciendo de esta manera que la congelación sea más progresiva y natural, con el tiempo si es muy solicitado agregaré distintas fases, pero por ahora con una debería bastar. ¿Cómo funciona? En el menú sandbox podrás elegir si activar o no está característica y también podrás definir la temperatura necesaria para que eso ocurra. Intenta poner siempre una temperatura superior a la de congelación para que no pasen cosas raras, no fue testeado que pasaría si no lo haces. La temperatura de congelación y pre-congelacion son seleccionables en el menú sandbox así como también la cantidad de tiempo que la temperatura de congelacion debe permanecer para que el zombie finalmente se congele. En las opciones por defectos los parámetros se mantendrán en -5 °C para congelación, 0 °C para pre-congelacion y 30 minutos del juego para que los zombies pasen a estado sólido. Los zombies a su vez tienen un termómetro interno, si están cerca de un incendio y se calientan lo suficiente volverán a moverse, en los interiores los zombies no estarán congelados por que la temperatura es mucho mas alta. _______________________________________________________________ UPDATED FOR STABLE BUILD 42.20 Not tested with Ragdolls! The idea came up on the Reddit forum when we discussed how low temperatures affect zombies. I'm a fan of The Walking Dead comics, so I always liked the idea of a harsh winter where survival is more about enduring the harsh conditions and lack of food, rather than just fighting zombies. If you want this type of gameplay, this mod is for you. Zombies freeze when they reach a low temperature, just like in The Walking Dead winters. New UPDATE with new features. Now you can choose a pre-freezing phase, making the freezing process more progressive and natural. If there's enough demand, I'll add more phases in the future, but for now, one should be enough. How does it work? In the sandbox menu, you can choose whether to enable or disable this feature and also define the temperature required for it to happen. Always try to set a temperature above freezing to avoid any issues, as it hasn't been tested what would happen if you don't. The freezing and pre-freezing temperatures are selectable in the sandbox menu, as well as the amount of time the freezing temperature must remain for the zombie to finally freeze. In the default options, the parameters will remain at -5°C for freezing, 0°C for pre-freezing, and 30 minutes of gameplay for zombies to become solid. Zombies also have an internal thermometer; if they are near a fire and heat up enough, they will move again. Inside buildings, zombies will not be frozen because the temperature is much higher. description: After much consideration and between being very busy with RL and other projects and also some major PZ burnout, I’m officially suspending development of this mod. It’s been a while since I’ve had a chance to even try to write an update and that doesn’t appear to be changing any time soon. While it is missing some requested features and will have incompatibilities with certain weapon mods that employ script swaps for things like bayonet use or stock folding (this mod already includes compatibility files with some major ones like Britas and VFE), it is very functional in its current form and has behaved well over 200+ hours of testing. As it stands, it should remain in good shape for B41, but may become increasingly less reliable as B42 continues development in its unstable branch. I may try to come back to it and polish it up once B42 is released into stable. So cheers! May your sprinters always stumble and your bags overflow with ammo! 🍺 The new and much improved version of Legend Craft - Melee Weapons and Guns & Grenades Available for B41 and B42, Legend Craft Evolved lets you take duplicates of the weapons you find and, with tools, materials, and skill levels, combine them into ever more powerful variants. Works with vanilla and many major weapon mods including Brita's, VFE, Scrap Guns, and more. The mod defaults to requiring a hammer and 5 nails for every upgrade, allows the first upgrade on level 1 of that weapon's combat skill, and an additional upgrade per level until the weapon has reached Mark 10. For those who are familiar with the original's shortcomings, Legend Craft Evolved now also retains all tool functionalities as well. This is achieved through the use of a script-less and recipe-less craftlike system that checks your inventory and prompts you with the option to upgrade in your right-click inventory menu. There is also a feedback system through character speech to inform you what is missing to proceed with an upgrade. The mod also has a ton of sandbox choices split between two menus - Options & Values. There, you can decide Which weapon attributes to allow for upgrade (damage is the only non-optional value) How much each upgrade increases those attributes What tool or tool type to use (B42 has up to three choices from 29 types to consider) What materials to use, with 5 different choices in B41 and 7 choices in B42 (to be expanded in updates) What skill level to check for progress - Combat, Maintenance, Carpentry, Electrical, or Metalworking The option to prevent upgraded weapons from breaking or from taking any condition loss at all And more! There is also a token system to preserve upgrades should a weapon fall to pieces in B42 or be accidentally consumed as a craft ingredient. Everything is explained in detail in a HOW-TO.txt file included in the mod folder. So upgrade the things! Get too overconfident! Die terribly! That's how I use it anyway. NOTE: When uninstaling the mod, upgrades are left as artifacts. So the mod includes a 'Reclaim Mode' which gives item refunds for all upgrades to be used before a mid-save uninstall. SPECIAL THANKS Taylor MH for the Spanish translation Hx for the Korean translation and info about correct encoding for it Vilespring - co-developer of Vanilla Firearms Expansion - for pointing out that VFE's folded stocks likely needed special attention kin1555 for identifying a critical bug where upgrades were losing some values on exiting and reloading the game CdrCantees for identifying a critical bug involving upgrade function not functioning properly when level and skill check requirements were removed NuEvE for finding a major bug where artifacts would remain in the player's hands if a secondary equipped weapon was used to upgrade a primary or unequipped weapon or a primary was used to upgrade a secondary Vasher for reporting a pair of bugs that could cause crashes under certain circumstances MUSIC Upgrade Jingle: Excerpt of Banjo opener by Simonays https://freesound.org/s/533545/ License: Attribution 4.0 Remixed by Marbo Dreadnought Workshop ID: 3432470769 Mod ID: LegendCraftEvolvedB41 Mod ID: LegendCraftEvolvedB42

description: Shoving and stomping now carries a risk of being counterattacked. Highly customizable. NOTE: Temp fix for b42.20. Traits have no effect in the mod with b42.20. Full repair is WIP. No change on b42 version. Ever wonder why zombies become helpless when they're knocked over? Or why you never get bitten when you're shoving away a horde and putting your limbs right in front of their gnashing faces? Or maybe you just feel too powerful curb stomping dozens of zombies and walking away without a scratch on the first day? The idea behind this mod is to simulate the risk of fighting zombies without any range advantage. In short, it introduces a small chance for any one shove or stomp to backfire and result in a wound on the attacker with the same consequences of a normal zombie attack. This change discourages fighting when unprepared, especially at the very beginning of the game. Any last-resort improvised weapon becomes safer than going unarmed. In this time it might be better to flee and break line of sight than to kill a threat with your bare hands. When you do get a weapon, it becomes very important to keep zombies outside the weapon's minimum range so your melee attacks aren't automatically swapped into shoves. Crowd control with low-knockback weapons should be more difficult. The practice of preserving weapon durability by using unarmed is now risky. By default it's safe to shove zombies who are unalerted, facing away from the player, or who have already counterattacked a player within the last couple seconds. The player also has a separate shorter grace period after being counterattacked. Wearing armor on your limbs can reduce or eliminate the danger from this mod. The strength and fitness skills affect the chance of being injured, as do the thick and thin skinned traits. Almost every part of the mod is customizable in sandbox options so you can use as much or as little of it as you want. For example, you could configure the mod to: - Simulate the roughness of unarmed combat without actually being "attacked" by zombies by disabling all wounds except non-infectious scratches on the hands and feet, ignoring defense and not causing holes in clothing. With this setup you might get blisters or abrasions on those parts but it shouldn't ever be directly lethal. - Enable shove safety when holding two-handed weapons, allowing you to safely push zombies away using brooms, planks, or other long weapons. You could even hold something like a pillow to protect yourself from being bitten if you set shove safety to recognize "any item" - Set shoving to only affect the forearms, and stomping to only affect the feet; that way the counterattacks from this mod can be absorbed by more easily accessible clothes. Assuming you aren't using mods that add armor for the hands and shins. - Set the cooldown very high to (in effect) prevent a zombie from counterattacking you more than once. In case you want the risk to still be significant but don't like the chance of being ripped to shreds because you won an unarmed fight. I personally play with low-pop vaulting runners and transmission off. If you play with high pop, shamblers, or transmission on, this mod might make less sense or feel excessively punishing. It was just bothering me that my character could 1v1 a rabid monster the size of a full grown human while bare-handed and at little to no personal risk. Note: I have not tested this in multiplayer or with most other mods. I don't see a reason why it wouldn't work, but let me know if it doesn't and I'll mention incompatibilities here. Workshop ID: 3434796669 Mod ID: RiskyUnarmed

description: I warn you, all screenshots were taken on B42, it has quite noticeable differences from B41. The main goal of the mod is to add spawn zones for military vehicles in the appropriate places on the vanilla map. However, at the moment, several mod maps are also supported. If you have ideas where else I can add military zones, I will listen to you. The mod is designed to use modded vehicles, as there are no military vehicles in vanilla. So if you only play with vanilla vehicles, this mod is useless for you. Can be added to/removed from existing save. When added to an existing save, the changes will only apply to unexplored areas. When removed from a save, already spawned cars will remain, but will no longer appear in other places. If you want the cars to spawn only in military zones then load it after vehicle mods. The mod also adds 4 new road stories: Military Blockade | Convoy | Blockpost, Biohazard Crash. All road stories don't spawn in first 5 days of apocalypse. To understand what to expect, you can look at the mod's images. To ensure that semi-trailers spawn normally in stories, use KI5 Mini-fixes. ---> Old version <--- Where are the zones: Military base Louisville checkpoint East Army Camp near Louisville Brandenburg March Ridge In small camp between Irvington and Brandenburg Supported maps: Fort Redstone Fort Knox Fort Rock Ridge Louisville Quarantine Zone Raven Creek/Raven Creek B42 Echo Creek Military Base [B42] SecretZ Pandemic (Alpha)/[B42] SecretZ Pandemic [MODULAR] Foxtrot Warehouse [B42] Falcon Ridge B42 AnruisiTown (Military Bastion) Safeharbor Garrison Little bit of technical part All vehicles are sorted from VehicleZoneDistribution.military, but it also works with army, just adding vehicles from army to military. The mod automatically removes all vehicles from other zones, so if you don't enable a special sandbox option, military vehicles will only spawn in military zones. As I said earlier, the mod versions for B41 and B42 are slightly different and the main difference is the number of different zones. B41 version: -> military_burnt (burnt military vehiles; determined by the presence of "burnt" in the vehicle's script name) -> military_container (containers added by the mod Containers!; determined by the presence of "container" in the vehicle's script name) -> military_trailer (trailers; determined by the presence of "trailer" in the vehicle's script name) -> military_trailer_light (only small trailers; determined if offroad efficiency of trailer is less than or equal to 1) -> military_trailer_heavy (only huge heavy trailers; determined if offroad efficiency of trailer is more than 1) -> military_vehicle (military cars; remainder after sorting) -> military_vehicle_light (light military cars; determined if (mass*engineForce)/(maxSpeed*1000) is less than or equal 60) -> military_vehicle_heavy (heavy military cars; determined if (mass*engineForce)/(maxSpeed*1000) is more than 60) B42 version: -> military_burnt (burnt military vehiles; determined by the presence of "burnt" in the vehicle's script name) -> military_container (containers added by the mod Containers!; determined by the presence of "container" in the vehicle's script name) -> military_container_angled (slightly rotated containers) -> military_trailer (all trailers; determined by the presence of "trailer" in the vehicle's script name) -> military_trailer_angled (slightly rotated trailers) -> military_trailer_light (only small trailers; determined if offroad efficiency of trailer is less than or equal to 1) -> military_trailer_light_angled (slightly rotated light trailers) -> military_trailer_heavy (only huge heavy trailers; determined if offroad efficiency of trailer is more than 1) -> military_trailer_heavy_angled (slightly rotated heavy trailers) -> military_vehicle (all military cars; remainder after sorting) -> military_vehicle_angled (slightly rotated military cars) -> military_vehicle_light (light military cars; determined if (mass*engineForce*engineLoudness)/10^6 is less than or equal 425) -> military_vehicle_light_angled (slightly rotated light military cars) -> military_vehicle_heavy (heavy military cars; determined if (mass*engineForce*engineLoudness)/10^6 is more than 425) -> military_trailer_heavy_angled (slightly rotated heavy military cars) Making your own compatibility For vehicle mods: Just add your vehicle in VehicleZoneDistribution.military or VehicleZoneDistribution.army. If you are interested in where your vehicle will be distributed, read above about the zones. For map mods: Will be a bit later. description: Barrels can actually be more than just a sprite! Important: GigaWatte has stopped active development of this mod but I will do my best to fix bugs and keep the mod working for current version of the game. Updates may be slow but the mod is not dead. - SP4RTAN Multiplayer support is currently not fully implemented or tested. Please use it in MP at your own risk. Features available Use your Pipe Wrench to open the lid of the barrel! Store any fluid inside The amount of liquid inside the barrel affects the encumbrance Rubber Hose to take gas from the barrel Funnel for pouring gas into the barrel Funnel may speedup pouring action Refueling vehicle from the barrel. and vice versa Refueling generator from the barrel Randomized initial fluid and amount Sandbox vars to control mod behaviour as you want Chuckleberry Finn's Mod Update and Alert System integration for ingame ChangeLog Notes Uses new FluidContainer system of B42 Barrels are now less fragile! But anyway Walkers will break it pretty quickly Gasoline does not evaporate from the barrels with closed lid Modded vehicles and trailers are supported if the vehicle has a part with the "gastank" category and the part containerType contains the word "Gasoline" (this information is mostly for modders) Please! Any full 800L barrels in your characters pocket or car trunk is your responsibility, there is no proper way to haul them. For now at least. I'd also recommend checking out the Functional Gutters mod. How to Base usage Find a Pipe Wrench and any metal barrel in the game (there are only four types available) Move it to the garage at your base Right click on it and select "Uncap ..." option Find a Rubber Hose and a Funnel, then place them on the barrel to enable fluid transfer Refuel generator The generator must be near the barrel with at least 1 liter of fuel The generator must be turned off and have free space for fuel Find a Rubber Hose if you haven't found it yet, then place it on the barrel (or keep it in your inventory) Right click on the generator and select "Refuel From Barrel" Refuel vehicle The vehicle must be near the player The vehicle's engine must be turned off The gas tank must have free space The barrel with gas must be near the vehicle Find a Rubber Hose if you haven't found it yet, then place it on the barrel (or keep it in your inventory) Rain collector barrel Find a Welding mask and a Welding torch with at least 2 uses Right-click on the barrel Find the "Cut Lid" option - it may appear at the top or inside the existing barrel submenu Future plans Better multiplayer support Mods compatibility Modded vehicles (and fluid trailers) should be compatible if: vehicle has part and part category contains "gastank", part contentType contains word "Gasoline". Other mods, such as IDBFS, could introduce their own overrides of the game's tiles, which may lead to issues with UB. Known bugs In case of game crash FuidContainer may not save it's contents. Water level updates are not triggered while it's raining, so changes in the water level won't be rendered unless there is some manual interaction with the fluid. FAQ Q: b41 when? A: I dont have any plans to port it on b41. And there is already a mod for b41, it's called "Fuel API" Q: How to move my 800l barrel now? A: It's quite hard to implement right now properly. This mod has been updated using the new functionality in B42.9.0 for the best headlights ever, without any manual java file installation. In Options -> Mods -> High Beams you can change a few settings: Keybind: The key to toggle high beams Always On: high beams are always on automatically Length multiplier: default length is 36 tiles, this lets you increase that distance Intensity Multiplier: allows you to blind other drivers with your aftermarket xenon bulbs Radial Menu: Adds a high beam toggle to the vehicle radial menu. ✨ HydeCo. Unlimited Cars ✨ Default behavior: VANILLA If you never touch the mod's sandbox settings, it will not change your game. When you do want a different world, this mod gives you a clean preset system to reshape vehicle spawns across the map. What It Does - Adjusts vehicle spawn rules by zone definitions (the game's vehicle distribution tables). - Applies presets globally to every vehicle zone (including zones and vehicles added by other mods). - Optional variety setting: equalize vehicle-type chances inside each zone (more variety, same total count). - Optional trailer support: inject common trailers into most zones, and/or bias trailer odds (also affects modded trailers). Sandbox Presets (1–19) Set HydeCo Unlimited Cars → Preset to one of these: 1. Vanilla (no changes) 2. More Cars (x2 spawn rate) 3. Insane Cars (x6 spawn rate) 4. No Cars (disable zone spawns) 5. Burnt World (mostly burnt, damaged cars) 6. Pristine Cars (better condition, normal counts) 7. Custom (use Advanced tab) 8. Max Cars + Pristine (max spawns, perfect-ish parts) 9. Max Cars + Wrecks (max spawns, heavily damaged mix) 10. Rare Pristine (few cars, great condition) 11. Keyless Horde (max cars, almost no keys) 12. Jalopy World (normal counts, very damaged, not burnt) 13. Burnt Horde (max cars, mostly burnt + wrecked) 14. Showroom No Keys (pristine cars, no keys) 15. Trailer Town (normal-ish counts, trailers show up a lot) 16. Trailerpocalypse (max spawns, very trailer-heavy) 17. Van World (VANPOCALYPSE: max spawns, vans only) 18. Unique Fleet (max spawns, unique-only pool) 19. Emergency Only (max spawns, police/fire/ambulance only) Notes: - Preset 17 forces vans-only and disables special/emergency mixing. - Preset 19 preserves town/region-specific police pools (Rosewood/Louisville/etc) if a zone already has its own local emergency vehicles. Custom Preset (Advanced Tab) If you choose Preset 7 (Custom), you can fine-tune: - Spawn rate multiplier - Vehicle quality - Part damage chance - Burnt chance - Key chance - Trailer bias (multiply trailer odds inside zones) - Inject trailers (adds common trailers into most zones so they can actually spawn) - Emergency/special vehicle chance (police/fire/ambulance frequency via vanilla special-vehicle logic) - (Advanced emergency chance uses vanilla special-vehicle logic; it's not a strict whitelist like Preset 18) - Van bias (make vans more likely in every zone) - Unique bias (boost branded/service vehicles like Spiffo/Radio/Butchers/Mail etc) - Inject unique vehicles + percent (makes “unique” vans show up in common zones) - Optional: equalize vehicle-type chances per zone (variety mode) Important: Base Game “Vehicles” Sandbox Settings This mod edits zone spawn rules, but the vanilla sandbox settings under the Vehicles tab still apply on top of everything. If you want a specific “vision,” make sure your base settings match it too: - Global vehicle spawn settings can reduce/increase results even if you pick “Max Cars” presets. - Global condition/repair settings affect how “pristine” or “wrecked” things feel. - Global key/lock/alarm/gas settings can override the vibe you expect from a preset. Important: Crash Wrecks / “Story” Vehicles If you’re still seeing burnt wrecks, police roadblocks, or other “car crash / story” scenes even with Pristine-style presets, those usually come from the vanilla Randomized Road Stories system (not normal vehicle zones). To reduce/disable those, adjust base-game sandbox settings under the Meta tab: - Randomized Road Stories Chance (a.k.a. `VehicleStoryChance`) → set to the lowest/“Never” option - Optional: Zone Story Chance (a.k.a. `ZoneStoryChance`) → set to the lowest/“Never” option Note: changing these only affects newly-generated map chunks. Already-explored areas can keep existing story vehicles. Compatibility & Modded Vehicles - Works with vehicle mods: this mod edits zone spawn rules (not specific vehicle IDs), so vehicles added into zone tables by other mods are affected automatically. - Trailer compatibility: trailer bias detects any vehicle type containing “Trailer” (so many modded trailers get boosted too). - Stable with other spawn mods: changes are applied cleanly on top of the current zone tables (no repeated stacking every load). - Load order: load HydeCo Unlimited Cars after mods that add/modify vehicle zone distributions for best results. - Limit: if a vehicle mod spawns cars via its own custom system (not zone tables), this mod can't control those spawns. description: Realistically harvest rain water from a building's roof by connecting a container to the gutter's drain. Tap into existing gutters or build your own custom gutter system using a variety of new craftable gutter pipes. FAQ Does this mod work in multiplayer (build 42.13+)? Yes, the mod has been updated with initial multiplayer support. Servers will use the default mod options (1.0 rain factor, pipe wrench required) until configurable sandbox values are added in a future update. Can this mod be safely added mid-save? Yes, but it will not change any already existing collectors that happen to be placed on a gutter tile. Can this mod be safely removed mid-save? Yes, but extra steps are required for multiplayer. See the removal section below. Do gutter collectors work indoors? No, currently they still require being outdoors without a covered overhead tile. What can I connect to the gutter All vanilla rain collectors, troughs, and the amphora are supported. Additionally, any modded entities that use the game's FluidContainer system should work out of the box such as the Useful Barrels mod. Does this work for build 41? This mod relies on systems introduced in build `42.4+` and will not function in build `41`. How To Use Build/place supported collector on the same tile as a gutter drain. Either tile works for multi-tile troughs. Open the context menu by right-clicking on the collector. Find the "Gutter Drain" submenu and select the "Connect" option. Requires a pipe wrench unless turned off in mod settings. Enjoy the benefits of a highly-efficient rain collector system. Pre-Existing Structures Pre-existing structures already have roof gutters meaning you won't have to build your own. To tap into these roof gutters, you will either need to find a building with an existing drain pipe or build a new drain pipe. On its own a drain pipe will reach the next level above. Additional vertical pipes can be built on top of the drain pipe to access roofs on higher floor levels. Player-Built Structures Unlike pre-existing structures, player-built structures will require horizontal gutter pipes to expand the size of the roof's area being covered by the drain pipe. Each gutter pipe can collect rain from up to 4 grid-squares from its attachment point in a line. A roof square will be considered valid if it has a floor, isn't covered by a roof, and isn't occupied by an item such as a rain collector. Use the "View Pipes" and "View Roof" buttons in the gutter ui panel to help visualize the connected pipes and covered roof area. Mod Settings Options -> Mods -> Functional Gutters Removing Mod from Multiplayer As of 42.13.1, there is an extra step required to properly remove the mod from multiplayer servers. This process is not specific Functional Gutters and will be required for any mods that add custom entities until a fix is added in the base game. Removal Methods Choose one of the following methods to maintain an active multiplayer save: Placeholder Mod To help facilitate removal, a second mod titled "[42] Functional Gutters (Removed)" has been included alongside the main mod. This placeholder mod maintains all entity scripts and tiles definitions but none of the main mod's core functionality. Stop the server Backup the server files if not done automatically on server shutdown Disable the main mod "[42] Functional Gutters" in the server settings Enable the placeholder mod "[42] Functional Gutters (Removed)" in the server settings Start the server back up Manual Remove any player-crafted gutters from the game world - not required but will prevent invisible asset warnings being logged Stop the server Backup the server files if not done automatically on server shutdown Remove the mod from the server settings Locate and delete the following server files: WorldDictionary.bin, WorldDictionaryLog, WorldDictionaryReadable - location may differ but for hosted files on windows will be Users/<user name>/Zomboid/Saves/Multiplayer/<server name> Start the server back up - this will automatically regenerate the WorldDictionary files and allow clients to connect without crashing But why do I need to do all of this? The client syncs its own local copy of the server's WorldDictionary when connecting to the server. Any custom entities will still exist in the server's WorldDictionary with the flag removed=True whenever a mod is removed. Unfortunately in the current version of project zomboid multiplayer, this flag appears to be ignored and the client will crash with a reference error since the referenced entity scripts no longer exist for it locally. Deleting the server's WorldDictionary files forces the server to recreate them from scratch and they will no longer contain any entities from the removed mod allowing the client to properly connect once again. View on github for more information Workshop ID: 3439305933 Mod ID: FunctionalGutters Mod ID: FunctionalGuttersRemoved

description: The default F4-F6 speed settings can be customized to 1-10,000 speed, via sliders or text boxes. Note: the settings you set in the Mod options tab at the main menu do not currently apply in-game, you have to set the speeds you want while in-game for them to actually modify the F4, F5 and F6 hotkeys. Defaults are: F4 = 5 F5 = 20 F6 = 40 To better understand the speeds: if, for example, you set F4 to 10, it will be double the speed of what it is for vanilla. Be careful what speed you set, because if you set the values too high, the game can go by so fast your character will quickly die from hunger or thirst. Play around with what works best for you, and enjoy! description: The Best Lockpicking Old Mod, New Features! [p]"The Best Lockpicking" is a mod for Project Zomboid that adds realistic lockpicking mechanics and vehicle hijacking, expanding your survival options in the zombie apocalypse world. Forget about simply finding keys — now you’ll need to use your skills, tools, and a bit of luck to open doors, windows, and cars, or even break locks at the risk of damaging them permanently.[/p] TIP: [p]I recommend disabling “Separate Interface Processing” in the UI settings for smoother mini-game windows![/p] WARNING! To avoid errors, it is recommended to unsubscribe and resubscribe to the mod. Description: Adds realistic lockpicking mechanics for doors, windows, and vehicles using lockpicks or a crowbar. Lockpicking is performed through engaging mini-games! Introduces a hotwiring mini-game for stealing cars — feel like a real car thief. Allows you to check for alarms in houses and vehicles to avoid making unnecessary noise. Adds the “Lockpicking” skill, which affects success rate and speed. Introduces the “Lockpicker” perk and expands the “Burglar” profession for deeper role immersion. Key Features: Lockpicking System: Use lockpicks and screwdrivers for careful lockpicking of doors and windows with a mini-game that depends on your “Lockpicking” skill level. Use a crowbar for brute force — break locks with a chance of damaging them permanently. Vehicle Breaking: Open cars using a crowbar or lockpicks by completing mini-games that vary depending on the vehicle type. Feel like an electrician with the new Hotwiring feature — an interactive wire-connecting system where mistakes can trigger the alarm or headlights! (Not entirely realistic, I know.) Alarm Inspection: Inspect buildings and vehicles for active alarms before attempting to pick the lock to avoid attracting zombies. Realistic Interaction: The “Strength” and “Lockpicking” skills affect both success chance and lockpicking speed. Fatigue (Endurance) reduces efficiency — be careful not to overexert yourself! For details, see the changelog. Items: Lockpicking Magazine — Teaches the basics of lockpicking. Alarm Magazine — Grants the ability to check for alarms. Lockpick — Used for lockpicking along with a screwdriver. Improvised Lockpick — Crafted from paperclips (requires a screwdriver!). Guide to the New Lockpicking Mini-Game Game Overview [p]You need to control tension and lift the pins to open the lock. Each lock has a unique combination.[/p] Controls Mouse: Hover your cursor under a pin to interact. Lift the pin by moving the mouse upward. Tension Control Keys: A: Decrease tension. D: Increase tension. Hold the key for smooth adjustment. Game Mechanics Pins: Lift each pin to its setting point. Tension: Adjust the tension (shown in the top panel) within the indicated limits (for example, 3–5). Exceeding the limits increases the chance of breaking your pick or the lock. Hand Tremor: Your “Lockpicking” skill level and current tension affect random hand shake (chance increases with high tension and low skill). Compatibility: Tested on Project Zomboid build 42+. There are currently issues with some mods (the lockpicking mode can be interrupted when pressing movement or action keys): True Crawl — compatible (integrated patch). Common Sense — compatible (disable “Crowbar Mechanic” in sandbox settings). Want to Thank Me? Buy Me a Coffee. description: Uncle Dave was a prepper! UPDATED for 42.20 - Several maps are disabled until I have time to rework them with the new map updates. Also have not tested other mods compatibility yet. Love this mod? Hate it? Wish it had another location? Feedback welcome! Days ago a strange package from Uncle Dave arrived, it included a map and keys, but the note was cryptic and a bit confusing, but it's all starting to make sense now. It seems that Uncle Dave knew something was up and left some things for you. Or grab the 10 years later mod and set out to find more food and fuel. This mod provides a safehouse with water, power, and supplies. Use the options to set or exclude the various types, start with a map, or start in the safehouse. Each safehouse is fully plumbed and powered. Keep your generator in good condition and enjoy your creature comforts like working washing machines and flushing toilets (until the tanks run dry at least). Every safehouse has a pump, if the generator is running, it will gradually refill the tank over time. Many safehouses have wells or spring water. Recent updates should allow you to move and re-plumb fixtures within a reasonable radius of the original safehouse so you can access the safehouse's water tank. Uncle Dave was quite a collector and you might find a complete seed library (mods that use seed in their item names should be included). He was well known for being quite a reader, so perhaps he'll have left his complete collection of skill books and magazines too (works with Gyde's Trait Magazines and probably other mods that add anything to the skill category). About Loot Each location varies a bit, but will include a "essentials" storage with some commonly needed items. You can turn on all the locations and all the loot but this may make your game lag the first time you get near a safehouse I had some trouble fitting in the skill books and if you have a bunch of mods you'll find your shelves very full Recently I reworked some of the gun spawning. For most storages the lists work the same, pulling from the game's distribution lists, but I've added a "gun locker" for some spots. Instead of using the normal random distribution, it will build from a list ensuring some standard contents and a variable amount of ammo for the specific gun. At times the random spawn was giving me 10 guns and none of the clips for those guns at all. Lockers are also customized to have specific builds for the base game, but also if you use the Vanilla Firearms Expansion or Rain's Firearms & Gun Parts mods, you will find lockers built specifically for these mods. The guns are still random, but you'll get a full container of parts and ammo for a single gun with this change. description: Updated for b42.13, not tested in mp Review of the mod The mod adds the ability to grow fruits (apples and grapes at the moment, more in future). These plants survive the winter and do not progress in the winter, and continue their life cycle in the spring. Trees and grape vines do not rot after they have reached the final stage of growth. After harvesting, they return to the stage at which the bush/tree grew and the fruits grow again. Seeds can be found in the same place as vanilla seeds. They can also be crafted. If you can't craft seeds from rotten apples/grapes try press craft button and speed up time Can be installed into an existing save. All you need to do is find seeds in unexplored territory or find apples/grapes (fresh or rotten) and make seeds from them. The mod also adds the ability to create vinegar and salt: 1. In order to produce vinegar, you will need a Hand Press from pottering and a fermentation barrel added by the mod. Squeeze the juice from the apples and make vinegar from it. 2. To create salt, you can search for rock salt by Foraging in the same places where you find rocks, clay, limestone (you can find it from level 2 Foraging) Then you just need to grind it with mortar and pestle. UPD 16.03 Added the ability to create wine and added yeast to the vinegar craft. Also added the ability to create seeds from rotten fruits. UPD 17.03 Added a fermentation pot which helps in creating beer and sugar. Now you can create beer from wheat, cider from apples, sugar from sugar beets, yeast from beer. The pot itself can either be found in kitchens in unexplored territory or created yourself in the metalworking tab UPD 30.03 MAJOR UPDATE. The method of creating items has been completely reworked. Now everything that requires maturation must stand in a barrel for several days until it is fully ready. Including vinegar and yeast in a jar for several days. -All items now have hints on what to do with them next. -Added the ability to create whiskey. -Russian and Ukrainian localization added. -Added a fermentation barrel and a wooden barrel for storing drinks (A wooden barrel has a specific sound when pouring from it). -The ability to build a fermentation barrel has been removed as it no longer has crafting options. -Added moonshine still. -All crafts are now located in the Farming Expansion tab. -Reduced salt spawn and reworked item consumption in crafting after the release of 42.6. -Cherry added. -Added the ability to create juice in 5 and 10 liters at once. In future: -Adding crafts to various alcoholic drinks. -Adding more fruit trees. -Also suggest your ideas in the comments. v1.3 fix 2 -The seed crafting recipe has been adjusted to reflect the latest updates. It now uses only 1 fruit, even if it's rotten. -The juice recipe has been fixed. It now uses whole fruits instead of hunger units. -The beer brewing recipe has been fixed so that it no longer destroys an extra keg. -Fixed the sugar base recipe to use whole vegetables instead of hunger units. Suggestions for balancing things are also welcome. If anyone wants to help with drawing sprites and textures for the mod, as well as 3D models, please contact me in private messages. description: Build 42.12.3 – 42.20.3 | SP / MP Drink exactly what you need Drink Smart adds a 0% Thirst option to Project Zomboid's drink menu, letting your character drink only the amount needed to fully quench thirst instead of wasting extra liquid. It works with drinks in your inventory, containers, and ground panel, supports compatible sealed containers through Open and Drink, and can optionally show how much liquid will be consumed or add a small Sip action. Vanilla drink options are preserved. Main Features 0% Thirst — drinks only enough to reduce current thirst to 0. Works from the inventory, containers, and ground panel. Supports compatible sealed containers through Open and Drink. Optional consumed-amount display, e.g. 0% Thirst (0.30 L). Optional Sip action for very small drinks. Uses the liquid currently inside the container, so partially filled bottles are handled correctly. Note: This applies to inventory-style context menus, not to right-clicking placed world objects directly. Sandbox Options Allow Water Drink Low Thirst — Default: OFF Allows water sources to show drink options when Thirst is 10% or lower. All other vanilla drinking rules still apply. Show amount for 0% Thirst — Default: ON Shows the estimated amount consumed by 0% Thirst. Add Sip option — Default: OFF Adds a Sip option that drinks about 0.01 L, or all remaining liquid if less is available. Compatibility Compatible with Project Zomboid Build 42.12.3 – 42.20.3. Supports the relevant Build 42 versions through versioned mod folders. Designed for SP and MP. Safe to add to or remove from existing saves. Does not overwrite vanilla files. Build 41 is not supported. Possible conflicts are most likely with mods that replace or heavily modify the inventory drink context menu, especially: ISInventoryPaneContextMenu.createMenu ISInventoryPaneContextMenu.doDrinkFluidMenu ISInventoryPaneContextMenu.onDrinkFluid If you encounter an error, please use the Bug Reports discussion and include reproduction steps, your mod list/load order, and the first relevant ERROR + full STACK TRACE. description: Updated version for b42 of my mod Time Decreases Car Condition. HOW IT WORKS This mod adds a chance to greatly damage/remove vehicle parts CHECKED ONCE, WHEN THEY SPAWN. That chance will increase as time passes and can be customized in sandbox settings. Once a vehicle has been checked for damage (when they spawn), IT IS NEVER CHECKED AGAIN. The Sandbox Settings : Start Day : (default = 1) Peak Day : (default = 50) Start Chance to damage/remove parts : (default = 1) Applied before and on Start Day. Peak Chance to damage/remove parts : (default = 50 ) Applied after and on Peak Day. Check chance for removing parts: (default = true ) Uncheck this to disable removing parts Check chance for damaging parts: (default = true ) Uncheck this to disable damaging parts Check chance for breaking locks: (default = true ) Uncheck this to disable breaking locks Check chance for decreasing battery charge: (default = true ) Uncheck this to disable decreasing battery charge Check chance for deflating tires: (default = true ) Uncheck this to disable deflating tires Vehicle part chance multipliers: Chance multipliers for each type of part Starting from the Start Day, the chance to damage/remove parts will gradually increase until it reaches the peak chance, on Peak Day. After Peak Day the Peak Chance is always applied. For reference : to have it on the same level as Planetalgol's worse vehicle condition you would need to set the chance ~= 40 %. Note : The chance is applied ON EACH VEHICLE PART of a vehicle, and more often than not, it is applied more than once per vehicle part. It is not only once per vehicle. Some are applied the full chance once, others are applied half the chance, but twice. You can tweak these chances with the sandbox settings. Compatibility : It should work with most vehicle mods. description: B42.13 update: moving to unlisted, this mod needs a lot of work to fix and I don't think it's as important as it originally was now that the thumping behavior has changed a bit. B42.13.1 update: Apparently it is still needed if too many zombies are close together, so I'll see if I can get this working in B42.13 (SP first, then MP) NOTE: mod is currently not working in B42.13+ It's on my to-fix list, no ETA. One hundred zombies running down the street to kill you? Meh. Half a dozen zombies banging on a door somewhere in an apartment block? PANIC! This mod limits how much stress you gain from sounds, which in practice means you will not instantly panic when you get too close to big mob of zombies banging on a security grill. Stress will still build up, but at a reduced rate configured in sandbox options. The default cap of 15 seems like a good balance, but you can adjust this to taste. Yes, you can set it to zero and ignore all the bad noises. To completely eliminate stress from cutting down tress, use this mod Behind the scenes: Every tick the game adds up the stress of all stressful sounds, reduced by their distance (ignoring vertical height) from the player and increases your stress based on the total. This mod caps that increase. A single zombie thumping on a door has a maximum stress value of 15 per tick if you stand right next to it, but only when the sound is playing - there's no stress gain between thumps. So the default cap of 15 isn't the same as one zombie banging on a door, unless you squint at the numbers and say "good enough". FAQ Can this mod be added/removed to an existing game? Yes. If a single zombie banging on my door is a stress value of 15, why doesn't my stress value go up by 15 per tick and max out in 1/10th of a second? Because the sound stress is multiplied by 0.00002 before it is applied. The value in the sandbox options is before that multiplication, because it's easier for humans to deal with "15" than "0.0003" Workshop ID: 3460381012 Mod ID: NepStressGainCap

description: Compatible with Project Zomboid Build 42.12.3–42.20.3 (SP / MP) Clean Hot Bar improves Project Zomboid’s hotbar and hand-equipped UI with clearer item-status information, cleaner visuals, optional tooltips, scaling controls, and built-in slot reordering. The goal is simple: show useful information at a glance without turning the hotbar into visual clutter. Hotbar Status Information Clean Hot Bar integrates several Build 42 item systems directly into each slot: Overall condition: shown through the slot background and its color Weapon head condition + sharpness: combined into a single bar on applicable weapons such as axes White = current sharpness The remaining colored section = head condition above current sharpness Ammo counter: shows the ammunition currently loaded in firearms Toggleable items: clear ON / OFF indicators for flashlights and other activatable items Liquid contents: color-coded bars help identify container contents at a glance Because sharpness cannot exceed weapon head condition, both values are shown together instead of using two separate bars. Hand-Equipped UI The main-hand and off-hand slots use the same cleaner visual style, with refined textures, transparency, and additional status information. Hotbar and hand-equipped tooltips can be enabled or disabled independently. Liquid System Integration Build 42 liquid containers use color-coded status bars so their contents are easier to recognize quickly. Some liquid colors were originally created with AI assistance, so feedback is welcome if a color looks inaccurate or is difficult to distinguish. Visual Feedback Durability shake: an item briefly shakes when its condition decreases Condition flash: status values flash when durability is lost Liquid drain animation: smooth feedback while liquids are consumed Weapon condition warning: optional warning above the character when the equipped weapon loses durability Customizable Settings Use the button with the three horizontal lines next to the hotbar to open the Clean Hot Bar settings panel. Enable or disable individual status displays Adjust status-bar height Enable or disable hotbar tooltips Enable or disable main-hand / off-hand tooltips Scale the hotbar Toggle the weapon-condition warning Configure the built-in hotbar reordering system Settings are client-side. Each player can configure their own UI independently. Built-in Hotbar Reordering Clean Hot Bar includes its own slot reordering system. The controls are kept inside the settings panel so the hotbar itself stays uncluttered. Slot order is saved and restored automatically. Reorder The Hotbar is therefore usually not needed. Using both at the same time may cause visual or behavioral conflicts. If you use QoL Compendium, disable its Change quick access bar order option when using Clean Hot Bar’s reordering feature. Extra Slots and Authentic Z Clean Hot Bar supports hotbars with many additional attachment slots, including backpack upgrades from Authentic Z. The circular arrow button on the left side of the hotbar can automatically hide or reveal empty slots. Authentic Z users can also avoid adding unwanted backpack attachment slots or remove attachments they no longer need. Compatibility Compatible with Build 42.12.3 through 42.20.3 Supports SP, MP Host, and dedicated servers Compatible with CleanUI For best compatibility, place Clean Hot Bar near the bottom of the mod load order Conflicts are most likely with mods that replace hotbar rendering, attachment-slot logic, tooltips, equipping/unequipping behavior, or hand-equipped UI functions If a problem only happens with another hotbar/attachment mod, test both mods together on a new save before adding the rest of your mod list A compatible hotbar auto-hide option is also available through: [B41/B42] Minimal Hotbar It has worked in my tests, although every possible mod combination has not been tested. Installation Clean Hot Bar works on Build 42 only. Subscribe on Steam, wait for the download to finish, then enable it for the save through: Main Menu > Load > select save > More... > Choose Mods... For a new game, enable it from the mod selection screen before creating the world. For multiplayer servers, make sure the server configuration contains: · Mods=CleanHotBar · WorkshopItems=...;3461263912;... Then fully restart the server. Troubleshooting If the mod suddenly stops working after an update, with Project Zomboid closed: Unsubscribe from Clean Hot Bar Wait until Steam fully removes the old Workshop download Subscribe again and wait for the download to finish Verify the game files: Steam Library > right-click Project Zomboid > Properties > Installed Files > Verify integrity of game files Bug Reports When reporting a problem, please include: Project Zomboid version SP, MP Host, or dedicated server Clear steps to reproduce Exact affected item / slot when relevant Mod list and load order console.txt, coop-console.txt, or the relevant server log A screenshot or short video when possible For item disappearing, attachment-slot, crash, or compatibility reports, please use: Questions and Bug Reports Credits Original mod by Rocco: PZ Workshop Items Maintenance and compatibility updates for newer Build 42 versions by Afyrmo: PZ Workshop Items If you enjoy the mod and would like to support the original author: Workshop ID: 3461263912 Mod ID: CleanHotBar

description: Works for b42.20+ with MP support! It's a bicycle, hop on! There is also a B41 version of the mod, with multiplayer support! There's also a skateboard! And a kick scooter! ------------------------------ FEATURES ------------------------------ A rideable bicycle that increases movement speed while equipped. Hold SHIFT to go faster! Hold Right Mouse Button or CTRL to steer using the mouse. Press E while near a bicycle to hop on, and press E again while riding to hop off. Can be changed to a different button in mod options. Riding the bicycle without holding SHIFT takes as much stamina as walking (none), and holding shift takes as much stamina as running. Custom interactions and animations, right click the bicycle near a fence and use the "throw bicycle" option to get it over to the other side. The bicycle speed can be adjusted in mod options. Immersive Mode toggle in mod options, with it enabled you will go slightly slower on rough surfaces like grass/gravel/sand/dirt. Spawns in garages, storage units, sport stores, and a few other places where it makes sense to find bicycles. Parts system, find attachable containers, lamps, wheels and other parts to upgrade your bike! Sidecars! Find them in same places as bicycles (garages, storage units, etc.) and use them to transport loot and live animals! Is affected by leg/foot injuries and health. If you have a broken leg or foot then you can't pedal at all. ---------------------------- MOD INCOMPATIBILITIES ---------------------------- !! IMPORTANT NOTE !! Most issues should be resolved by placing the Bicycle at the TOP of the mod list, so try that if you're having an issue that is not listed below. Context menu to place bicycle in trunk might not work with some modded vehicles (tested and works with KI5 cars) ------------------------------ FAQ ------------------------------ How do I attach/detach parts like containers and wheels? Follow these instructions: -- 1. Have the parts in your main player inventory (!) NOT in a backpack/container. -- 2. Drop the bike on the floor and stand near it -- 3. Right click the bike choose "Upgrade" Why are the bicycles spawning without wheels and I can't attach anything to the bike? Most likely you're using Gael's Gun Store mod, or another weapon mod that interferes with the upgrade/remove upgrade actions. They cause conflicts with my mod. Why can't I put the bike in my inventory? You have to enable the "Allow transfer to inventory" in the mod options. How do I use the kickstand? Hold E to dismount with kickstand, press E to throw the bike to the ground. How do I ring the bicycle bell? Press Q (or your shout button if not using default) What's the difference between street wheels and offroad wheels? Street wheels go faster on smooth surfaces like roads, but slower on rough terrain like dirt, sand, and grass. There's also a chance to get flats if riding on rough terrain. Offroad wheels go slightly slower on smooth surfaces, but has no speed penalty and can't get flats on rough terrain. How do I repair a flat wheel? You can repair it with a rubber hose and tire pump, there's a recipe for it. ------------------------------ Credits ------------------------------ Big thanks to Nik for making the beige bike model and attachments, as well as helping set up the attachment system! Big thanks to Viruana for letting me use their spawn system! Big thanks to Large_Flamingo for making the new red bike model and all of the sidecars!
