description: SMB AUTOHIDEHUD See more of the world without giving up the HUD. SMB AutoHIDEhud smoothly moves the interface out of the way while you play and brings each panel back when your cursor reaches it. Nothing is permanently removed. Every HUD group can be controlled separately, and disabling one of the animations restores that part of the interface to its Vanilla behavior immediately. I made it because I wanted a cleaner screen, but I never wanted a hidden interface to become harder to use. CHOOSE WHAT LEAVES THE SCREEN Left icon sidebar, while preserving the Vanilla damage-heart alert. Moodles and right-side indicators. Bottom hotbar and optional vehicle dashboard. Player inventory and nearby containers. Clock and time controls. Minimap with a smooth fade and its own 3.5-second delay. Crafting, Building, Investigate Area and Character Information windows. Open Mod Options and select SMB AutoHIDEhud. Enable only the groups you want to animate and choose how long normal panels wait after the cursor leaves before retracting. The delay changes in real time. Animations freeze safely while the game is paused or a blocking menu is open, and hidden panels are moved outside the screen instead of leaving invisible click blockers over the world. HIDE EVERYTHING WHILE AIMING Enable Hide all HUD while aiming and every supported group leaves the screen while you hold aim, even when its individual animation is disabled. Release aim and each panel returns to the normal Vanilla or animated state you chose. INVENTORIES THAT WAIT FOR YOU Hidden inventory and loot windows reveal from their real title bars. The whole invisible panel no longer reacts simply because the cursor crossed it. Once open, the windows remain fully interactive. Move them wherever you want, pin each side independently, switch containers with a single click and double-click outside to close unpinned inventories deliberately. SMB AutoHIDEhud follows the actual position of the Vanilla windows instead of forcing them back to a fixed layout. SMALL TOOLS, SAME CLEAN SCREEN A draggable FPS counter using Project Zomboid's real client value, with color and size controls. A configurable key binding to hide or show the mouse cursor during gameplay. Optional removal of the Vanilla technical information in the bottom-right corner. Three subtle pulses when a new Moodle appears, without changing its color. A single clock appearance on each full hour with a quiet client-only chime. Interface options translated into 19 languages. All alerts are local. They create no sound in the world, attract no zombies and send nothing to other players. COMPATIBILITY SMB AutoHIDEhud is fully client-side. It works in single-player, on multiplayer clients and with split-screen HUD references without requiring server synchronization. description: Description The Knox Event did not immediately bring about the end of civilization. Deep inside the exclusion zone, the remaining personnel are still fighting to keep essential infrastructure alive. Power stations and water systems continue to operate, but without proper resources and maintenance, failures are becoming inevitable. Expect unexpected outages, temporary recoveries, and a slow decline of the systems that once kept the region alive. Features Dynamic Water and Electricity Blackouts – By default, water and electricity can randomly shut off (1% chance every 10 minutes) and be restored (5% chance every 10 minutes). Sandbox Options – configure blackout behavior to your liking. Light Flickering – before a blackout occurs, lights will flicker (as shown in the video). Moved from Sandbox Options to Mod Options, allowing each player to configure the effect individually, including in multiplayer. Immersive Radio – automated emergency broadcast system from Knox Emergency Regional Infrastructure Service (KERS) on 89.2 MHz. The radio provides warnings about upcoming water and electricity shutoffs, current infrastructure status, emergency announcements, and occasional corrupted transmissions with static and survivor broadcasts. Shutoff Days Range – configure a random range for the day when water or electricity shutoffs can occur. "Self-Cleaning" – once water and electricity are completely shut off, the mod stops affecting the game and can safely remain in your save. Safe to add or remove anytime – fully compatible with existing saves, no risk of breaking progress. Multiplayer Support WARNING Flashing Lights: This mod contains flashing and flickering lights that may trigger seizures or fainting in individuals with photosensitivity. If you experience dizziness, vision disturbances, muscle twitching, disorientation, or loss of consciousness, stop using the mod immediately and seek medical attention. Note You can disable Water or Electricity events by setting their chances to 0%. Current Issues Sometimes the game fails to play the electricity shutdown sound, which causes the power shutdown event to break, and some objects (for example, signs) may remain illuminated. description: SMB THEY SEE YOU You hear the sprinter before you understand where it is. SMB They SEE You gives each sprinter already living in your world one of 62 distinct voices and a stable pitch. You are not hearing a random horror effect; you are hearing a creature you may meet again. The goal is not constant noise. It is to make a rare sprinter feel like the same hunter from the first warning to the end of the chase. THE HUNT HAS A MEMORY The voice changes with what the creature is doing: Presence: a sprinter without a target may expose itself somewhere within range without starting a chase. Identification: when a sprinter commits to you within the configured time and range, that moment has its own scream. Close range: after being farther away, it can scream again when it reaches you. Hunt: later screams may break through a longer pursuit, controlled by chance and time between attempts. Rediscovery: lose it for long enough and the same hunter may announce that it found you again. Recovery: knock it down and it can find its voice again when it gets back up. Call and response: shout with Q and, sometimes, one nearby sprinter answers. These moments live inside hunt chapters. Each sprinter has its own limits and time between screams, but can gain a second wind after staying silent. The result is a creature that does not become mute forever and does not scream without end. ONE BODY, ONE VOICE, ONE POSITION Every scream plays from the moving 3D source of the sprinter that produced it. Direction, distance and floor follow the creature's real position, so careful listening can help you locate the threat and recognize the hunter that is still following you. Hard of Hearing characters hear the voices at a reduced level. Deaf characters do not hear them. When zombie reactions are enabled, a scream that actually happens becomes a sound the game's zombies can hear at the sprinter's real position and floor. Normal zombies and other sprinters inside the chosen radius may react to it. SHAPE THE TENSION Everything is organized inside one SMB They SEE You Sandbox category: Encounters: choose anytime, daytime or nighttime behavior; distant presence chance and range; close screams; rediscovery; chase timing; and the length of each hunt chapter. Voices: adjust overall, hunt and close-range volume, plus the stable pitch variation assigned to each sprinter. Zombie Reactions: decide whether screams attract zombies, how far they can hear and whether a real player shout may receive an answer. Advanced: prevent nearby screams from piling up and tune how far and how often sprinters are checked. The distant-presence controls affect only sprinters without a target. Turning them off leaves identification, close range, pursuit, rediscovery, recovery and player-shout responses intact. Each creature's own timing, hunt chapters, nearby-area quieting and processing limits prevent a crowded world from becoming a wall of sound or unnecessary work. The complete Sandbox interface is available in 19 languages. The mod does not create sprinters or change their population, speed, pathfinding or perception. It gives a voice to the sprinters your world already has. I designed the default experience around roughly 1-2% sprinters. At that rarity, one voice can make you stop looting, change direction or question a building that looked safe a moment earlier. MULTIPLAYER AND COMPATIBILITY In single-player, the event and playback stay local. In multiplayer, the server chooses the sprinter, scream, voice, pitch and origin, then sends that same event to nearby players. If the scream attracts zombies, the world reacts once, not once per player. If you want to act as a sprinter and record your own scream, join the project on Discord. Your voice may become a real creature hunting survivors in someone else's world. description: ☣️ THE ONLY LOGICAL APPROACH TO A ZOMBIE PANDEMIC ☣️ Obviously, the logical solution to a zombie apocalypse is to set up a full laboratory in your backyard and start poking around in contaminated blood. Build questionable equipment, perform autopsies with dubiously sourced tools, synthesize compounds that probably shouldn't be anywhere near fire, and try to develop a cure before your closest volunteer decides to take a bite out of you. You can set up a workbench, melt glass for tubes and flasks, process infected blood, extract leukocytes and antibodies, and—with a bit of luck—synthesize vaccines or maybe even a cure. 📚 Oh, and about the textbooks… Your virology books aren't exactly lying around in Grandma's living room. They're probably in military research sites, St. Peregrin Hospital and the Louisville university lab — you know, those charming places with armed checkpoints, biohazard warnings, and approximately eight million zombies per square meter. If you want to learn, you'll have to earn it. And by "earn it," I mean "run for your life while clutching a book like it's a family heirloom." 🏃 Good luck. You're gonna need it. ☠️ The idea of this mod is not to give you a free pass to ignore infection. It doesn’t remove the fear of death. Instead, it gives you a long-term goal — a chance to develop something that might save you. Until you reach that point, survival still comes first. You’ll need to stay alive, stay healthy, and manage your resources carefully. Research takes time, preparation, and risk. It means you can — and probably will — die in the process if you’re not careful. This is a complex system designed for players who want to dive deep into scientific research and experimentation. description: ZBBetterFPS A comprehensive performance overhaul for Project Zomboid that optimizes rendering, game logic, and CPU usage. Unlike traditional mods, ZBBetterFPS uses low-level runtime patching to fix performance bottlenecks deep within the game engine. ⚙️ All optimizations are disabled by default. Enable the ones you want in Mod Options → ZBBetterFPS after loading the game. 🚀 Key Optimizations: Smart Sprite Batching: Intelligently merges sprites and 3D models into fewer drawing commands, significantly reducing the load on your CPU. Graphics State Caching: Suppresses redundant graphics commands to ensure your GPU only receives necessary updates. Enhanced GPU Buffers: Increases internal render buffers to 1MB to reduce data transfer overhead between CPU and GPU. Faster 3D Models & Shaders: Optimizes the rendering of characters, items, and terrain through advanced data caching. Background CPU Throttling: Prevents the game from consuming 100% CPU when minimized or paused, keeping your PC cool while you're away. Adjustable Render Distance: Fine-tune how many tiles are rendered to match your hardware's capabilities. Streamlined Physics: Optimized math for object separation and physics updates to keep high-population areas running smoothly. ⚙️ Configurable Features: IndieGL Optimization: Caches graphics states for smoother rendering. RingBuffer Optimization: Larger GPU buffers for heavy scenes (Requires restart). Render Distance: Adjust from 24x24 to 312x312 tiles (Default is ~152x152). Background Throttling: Saves power and CPU when the game is not in focus. Uncapped FPS Control: Choose between Default, Force Uncapped, or Force Capped. ⚠️ Important: All optimizations are off by default—enable them in Mod Options. A savegame reload is required after changing the Render Distance setting for changes to take effect. The RingBuffer optimization requires a full game restart. Safe to add or remove on existing saves. ✅ Compatibility: Bandits: Compatible. When Bandits is enabled, minimum render distance is automatically limited to 130 tiles so bandit spawns work correctly. Game versions:: B41, B42.12 to B42.17 (inclusive) 📦 Installation: No manual installation needed for ZBBetterFPS! Just subscribe and enable it in the mod manager. You only need to install ZombieBuddy once (the required framework). See the ZombieBuddy mod page for instructions. After ZombieBuddy is set up, all mods that use it will work automatically! Requirements: ZombieBuddy - Required framework (one-time installation) Credits: Inspired by the original BetterFPS_B42 mod by Alree. ZBBetterFPS provides a modern, runtime-patched implementation with additional low-level optimizations. description: PhunServer is an essential lightweight mod for multiplayer Project Zomboid servers. Designed for admins who want automation, safety, and quality-of-life without babysitting their server. TL;DR Automatically monitors Workshop mods and can trigger a controlled shutdown when updates are detected Provides useful admin and player commands (/players, /hours, /sethours) Supports resetting the players map when seasons change or even if the player dies Allows independent day/night speeds Adds optional chat quality-of-life features (greetings, cleaner radio/music output) PhunServer: Misc Various commands and server-side quality-of-life settings. Related commands: /players – Shows all online players. Can optionally include players who have been online in the last 24 hours by ticking the Include Recent option. /hours <username?> – Returns hours survived. If no username is supplied (or the user is not an admin/mod), the issuing player is used. Target player must be online. /sethours <username?> <number> – Sets a player’s hours survived. Admins and moderators only. Target player must be online. PhunServer: Chat Ensure your players feel seen. PhunServer: ModWatch Automatically monitor the Steam Workshop and trigger a controlled server shutdown when one or more mods have been updated. Heavily inspired by the excellent Udderly Up To Date, which I otherwise could not live without. Important: PhunServer does not restart your server automatically. It can trigger a shutdown, but you will still need a host, cron job, or service to bring the server back online. Once restarted, Steam will automatically update mods. Related commands: /check – Immediately checks the workshop for updated mods and triggers a restart countdown if any are found /restart <minutes?> – Trigger a restart with an optional countdown (0 = immediate). If omitted, the configured Countdown setting is used PhunServer: Maps Settings that control player visibility on maps and allow controlled map wipes for resets or seasons. Note that (when enabled) a players map is wiped when their wipekey differs from the one in your settings. This is evaluated at login or when a character is created (e.g. a respawn after death), PhunServer: Cycles Settings that allow you to control the start, end, and speed of day/night cycles. description: Compatibility: Build 42.13 → 42.20+ (SP/MP) Fix NaN Stats automatically detects when gameplay values become corrupted as NaN (Not-a-Number) or Infinity and safely restores them to valid values — preventing broken moodles/HUD bars, “temperature/wetness = NaN” issues, pain/health glitches, and other weird behavior caused by invalid numbers. What this mod does Sometimes a value can become NaN or Infinity due to a bug, a mod interaction, or an edge case. Once a value is invalid, many systems stop behaving correctly. This mod is a lightweight safety net: Detects invalid numbers (NaN, +Inf, -Inf) in stats, nutrition, pain/health sources, thermoregulation, and worn clothing. Repairs only values that are actually invalid (it does not change normal values). Runs automatically while you play. Optional on-screen + log notifications when something is fixed (Mod Options). When should you use it? Use this mod if you notice any of these symptoms: A stat/moodle looks “stuck”, behaves strangely, or never updates correctly. You use status-bar HUD mods (e.g. Simple Status, Modern Status) and one of the displayed bars shows weird/blank values, freezes, or behaves incorrectly. The Debug UI shows nan or an invalid value for a stat, nutrition value, temperature, wetness, pain, or a clothing-related field. You get the “body temperature = NaN” / “wetness = NaN” type of bug (especially noticeable during winter runs). You suspect a mod or an edge case caused numeric corruption. You can keep it enabled permanently, or enable it temporarily to repair a save and disable it again afterward. What it fixes Character stats The mod checks every CharacterStat and repairs any value that becomes invalid. Common examples include: Hunger, Thirst, Fatigue, Endurance, Fitness, Drunkenness, Anger, Pain, Panic, Morale, Stress, Boredom, Unhappiness, Sanity, Comfort, Wetness, Temperature, Health, ColdStrength, Sickness, etc. Nutrition Calories Carbohydrates Lipids (Fats) Proteins Weight (fallback reset if needed) Pain / health sources (BodyParts / BodyDamage) Repairs invalid numbers in BodyPart/BodyDamage fields that can cause global Pain to snap back to invalid values. Repairs BodyPart wetness and pain sources (plus related timers/fields when present). If a BodyPart’s Health becomes NaN, it is restored to 100 to prevent corruption loops. Repairs OverallBodyHealth (General Debuggers → Body) when it becomes invalid. Thermoregulation (temperature/wetness) Recovers from “body temperature = NaN”. Recovers from “wetness = NaN” (including per-body-part wetness). Scans Thermoregulator thermal nodes and performs a safe reset/update when needed. Includes BodyPart wetness recovery to prevent invalid-number feedback loops. Worn clothing values (when they become invalid) Insulation (invalid → restored to a safe/script default) Wind Resistance (invalid → restored to a safe/script default) Clothing/item wetness Blood level Dirtiness Notifications (optional) If enabled in Mod Options, the mod can display a small message over the character (and also write a log line) when it fixes something. This helps you notice when a specific action or mod interaction produced an invalid value. Example: Fix NaN: Temp/Wetness | Clothing x4 (Insulation/Wind) | Stats: Thirst | Nutrition: Calories Multiplayer notes Works in Singleplayer and Multiplayer (hosted/dedicated). For MP, the mod should be enabled on the server so fixes are server-authoritative and clients stay in sync. Performance / resource usage Very low. The mod performs lightweight checks at a fixed interval and only writes values when something is actually invalid. During normal gameplay (with no NaNs/Infs), it effectively does nothing. Safe to add / safe to remove Safe to add to an existing save: it only repairs corrupted values. Safe to remove: it does not add items, recipes, maps, or permanent content. It simply prevents and repairs invalid-number corruption while enabled. Notes This mod is a “sanity fixer”: it does not attempt to diagnose the root cause, only to restore valid, playable values. If you consistently get NaNs/Infs, consider checking mod conflicts and reporting details (build number + mod list + steps to reproduce). Planned improvements Possible future updates may include: Configurable check frequency Custom reset values (per stat) Credits Afyrmo — Original author and main maintainer (Fix NaN Stats) Kaori — Helpful investigation, reproduction notes, and contributions that improved the 42.15+ fixes (thanks!) More mods & feedback You can find my other Project Zomboid mods here If you find Fix NaN Stats useful, please consider leaving a thumbs up and adding it to your favorites — it helps other players discover it. Feedback and suggestions are always welcome. Workshop ID: 3627071412 Mod ID: FixNaNStats

Newest Additions TwisTonFire - Map Improvements Make the vanilla World Map cleaner, more flexible, and more comfortable to use. Resize symbols, scale the complete symbol interface, mix additional colors, draw directly on the map, create dedicated sketch paper, and safely manage your map markings. The mod uses focused patch-style changes wherever possible instead of replacing complete vanilla files. Features Improved Map Symbols Interface Cleaner Map Symbols layout with a more organized and responsive interface. Map Symbol Size Slider for quickly changing the size of placed map symbols. Persistent symbol size: the mod remembers your last selected size. Custom default size: save your preferred symbol size and restore it with the Reset button. Complete UI Scale setting: resize the entire Map Symbols interface from 75% to 140%. Separate UI Scale window with Save and Reset controls. Custom-font safe layout that adapts to larger fonts and longer translations. More Colors and Writing Tools Additional mixed colors for map symbols and map notes: Yellow Purple Cyan Orange Pink Consistent color selection between the Map Symbols menu and the Add/Edit Note window. Vanilla-friendly pen requirements: regular colors require their matching pen. Mixed colors require both matching pens. For example, purple requires a red and blue pen. Improved writing-tool support for compatible modded pens, markers, crayons, and other items using the proper writing tags. Additional Map Symbols Seven new animal location symbols are included: Chicken Cow Pig Rabbit Sheep Turkey Raccoon Sketch Tools Draw directly on the World Map using a movable Sketch Tools panel. Freehand Tool for drawing naturally with your mouse. Straight Line Tool for creating clean and precise lines. Brush Erase Tool for removing only the sketch marks touched by the eraser. Adjustable Stroke Size for thinner or thicker markings. Adjustable Stroke Density for changing the spacing and smoothness of your strokes. Map color integration: sketches use the currently selected Map Symbols color. Writing-tool requirements: drawing requires a pen, pencil, or compatible writing tool. Eraser requirement: removing sketch marks requires an eraser. Undo and Redo for up to 20 sketch actions. Accurate cursor preview that matches the actual size and visibility of the placed sketch marks. Zoom-based sketch visibility: sketch marks can automatically disappear when the map is zoomed out. Adjustable visibility threshold through the native Mod Options menu. Performance-aware drawing that automatically adjusts stroke spacing on maps containing very large numbers of sketch marks. Persistent and Safe Sketch Tools UI The Sketch Tools panel remembers its position between game sessions. The panel automatically adapts to custom fonts and longer translations. Long button labels are safely shortened instead of breaking the UI. The panel is clamped to the visible screen and cannot be permanently moved outside the display. Sketch Paper Map Prepare a dedicated Sketch Paper Map from a regular Sheet of Paper. This provides a clean paper surface that can be used for drawings, plans, routes, notes, or anything else you want to sketch without using the main World Map. Improved Map Reset Options The vanilla map reset action now opens a safer selection menu. Choose exactly what should be removed: Remove Sketch Marks Removes only markings created with the Map Improvements Sketch Tools. Remove Player Symbols Removes player-created map symbols and notes while keeping explored map memory. Full Map Reset Removes player-created symbols and resets the complete explored map memory, matching the original vanilla action. Each destructive action includes a separate confirmation window to prevent accidental map deletion. Translations Translation files are included for 27 languages: Arabic, Catalan, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil), Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, and Ukrainian. Compatibility This mod is compatible with mods that add additional map symbols. Do not combine it with another mod that adds its own Map Symbol Size Slider. Map Improvements already contains its own localized and persistent Symbol Size Slider and changes the surrounding symbol interface layout. Supported Game Modes The current version requires Build 42.19 or newer. Your support helps me keep going — thank you very much! More Map Features Looking for even more World Map improvements? Check out Darker Map & Satellite View. Workshop ID: 3627539752 Mod ID: twistmapimprovements

description: Printer3D: Manufacturing & Recycling System A complete, balanced, and immersive industrial manufacturing and recycling system designed to integrate naturally into Project Zomboid’s survival gameplay. This mod introduces multiple types of 3D printers, filament materials, blueprints, power dependency, sound-based risk, and a late-game recycling pipeline — without turning the game into a factory simulator. Sustainability is not free. When industrial supplies run out, survival depends on dangerous, noisy, and unreliable recycling — not infinite resources. This is a tool for survivors, not a magic machine. Features Multiple 3D printer variants, each with a clear and distinct role Dedicated industrial recycling machine for late-game sustainability Real-time fabrication with noise propagation Power dependency (grid or generator) Printing failures, jams, and operational risk Filament-based material system Blueprint-based technological progression Portable emergency printer for survival scenarios Fully compatible with custom maps No crafting exploits, no infinite loops 3D Printer Types Standard 3D Printer Produces items faster than standard crafting Generates normal noise levels Provides reliable everyday printing Supports printing while you move around Requires indoor power Silent / Metal Printer Reduces noise output Maintains standard printing speed Performs well in urban or risky locations Supports printing while you move around Requires indoor power Fail-Safe Printer Reduces failure chance Maintains stable, controlled operation Supports long or advanced print jobs Supports printing while you move around Requires indoor power Focused on reliability rather than speed or silence. Portable Emergency Printer Compact and lightweight deployment Generates low noise Prints small emergency items quickly Requires the character to stay in place during printing Limited to small and medical items Requires indoor power Each printer is balanced to be useful — none is strictly better than the others. Printing System Printing takes real time Noise attracts nearby zombies Higher tiers increase noise and risk Power loss can cause failures Abandoning a print job has consequences Printing is a decision, not a free action. Filaments Different filaments affect: Print time Noise output Stability Access to advanced designs Advanced prints require multiple materials. Standard filament is always required as a base — precision and industrial filaments enhance or unlock advanced recipes. Blueprint Progression Blueprints define technological progress. Basic designs are common Advanced designs are rare Military locations provide faster progression Civil locations still allow long-term access Risk accelerates progress, but never blocks it. Blueprints are consumed on use. Item Acquisition Large printers spawn as rare industrial equipment Portable printers appear as rare survival loot Filaments and blueprints spawn in logical locations Fully compatible with custom maps No fixed locations. No memorized spawns. Every run is different. Sustainability & Recycling Finite industrial filament availability Late-game recycling as a survival fallback Higher risk, higher noise, higher failure rates Fully circular resource loop — no infinite production When resources run out, survival depends on what you can recover — not what you can endlessly craft. New in This Version (Framework v2.0 — Recycling & Sustainability Update) Recycling Machine System: Late-game industrial recycler that converts waste items into usable filament. Recycled Filament Type: A non-industrial filament with higher failure risk, intended for survival when standard supplies are gone. Circular Resource Economy: Empty filament spools are required for recycling, enforcing a balanced loop. Blueprint-Locked Recycling: Recycling unlocks only after mastering previous printer technologies. Anti-Exploit Safeguards: Switching to recycled filament permanently locks the printer into recycling mode. Machine Synchronization: Nearby printers synchronize recycling state to prevent exploits in SP and MP. High-Risk Operation: Recycling is loud, dangerous, and failure-prone. Expanded Recycling UI: Batch controls (x3 / x5 / x10), output previews, and failure probability indicators. Server-Safe & MP Compatible: Fully server-authoritative logic with deterministic outcomes. Sustainability isn’t safe. Recycling is loud, dangerous, and never guaranteed. Design Philosophy This mod does not make survival easier. It gives you options — at a cost. Noise, power, time, and risk always matter. Once you commit to a path, there is no undo button. Enjoy, survive, and choose carefully. description: Create blueprints. Build from blueprints. Share blueprints. See this quick video for a basic exemple. How to clear an area ? You need to right click any square, select Architect menu and click on Clear Area. You need left click, drag and release to define the zone. Then clearing action starts. How to make a virgin blueprint ? You need something to write (like a pencil). You need something to write on (like a book). The craft recipe is known by everyone and can be found in the misc recipe category. How to write the description of a building on a blueprint ? You need virgin blueprint. You need to right click a square inside a mapped building, select Architect menu and click on Save Building. This is strictly limited for initial map buildings. How to write the description other parts of the map on a blueprint ? You need virgin blueprint. You need to right click any square, select Architect menu and click on Save Area. You need left click, drag and release to define the zone. Then writing action starts. Once done, the affected blueprint will have an awfull name with ingame x & y / start & end positions. You can change it as you prefer with right click and write on the item. How to build from a written blueprint ? You need a written blueprint (either from a building or from an area). If activated from sandbox options, you need the associated building material. You need to right click a square, select Architect menu and click on Place Building. A preview of a rectangle containing the lowest floor of your building can be visualised (with eventual doors). Click to validate. An action starts that takes a little time then the building is applied. If you deactivate "Adjust Building Zone" (default: activated) from sandbox options, the clicked square wil be the most south-east point of a rectangle around the building. With "Adjust Building Zone" active, you can change the position of that most south-east point and validate with left click. By keeping "Preview Building Zone" active (default: activated) from sandbox options, you can keep track of the rectangle around the building. By keeping "Preview Doors" active (default: activated) from sandbox options, you can keep track of the doors around the building (as a thick green symbol). You can cancel the building until the end of the action like with vanilla building actions (by pressing escape key or moving or being bitten by a Z). Building Cost (Sandbox options) You can activate and tune the cost of buildings to your liking from sandbox options (active by default). Building Cost is a number of items per "inside" square to build. Tick: Activate Building Cost Building Cost syntax is "Item1FulltType:NbOfItem1;Item2FulltType:NbOfItem2;Item3FulltType:NbOfItem3;". Use Building Cost default value as an exemple. The cost of a building is computed once when saving the blueprint. Changing the sandbox options afterward will only impact the cost of future blueprints. Technical details Can be added and removed from any game save any time. Multiplayer is now available. In Multiplayer, wall Lightswitches are not working. (under investigation) Joypad is not handled. The result of a building action has a similar behaviour to player-built structures, not to vanilla buildings. You can name your blueprints with vanilla item context menu option (write). Huge buildings are strongly NOT ADVISED ! Those (e.g. Malls) will create various unpredictable problems depending on MP / Solo including crashes, never ending freeze and up to save corruptions. Do not clear basement stairs or your way to it from below (use Debug > Cheat >Fast move if you did). This mod is sort of overpowered which may lead to boredom, beware. Use this other mod for B41 and previous versions. If you have questions or problems about the mod, ask on Official PZ Discord: mod_support channel. Credits CN/CH Translation here. Blueprint icons created by Freepik - Flaticon This mod is dedicated to Sinai, who I know nearly nothing about except their pseudonym, but who's work for Outward modding community impresses me greatly. On Lockdown This mod cannot be modified by anyone else, for anything else, at all, ever. Even if the user disappears, he or she would much rather you didn't touch the fruits of their hard labour. description: GLOBAL UPDATE: V2.6 The mod improves the gameplay and visual components of the original Bandits mod, and also introduces minor changes to the Bandit AI. For detailed information, please read below. Even though the previous patch of this mod failed due to my inexperience, this one brings major changes. I have slightly shifted the initial direction of the mod, but it will still be refined and expanded over time. Features & Changes Surrender System (V2.1) This mechanic is implemented and will be further refined soon. Currently, it works like this: let's say there are 4 bandits in a group and you kill 3 of them — the 4th one will surrender. Before surrendering, the bandit will drop all their belongings on the ground and play a corresponding animation, after which they will freeze with their hands in the air. At this point, you have 2 options: kill them or let them go. If you choose the 2nd option, they will simply run away from you in a random direction. If a bandit surrenders to a rival group of bandits, a "cutscene" mode is triggered. One random bandit from the group will be chosen to take on the role of the "executioner", while the rest will simply point their guns at the captive. You will see the executioner walk up to the surrendered bandit, loot them, and then execute them. Visual Component: Dropping Weapons Yes, bandits now finally drop the weapons from their hands upon death. I've wanted to implement this for a long time! Technical Component: Hell Yeah, Radios! The main new feature of the mod is a radio system. Radios drop when a bandit dies, and they are quite interactive. The core feature is that bandits now have the ability to request backup. Whether that backup arrives or not is something you'll have to guess based on the text coming from the other side of the radio. [] Semi-Dynamic Dialogue: Radios do not just broadcast static text. All voice lines and responses are semi-dynamic. Everything depends on the specific situation the bandit is in. The radio also reacts to the weather and the time of day (nighttime). [] Dynamic Scenarios: The main goal of these radios is to make the original mod feel alive. Imagine a squad of bandits spawns at a random gas station, dies pointlessly to zombies, and that's it. But now, thanks to the radios, one of the bandits manages to report the casualties at the very last moment. With a certain probability, a voice from the radio will approve an evacuation and send backup... or they might refuse... or maybe the radio frequency will be intercepted by raiders and an inter-clan shootout will break out. Who knows? :D Advanced Combat & Backup AI (V2.5) This update brings massive improvements to how bandits fight and coordinate, particularly for reinforcements called in via radio: [] Active Patrols: If backup arrives and there is no visible enemy, the squad will now spread out and actively patrol the area until they make contact. [] Hivemind Vision: The arriving backup group utilizes a "hivemind" shared vision system, allowing them to instantly coordinate their hunt once an enemy is spotted by any member. [] Reworked Suppression & Flanking: The suppression system has been heavily refined. Bandits will now utilize suppressive fire to execute V-shaped flanking maneuvers against the enemy. [] WIP CQB Module: Reinforcements now feature a Work-In-Progress Close Quarters Battle (CQB) module for better tactical movement and combat inside buildings. Future Plans I am still refining the mechanics (and will also polish the voice lines). Soon, I plan to create a separate, procedurally generated radio network in each world with custom dialogues, and add even more ways to interact with the radios. Configuration The mod is fully configurable in the Sandbox Settings. You can find these options in the exact same tab where the original Bandits mod settings are located (scroll to the very bottom). Author's Recommendations I highly recommend using this mod alongside Bandits Creator and custom clans. Why? Because it will be absolutely hilarious if a group of, say, medievalists urgently requests backup or a tactical evacuation over the radio! Known Issues [] The radio sound still doesn't account for distance perfectly (I will fix this soon). [] The custom AI program for the radio backup bandits is not fully finished yet, so bugs are possible. Support the Mod If you'd like to support my work (and help pay for the AI subscription :D) so that my lazy ass updates the mod faster, you can buy me a coffee here: ☕ buymeacoffee.com/krwxch Disclaimer: Please keep in mind that the mod still contains bugs. I do not know how to code personally — Gemini AI helps me write the code. I will fix issues over time, so if you find a bug, please report it. Feedback and bug reports are welcome! description: Better Auto Mechanics Train mechanics with a single click. Smarter, more intuitive, and lightweight. In Multiplayer and Singleplayer. Rewritten from the ground up, Better Auto Mechanics is a comprehensive quality-of-life upgrade for the mechanic skill. Inspired by the original mod "AutoMechanics", it improves on several key features while still allowing you to train mechanics on vehicles with a single button. And it works in multiplayer! Compatible with all B42 versions! B41 is not supported, use this instead. 🔧 Key Features Smart XP Tracking: The mod knows exactly when you can't gain XP from a specific car anymore. It will alert you if a vehicle isn't worth training on, so you never waste time. Resume Interrupted Training: If zombies interrupt you (or you cancel an action), you can pick up exactly where you left off. No more starting from scratch and wasting part durability! Efficiency First: The mod will never perform an action if it won't yield XP. Clearer Tooltips: Know exactly what tools you need and how your skill level, known recipes, and other factors impact the training before you start. Fast-Forward Supported: Fully supports speeding up the game in SP, allowing you to breeze through your training sessions. Nearby zombies will still reset the game speed to normal. Batch Uninstall: Quickly strip vehicles for spare parts! Use the new context menu to batch-uninstall specific categories like all doors, all tires, or completely strip the entire car bare with a single click. Translated into: English, German, Russian, French, simple + trad. Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Polish. 🚗 How to Use Open the mechanics window on any vehicle. Right-click any part. Select "Train Mechanics". Watch the levels go up! Note: Pathfinding can sometimes impact the training session. Please ensure your character has some walking space around the car. 💡 Tips You can only gain XP from a specific vehicle once per day. Right-click directly on a vehicle in the world to access the "Train Mechanics" button faster. The "Train Mechanics" button is automatically hidden once you reach Mechanics Level 10. ⚙️ Mod Settings You can customize the "Minimum Vehicle Part Success Chance" in the options. This value determines the safety threshold for installing/uninstalling parts; any part with a success chance below this value will be skipped during training. 0 (Risky): All parts will be worked on. Be careful—parts will break or lose condition at lower skill levels. 30 (Default): A good balance. Parts with a very low success chance are skipped to prevent excessive damage, while still allowing for decent XP gain. 100 (Safe Mode): Only parts that are guaranteed to succeed will be worked on. This is completely safe at all skill levels, though training may be slower as fewer parts are eligible. Multiplayer / Server Admins: Server owners can enforce this setting via Sandbox Options. -1 (Default): The setting is not enforced. Players are free to use their own local Mod Option setting. 0 to 100: The setting is enforced server-wide. Any value greater than -1 will override individual player choices. The value set by the server will be visible in the button tooltip. ✅ Compatibility & Save Info Safe to add and remove mid-save. Compatible with all KI5's Vehicles, Project Summer Car, Vehicle Repair Overhaul, and most other vehicle mods. description: Burd's Survival Journals Record your survival skills in personal journals and learn from the fallen. Find worn journals in bookcases and desks, loot bloody journals from zombie corpses, risk cursed journals for powerful rewards, or unwrap seasonal Yuletide gifts packed with supplies. Your knowledge doesn't have to die with you. Pass your journals to new characters, trade them with friends, or discover what survivors left behind before they turned. Leave a like or favorite if you're enjoying the mod, more features & polish to come down the line. Any feedback or bugs? Drop them in the comments or start a discussion! Features Sandbox Options — Fully Configurable Journals - Player: Enable/disable, XP recovery modes, baseline restrictions, pen/eraser requirements, learning times, capacity limits Journals - Loot: Spawn chances, XP ranges, trait/recipe/forget chances, limited-claim dissolution Journals - Loot (Fun): Cursed journal settings (curse types, disguise mode), Yuletide season timing and gift tiers, Krampus integration Journals - Advanced: Skill book multipliers, reading skill speed bonuses, light requirements, batch processing, multiplayer permissions, animated visuals toggle Journals - Other Mods: Compatibility toggles for Traits Purchase System, Adaptive Traits, Evolving Traits World, VHS skills Nearly everything is adjustable. Run it hardcore with strict limits, or generous with plentiful rare drops. Your server, your rules. FAQ Q: Does this work in the latest multiplayer build? A: Yes. Full server-authoritative multiplayer support with claim tracking, sharing permissions, and admin tools. Working Builds Checklist: ✅ B41 - SP/MP - Full working. Recently released, may not be as stable as B42 branches. ✅ B42 SP/MP (Up to 42.14) - Fully working ✅ B42.15+ SP/MP - Fully working Q: Will this break my existing save? A: No. Safe to add to current saves. "Only Record Earned Progress" takes effect on your next character respawn if you already have an established run. Removing the mod during save could destroy active player or loot journals. Q: Can I exploit this with profession skill farming? A: Not easily. Baseline restriction (enabled by default) prevents recording starting profession XP. You'd have to earn it the hard way first. Q: What traits can bloody/cursed/Yuletide journals have? A: Positive traits like Keen Hearing, Cat's Eyes, Organized, Brave, Fast Learner, and more. Negative traits are disabled by default but configurable. Cursed/Yuletide have higher drop chances for traits and forget slots. Q: Is this compatible with other mods? A: Generally yes. Works with most skill/trait mods that use standard B41/B42 registration. Compatibility toggles included for major trait mods. Safe function capture prevents crashes from conflicting mods. Q: How do cursed journals work? A: 0.08% zombie drop chance to replace a normal bloody journal spawn. Opening one applies a curse (10 possible effects), then transforms into a premium reward journal with 2-5 skills at 75-300 XP each. Can disguise as bloody journals if sandbox setting enabled - no warning prompt, immediate curse. Q: When do Yuletide journals spawn? A: During December by default, but configurable for in-game December, real-world December, or always-on. Replace worn (default 8%) and bloody (default 4%) spawns when active. Q: Can I use player journals as a memory system for my whole server? A: Yes. Record skills/traits/recipes, drop the journal in a shared base, let others claim. Per-character tracking means everyone gets their own copy of the progress. description: PZ Marketplace - Global Economic System Tired of risky hand-to-hand trading? Ready to build a real economy on your server? PZ Marketplace GES adds a fully functional, secure, and synchronized global trading system accessible through in-game computers. Build a thriving server economy without the fear of scammers, dupes, or database wipes. Features for Players Global Trading Network: Buy, sell, and browse items using any working computer in the world. Virtual Bank: Deposit cash into a secure virtual bank account and withdraw it whenever you need it. Smart UI and Filters: Stylish OS-style interface. Search items by name, filter by category, or set minimum/maximum price limits. The contract system: Post your tasks for other players or complete other players' contracts to earn in-game currency. Sales history: The ability to view who bought your product and when, and how much money you received for it. Delivery system: More immersion! The items will not arrive immediately in your inventory, but after the appointed time. Accurate Condition Tracking: The system correctly reads and displays the condition (durability) of weapons, tools, and clothing in percentages (%). Offline Protection ("Mailbox" system): If an admin wipes the market or someone returns an item while you are offline, your items won't disappear! They will be safely stored in a hidden queue and automatically added to your inventory the next time you log into the server. Features for Server Admins (Zero-Desync Architecture) This mod was built from scratch specifically for Build 42+ Multiplayer, focusing on extreme database safety and anti-dupe mechanics. Bulletproof Anti-Dupe: Strict server-side validation prevents quantity mismatches (e.g., duping nails, ammo or liquids in containers). Items are verified by their unique IDs before any transaction. Built-in Transaction Logs: Every single action (Create, Purchase, Cancel, Deposit, Withdraw) is logged. Admins can view the last 100 transactions via a secret in-game Log Panel (color-coded for convenience). A permanent log is also saved to the "Lua/MarketplaceTransactions.txt" file on the server. In-game Admin Panel: Players with administrator access receive secret buttons in the interface that allow them to view logs, safely clear the market, or configure the server in real time (Tax, Lot Limits, Custom currency, delivery time) without leaving the game. Economy Control & Custom Currency: Easily change the default Base.Money to any item (e.g., Gold, Diamonds) via the Admin Panel. Safety feature: changing the currency automatically wipes existing virtual balances to prevent inflation exploits. Virtual balances also track down to the cent to prevent rounding losses on cheap items. roadmap (currently in development) Mailbox: I plan to add a mailbox to which the purchased product will arrive. It will be located in the construction menu and will be linked to a specific player. ATM: Adding ATM crafting capability. replenishment and withdrawal of cash will be available only through it. How it Works Find any computer terminal in the game (e.g., in offices or banks). Ensure the building has electricity (from the grid or a generator). Right-click on the computer and select "PZ Marketplace". Deposit money into your account, list your loot for sale, and start earning! Technical Details Game Version: Project Zomboid Build 42.14.0+ Multiplayer: 100% compatible Performance: Highly optimized. Uses a "Fat Client" UI approach with server-side limit checks, ensuring zero impact on server FPS even during active trading. description: Currently working on: B41 and B42.20 SP/MP Updates Update 1.4 Fixed Safety button white background when sidebar is hidden Safety button now shows when toggling PVP (G key) in multiplayer Update 1.3 Added animation speed option for sidebar transitions Improved internal code for better stability and compatibility with other mods Update 1.2 Added animation support for borders and text colors on non-vanilla custom buttons Added option to enable or disable Minimal Sidebar in the options menu Furniture button now remains visible and opaque while the tool is active (Pick Up, Place, etc.), even when the sidebar is hidden Update 1.1 Mod added to B41 version Added smooth fade-in/out animations for the sidebar and hand slots Heart icon now briefly appears when taking damage (pulsating) and fades out smoothly afterwards Added Show Heart on Pulse option in Mod Options (Default: Disabled) Mod Description Minimal Sidebar keeps your interface clean and immersive by automatically hiding sidebar shortcuts when they are not in use. When hovering over the sidebar, all shortcuts become visible again. If an item is equipped, it remains visible as a floating icon, ensuring quick access without cluttering the screen. Features Automatically hides sidebar shortcuts when not hovering Equipped item remains visible as a floating icon Clean and minimalist UI No gameplay impact FAQ The pulsing heart icon does not appear when taking damage. What can I do? A: By default, the animation stays invisible when the panel is not visible. However, you can enable it in the mod options tab. If you are using B41, Mod Options B41 is required to enable it. The animation looks slow or laggy. What can I do? A: Increase the UI FPS. The higher the UI FPS, the smoother the animation will be. It is not hiding automatically. What could be causing this? A: I recommend checking if there are other mods overriding the game side panel. Try changing the load order and, if it still does not work, it is likely an incompatibility with another mod that is overriding a crucial function used by this mod, which is ISEquippedItem. For Modders Minimal Sidebar hooks into ISEquippedItem and automatically applies fade-in/out and opacity logic to its child elements. Any UI element added as a child of ISEquippedItem will automatically follow the sidebar visibility state. Supported UI types are ISButton and ISImage. No custom fade or visibility logic is required from other mods. If you override a custom render function, you must respect the alpha values controlled by Minimal Sidebar, such as textureColor.a, backgroundColor.a, borderColor.a, and textColor.a. This system is designed to be safe and compatible with other UI mods, as long as they do not override ISEquippedItem. Example require "ISUI/ISEquippedItem" local original_createChildren = ISEquippedItem.createChildren function ISEquippedItem:createChildren() original_createChildren(self) local myButton = ISButton:new(0, 50, 20, 20, "X", self, nil) myButton:initialise() myButton:instantiate() -- Critical: ensure the Type is set myButton.Type = "ISButton" -- Add as child so Minimal Sidebar can control visibility self:addChild(myButton) end Workshop ID: 3642084851 Mod ID: MinimalSidebar Workshop ID: 3642084851 Mod ID: MinimalSidebar

description: What it does Pick a weapon and stick with it. Every zombie you kill with it is counted, per weapon. Hit enough kills and it starts earning stuff: more damage, faster swings, bigger mags, better crits, tougher condition. Your beat-up machete slowly turns into something with a name, a stat line, and a bit of an attitude. If you played Vorpal Weapons on Build 41, you already know the loop. This is that idea, rebuilt from scratch for Build 42. "Something stirred within it. I felt it before I saw it." Three tiers Keep killing and the weapon climbs three tiers: Marked - it picks up its first affix. Bonded - a second affix stacks on. Blooded - past 200 kills, it gets a full multi-stat bonus and becomes properly yours. Every tier-up fully repairs the weapon, so a blade you've bonded with won't just crumble on you. Thresholds are all sandbox-adjustable if 200 feels too high or too low. "It stopped being a separate thing. It's just my arm now." Weapons get a personality On top of the stat affixes, each weapon grows a character based on how you actually use it. Fight at night a lot and it turns Nocturnal. Kill fast and often and it goes Ravenous. Play slow and picky and it becomes Patient. Never touch a whetstone and it stays Pristine. Change how you play and the personality drifts over a few days. These aren't just labels. A Nocturnal weapon cuts your panic at night. A Patient weapon gives crit chance. A Scarred weapon gains durability when you repair it. The effects get stronger as the weapon levels. Your tooltip ends up reading something like Proven. Nocturnal. Hunting. (that last word is a live mood that shifts with time of day, weather, and how rough things are right now). Guns too Pistols, rifles, shotguns, SMGs, all of it. Same kill-and-grow loop. Affixes can change fire rate, accuracy, magazine size, reload speed, recoil, noise, jam chance, and stagger. Your M9 turns into a Steady M9 of the Arsenal. Your shotgun ends up a Blooded Savage Shotgun of Destruction. It works with weapon mods automatically. Rain's Firearms, Brita's, whatever you run. If Zomboid treats it as a weapon, this mod will bond with it. Blooded weapons survive being reforged Saw off your shotgun, dismantle your fire axe, build a nail bat. If the weapon is Blooded, all the history carries over to the new form: kills, affixes, the lot. Lower-tier weapons don't survive the change, the bond has to run deep enough first. So a Blooded blade you've carried for 300 kills stays yours even when you turn it into something else. Vorpal Shards Something fell from the weapon. Sharp. Warm. Shards turn up rarely out in the world. Use one to reroll a weapon's affixes, three rerolls per shard. The old rolls get logged in your journal so you don't lose the record. description: -------------------------------------------- B42 -------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------STAGE [1] FULL REWORK----------------------------------- -------------------------------------------- B42 -------------------------------------------- TESTED WORKING IN 42.20! Adds down-to-earth blacksmithing path to craft vanilla katana-style weapons and tools with varying degrees of condition and sharpness. While also being able to do almost every task in the woods off of only what is provided by your skills, efforts, and of course a little luck never hurts. Includes step-by-step methods to smith, hone, and assemble makeshift weapons and tools, making full use of the new vanilla crafting systems - from Blacksmithing to Assembly. Includes skill magazines to learn the crafts. This mod favors time, practice, and material investment over randomness or shortcuts. Early progress is slow by design. Expect long periods of subsistence before advancement. Designed for Build 42 vanilla crafting systems. Crafted katanas are powerful, but quality is never guaranteed - mastery comes from repetition, not RNG. xxxxxxxxxxx EARLY SURVIVAL xxxxxxxxxxxx Fire, clean water, tools, and food all have emergency methods - but none are meant to be comfortable or efficient. Every system has a desperate fallback. None are meant to replace proper tools. Build primitive forges and furnaces in almost any walk of life. Fish with only what nature provides, make a hook out of hardwood or even twine when there is nothing else. (These variants will be much worse at catching anything than an actual hook.) Cook primitive soup or tea in salvaged empty tin cans. Scrape wood to gain understanding and/or healing bark shavings. Build stone wheels or blocks out of hard pressed clay blocks. Filter water using a cut bottle and precious time and resources. Progress is often logistical, not technological - carrying, storing, and preparing materials is advancement. + STAGE 1 - LEARNING THE TAO Begin by devoting your life to all types of metal and many new disciplines. Find the magazines and study the crafts. Or put in the work and learn how to make each tool and weapon strike by strike. Focus on practicing Blacksmithing - we all start somewhere. Pour metal, sweat and knowledge. Build your skills in Blacksmithing, Pottery, Masonry, Fishing and Foraging. Be rewarded for practice and patience, hone skills across the entire experience. At Blacksmithing Level 2, the journey truly begins. Routine, patience, and preparation are progression. + STAGE 2 - DEVOTION & DEDICATION TO THE TAO Practice mixing coal and precious metal scraps to create Flux Powder. After crafting many different metal tools and components, you begin to understand the elements within scrap more clearly. Separate scrap to extract Carbon Chunks. With time and dedication, you will become capable of drawing out the carbon needed to begin true blade smithing. During your training and development of your crafts, you can also hammer out crude weapons and tools, and even with enough uninterrupted time and dedication you could forge almost anything. Explore different metals and make new things out of old ones. + STAGE 3 - BECOMING ONE WITH THE TAO This stage will take a long time. During this time you can pour metal into various ingots, and even combine others to make alloys. ==================================== You will craft many blades. You will also craft many tools Most will be dull. Some will be fragile. Few will meet true standards. Everything will eventually break. ==================================== But as you practice and refine your craft, you will grow with the steel and curve with the edge. Become more capable and able to make something from nothing. And one fateful day, you among the far and rugged few may finally say: "I have crafted a True Warrior's Katana." "Great works are performed not by strength, but by perseverance." - Samuel Johnson "The two most powerful warriors are patience and time," - Leo Tolstoy --------------------------------------------------------------- Become an Ancient Swordsmith. Walk the Way. --------------------------------------------------------------- (Tested in a live multiplayer environment with 100+ mods!) (Designed to coexist with large mod lists and multiplayer pacing!) --------------------- COMPATIBILITY --------------------------- It seems most things in B42.13 do not respond well to anything that changes + IStimedaction Otherwise should be compatible with everything unless it touches the same files. MY MOD CHANGES + entity_hand_press (Edits TIS Build Recipe) + entity_kiln_large (Edits TIS Build Recipe) + fishing_properties.lua (Makes my fish hooks valid and adds new trash loot and other goodies?) ===================================== RECOMMENDED ===================================== I highly recommend this mod at least for crafting to make sense. (IntuitiveCrafting) As well as this to make crafting less menu heavy. (SmartRadialMenu) THESE TWO MAKE CRAFTING SIMPLE AND FUN!! Also to be able to gather water in the wild we would build a well. (GRM-MyOwnWell) (GRM-MyOwnWell-Primitive) This one will add more forageables, and the ability to make primitive medicines. (herbalist) Before you say "These timings are really long" understand the scope of this is for a concept. Anyone, at any skill level, can do almost anything with enough time and energy. Meaning that it is meant to be long, difficult, and painful. However it is also rewarding, your efforts will bear fruit of many kinds all you have to do is sow the seeds. Known Issues.... B42 is buggy. That being said I personally am and have exclusively tested ALMOST every single line of code I have added or tweaked. Spent countless hours with a line in the water to check the fishing functions and easily over 100+ hours for all other functions and progression paths. I spent some time trying to understand TIS animations for recipes, but anything that needs a craft GUI (Ie: Sharpening Stone, Forges, Kilns, Furnaces) if you close the craft menu the recipe halts. Fishing rods are weird, they work but they are odd. NOTES ON FISHING RODS FOR B42.13+ MOST IMPORTANT CAST LINES ONLY USING PRIMARY AIM FUNCTION (MOUSE BUTTON) DO NOT USE AIM KEY YOU WILL NOT PULL CATCHES IF CHARACTER IS AIMING EVER 1. description: You can now build a raft and use it to cross water. See this quick video for a basic exemple. Build the Raft You need 2 levels of Carpentry and 1 level of Tailoring. You need 5 logs, 3 ropes, 1 sheet and 1 saw. The ingredients may be replaced by similar items (all use tags). The recipe is known from start. The raft is heavy, build it close to the water. Control the raft To enter the water, you need the raft in your inventory. Ensure the wind will not push you back to the shore immediately. Walk to the water, the rest is automatic. Once on the water, you control the direction with the cursor like when in combat or sit. Once on the water, the drag and drift depend on the wind force and direction. You can use forward and backward control to move the raft if you have a paddle equipped. To exit the water, you need to join a shore and once arrive just walk to the ground to get up. Once on the water, you can move the Anchor Up / Down from the Emote menu. (The anchor is magically moved up while the wind is at or above 8 Beaufort) The Wind The wind direction can be known from vanilla radio weather forecast. The wind direction can be known from the wind rose. (color and visibility are controlable from mod options) No arrow means no wind (or neglectable). When the wind becomes dangerously strong, the arrow becomes more red. (Unless you chose red color for the arrow) Fishing Fishing is possible from the raft if you have a fishing rod. Ensure you are not moving while fishing. Fishing model is not made for this and I did not add protection yet. Credits Anchor icons are copied from Aquatsar mod. Technical details The West / East axis on the wind rose is exact but the closer you are to North or South, the less precise it is compared to the map. (the rose is orthogonal, and does not respect isometry) E.g. If the wind if full North, it will push to the right of the Wind Rose direction. Can be added to any game save any time. Can be removed from your game save as long as your character is NOT on water. Multiplayer available but the positions of other players on raft are not updated correctly. Joypad is not handled. Works only for B42.13.1 and further. Not compatible with Aquatsar Yacht Club or any other mod allowing to move on water. This mod is sort of overpowered which may lead to boredom, beware. If you have questions or problems about the mod, ask on Official PZ Discord: mod_support channel. On Lockdown This mod cannot be modified by anyone else, for anything else, at all, ever. description: Extended Categories (B42 SP & MP) Greatly expands the categories used in the game and applies its logic dynamically to all items, including those added by other mods. This also dynamically changes the categories of water containers based on their contents. For example, a bottle of soda will be categorized as "Beverage - Soft Drink", while an empty bottle, carton, mug or anything else that holds liquids will be categorized as "Container - Liquid" rather than "Food" or "Water". You can even mix some booze into your soda, and it will be categorized as "Beverage - Cocktail"! 📂 Categories Currently, the following broad categories are covered: 🍗 Foods → divided into Canned, Preserved, Prepared, Meat, Fish, Condiments, Spices, and much more 🍹 Beverages → Alcohol, Water, Tea, Coffee, SoftDrink, Cocktail, etc, with dynamic categorization based on container contents 👕 Apparel → clothing, protective gear and accessories divided into categories like Footwear, Socks, Top, Outerwear, Headwear, Gloves, Underwear, etc. 📚 Literature → Magazines, Hardcovers, Picture Books, Brochures, Fliers, Recipes and more. Categorized items such as phone books as "Literature / Junk". ⚔️ Weapon → Melee weapons divided by skill type and guns into Pistols, Rifles, Shotguns 🔫 Ammo → Magazine, Box, Carton 🚬 Cigarettes → not "Junk" anymore, but categorized as "Smokes" 💌 Memento → all plushies are now "Memento - Plushie" 🪴 Gardening → seeds, seed packets and compostable items 🍳 Cooking → utensils, cutlery and more (WIP 🏗️) 🛠️ Tools → subdivided by relevant skills (WIP 🏗️) 🧱 Materials → subdivided by relevant skills and/or material types (WIP 🏗️) Anything else that's in a box, bundled, stacked, cartoned, etc. will also be categorized as "<Category> - Box" or similar. For example, "Box of Nails" will be categorized as "Material - Box". If you have any ideas or requests, please let me know! For in-depth information and discussion about the categorization logic, visit the Categorization discussion. 📋 Changelog/Release Notes I write detailed change notes on every release. You can find them in the Change Notes tab of this page. 🌐 Translations Visit the Translations discussion to help with translations or see the current available languages. 💡 Recommendation This mod works best together with a mod that allows you to transfer items by their category, such as CleanUI. ⚙️ Compatibility This mod works with the latest version (42.14) and is safe to install or remove at any time. It supports both singleplayer and multiplayer. Built-in compatibility is included and/or maintained for the following mods: Food mods: Vanilla Foods Expanded Sapph's Cooking (WIP, needs more testing) Clothing/container mods: Authentic Z Frockin' Splendor! Pack Mule Customizable Containers Gun mods: Guns of '93 - you can add this optional patch created by Jiopaba and me to categorize guns by their ammo type! GaelGunStore - Note: triggers a lot of lua errors on load, this is not an issue with my mod and it does not affect gameplay. Read the error I trigger manually on game start for more information. Firearms B42 - Note: Same as with GaelGunStore, except it's only one item that triggers this. This should work with ANY other mod that adds content, as I use a broad approach to categorize items based on their properties, rather than specific item names. If a mod honors the game's item property and tag system, their stuff will be categorized correctly. If the mod adds custom categories, food types, body locations or other properties, you might see some items not being categorized correctly, or having missing translations ("IGUI_ItemCat_XXX"). If you run into any issues like that, please let me know, and I'll see what I can do to improve compatibility. Or, if you've tested another mod and everything works fine, please share that as well. :) 🙏 Acknowledgements A special thanks to Better Sorting for inspiring me to make this mod. I've made an extension for it with a similar idea, but it's much less comprehensive as there were far less useful properties/tags available on items pre B42, so most of it is based on assumptions on item names. Since Better Sorting wasn't being updated and I have a different approach to sorting in the first place, I decided to make my own fresh B42 mod from scratch, that I can continue to expand on. description: Tank Water Tank Water adds a complete, realistic industrial water storage system to the world of Project Zomboid. Designed to feel like a natural part of the vanilla game, this mod introduces large-scale water infrastructure commonly found in farms, warehouses, construction sites, and industrial areas — with uncertainty, planning, and long-term survival in mind. Not every tank is guaranteed to contain water. Some may save your run. Others will remind you that nothing is free after the water shutoff. Features Industrial Water Tanks Adds multiple industrial water tanks with different capacities: 1200 L – Industrial Tank (S) 2000 L – Industrial Tank (M) 5000 L – Industrial Tank (L) 10000 L – Industrial Tank (XL) Tanks spawn naturally in appropriate industrial, rural, and construction-related locations. Each tank has its own stored water amount and can spawn full or empty. How to Use – Tank Water System This mod adds a realistic water storage and transfer system to Project Zomboid, allowing you to pump, store, filter, and manage large quantities of water without magic or instant refills. 1. Place a Water Tank Obtain a Water Tank. Place it on the ground where you want your water storage. Tanks store large amounts of water. Water Tanks only function when properly connected to a pump. 2. Connect a Motor Pump Place a Motor Pump near a water source (river, lake, rain collector, etc.). Connect the pump to the tank using a Transfer Hose. Hose connections are site-to-site and respect distance limits. No infinite range. No teleporting water. 3. Choose Your Water Source Carefully If you pump contaminated water, the tank will store contaminated water. If you pump clean water through a filter, the tank will store clean water. You cannot mix clean and contaminated water in the same tank. Once a tank is filled with one type of water, that state remains until emptied. 4. Filtration System Filters allow contaminated water to be purified before entering the tank. Filters have limited durability. If the filter breaks, the pump stops automatically. No hidden purification. The system respects water state logic. 5. Water States The system uses only two states (vanilla-compatible): Clean Water Contaminated Water If contaminated water is stored: You must boil it before drinking. The tank does not magically purify water. 6. Pumping & Wear Pumping consumes fuel. Motor Pumps slowly degrade with use. All actions are progressive (no instant transfers). 7. Maintenance & Risk Large tanks reduce micromanagement. Water cleanliness must still be managed manually. Accepting contaminated water means accepting risk. Water is powerful. But it is never automatic. Inspection & Interface Interactive inspection UI for tanks and motor pump. Displays tank type, capacity, stored water, percentage, and visual progress bar. Displays pump fuel level, condition, operational status, and connection state. Skills & Requirements Operating and repairing the motor pump requires vanilla-style skills: Electricity Level 1 Mechanics Level 2 Required skills and tools are clearly displayed in the inspection panel. Tools Required Screwdriver Vise Grips Gameplay Focus Designed for long survival runs and base infrastructure planning. Encourages realistic water management instead of instant solutions. Scales naturally from mid-game to late-game survival. Why It Matters After the water shutoff, reliable water sources become rare. Industrial tanks can secure your base for days, weeks, or even months — but only if you have the fuel, skills, and setup to use them. Finding a massive tank doesn’t guarantee safety. It guarantees responsibility. Design Philosophy Vanilla-friendly balance and pacing. No instant or magical systems. Physical distance matters. Infrastructure must be built, not exploited. Scales naturally from mid-game to late-game survival. This mod is meant to feel like something that should have always been there. Compatibility Singleplayer and Multiplayer supported. Safe to add to existing saves. No vanilla files are overwritten. Not compatible with Dynamic Backpack Updates, Skill Recovery Journal mod. Mod Interaction Tank Water is designed as a standalone infrastructure system. The industrial tanks added by this mod do not automatically integrate with other water-related mods. Water transfer is handled exclusively through the Tank Water motor pump and hose system. Known Interactions [B42] Functional Gutters Tanks will NOT automatically collect rainwater from gutters. This is an intentional design decision to avoid passive or infinite water generation. [B42] Water Pipes / Plumbing Mods Tanks will NOT automatically connect to the features of other water system mods. Vanilla rain collectors and plumbing remain unaffected. This mod's permissions fall under TIS's policy: Ask for permission (theindiestone.com) This mod can only be added to and extended with the express permission from the original creator. If permission is granted, proper credit must be given both within the mod files and wherever the mod is published. If no permission is received, the mod must be treated as 'On Lockdown'. Servers are allowed to include this mod in their modpacks and apply internal changes, as long as proper credit is given to the original creator. Support the Mod Support the Project If you enjoy this mod and want to support future updates and new systems: Your support helps expand the project and keep development active. Every contribution makes a difference. Thank you for your support! ❤️ A like or favorite helps a LOT! Workshop ID: 3652517636 Mod ID: TankWater

description: Numb Trait Adds a progression-based emotional hardening system tied to zombie kills. As survivors accumulate kills they gain traits that progressively reduce emotional penalties. There are currently two versions of this mod included — enable only one at a time: NumbTrait_B42 — v1 (original). Build 42.13.2+ NumbTrait_B42_V2 — v2 (redesign). Build 42.18+ Switching from v1 to v2 You can safely switch from v1 to v2 on an existing save without starting a new character or save. Disable NumbTrait_B42 and enable NumbTrait_B42_V2 — your kill count carries over. Your next kill will trigger v2 to re-evaluate your kill count and apply the correct v2 trait, which may differ from what you currently hold due to the redesigned tier order. Sandbox settings are not compatible between versions — reconfigure from scratch when switching from v1 to v2. Tier Progression Kill thresholds are configurable per tier in Sandbox settings. Stat Clamping v1: Hardened through Apathetic hard-lock Panic to 0. Discomfort is clamped to 0 for all custom traits and is not configurable. Desensitized uses vanilla behavior. Numb clamps all stats to 0. v2: Panic now descends gradually per tier. Discomfort is now capped and configurable per tier. Desensitized receives mod-side Stress, Unhappiness, and Boredom clamping (Panic and Discomfort remain vanilla at Desensitized). All values below are defaults and configurable in Sandbox settings. Corpse Looting Immunity Stress and unhappiness from looting corpses are suppressed: v1: Hardened, Calloused, Detached, Apathetic v2: Hardened through Desensitized (T2–T6) — Desensitized is now included Negative Trait Removals * Pacifist and Smoker removals are optional and configurable in Sandbox settings. Sandbox Options Both versions: kill thresholds per tier, enable/disable individual tiers, max Stress/Unhappiness/Boredom per tier, optional removal toggles (Brave, Desensitized, Smoker, Pacifist), and auto-reapply removed progression traits. v2 additionally: max Panic per tier (Hardened–Apathetic), max Discomfort per tier (Hardened–Apathetic), and max Stress/Unhappiness/Boredom for Desensitized. v2 uses a unified Enable* toggle naming convention (EnableBrave, EnableHardened, …, EnableNumb). Known Issues Trait icons need to be re-made or properly re-scaled for the Project Zomboid UI Stress gain from the Smoker trait appears to ignore this mod's stat clamping Starting with a Veteran character using NumbTrait v2 means no trait progression until you reach the requirements for the Numb trait. Where to find microscopes: schools, medical clinics, hospitals, police stations (forensics), and the occasional fancy house. Unlockable traits Some specimens are tagged for trait research: each unique item type you study at a microscope counts toward that trait.
